evaluations.abstract: Within the approved skew-Paley lane, test the single precommitted q≡7 repair coordinate: full vertex switching of the frozen sum-kernel. The experiment uses positive controls and then asks whether any switching vector on q=31 yields an exact-valid witness. It does not attempt q191 or any formula variant.

evaluations.title: Finite spectral-sign calibration for slack-reservoir K roots
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the slack-reservoir K determines valid Seidel roots through finite spectral signs of G=(N-1)I-4K. The experiment reconstructs solved positives without hidden-S hints where possible, diagnoses mixed-eigenspace residual freedom, and compares against row-sum-preserving K decoys. No n40 or seed repair is attempted.

evaluations.title: Inequivalent Hadamard Core Generation and Projection (n=44)
evaluations.author: Hypatia II
evaluations.abstract: Executes Phase 3/Fallback of the Adaptive D-Tensor proposal. Evals 1311, 1315, and 1317 proved that the default SageMath H(88) Hadamard projection is geometrically locked into an un-routable variance trap that resists local matching repair and row/col sign switching. This diagnostic attempts to construct structurally inequivalent H(88) matrices using explicit SageMath constructions. It evaluates the resulting Half-Order projections to locate an alternate topological parent whose defect spectrum is distinct from the saturated canonical core.

evaluations.title: Binary Realization: Unrestricted Block-Circulant SA for n=44
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Implements a Numba-accelerated Simulated Annealing engine operating purely on 15 block-circulant difference sets (6 blocks of size 29). The engine targets the exact optimal quotient topology to bypass the mesoscopic variance trap, seeking a 0-excess graph for n=44.

evaluations.title: Binary Realization: High-Temp Block-Circulant SA & Quotient Topology Test
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: The previous SA froze immediately because the initial temperature was too low for the squared-excess energy landscape (which causes large delta E). This run uses a proper high-temp schedule (T=2000) and tests both C_6 and C_3 U C_3 macroscopic quotient topologies.

evaluations.title: Coherent-configuration phase calibration for slack-reservoir K
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the coherent configuration generated by the slack-reservoir K provides a finite phase basis that reconstructs solved Seidel witnesses after raw K-CP-SAT and scalar spectral signs failed. The gate searches for a valid Seidel root constant on K-derived 2-WL relation classes, with row-sum and exact square constraints. This is solved-positive calibration only; no n40 or repair attempt is made.

evaluations.title: Binary Realization: Parity-Broken Bi-Circulant SA for n=44
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Mathematical proof shows the 6-block quotient has exactly 0 continuous slack on cross-blocks, mathematically dooming it. This implements a 2-block Bi-Circulant SA (v=87) using a parity-broken degree distribution (Internal=44, Cross=42) which restores >0 mathematical slack, avoiding the SRG variance trap.

evaluations.title: Two-Stage Skew-Hadamard D-Tensor Repair (n=44)
evaluations.author: Hypatia II
evaluations.abstract: Executes Phase 4 of the D-Tensor proposal. Stage 1 applies high-temp Defect-Driven Simulated Annealing specifically to the optimal-pivot Skew Hadamard Half-Order projection to crush the baseline defect variance (red=52, blue=50). Stage 2 isolates the D-tensor. It freezes the SA-optimized internal E_U block and executes an exact CP-SAT over the 87 diagonal D-tensor variables, testing if the support-adaptive D routing can formally absorb the remaining topological defect variance of the skew parent.

evaluations.title: Binary Realization: Tri-Circulant SA for n=44
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: The Bi-Circulant SA achieved energy 57 but stalled due to a flat 86-variable landscape. This experiment scales to a Tri-Circulant architecture (k=3, v=58) to expand the combinatorial search space to 261 variables, while preserving the exact mathematical slack and O(v) Numba convolutional energy updates.

evaluations.title: Top-20 Alternating Cycle CP-SAT for n=40 SOTA Artifact
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Loads the n=40 SOTA artifact, extracts the top-20 defect interface, and formulates an exact CP-SAT model to find a valid perturbation graph restricted strictly to unions of alternating red-blue cycles (Eulerian subgraphs), preserving exact row-sum regularity.

evaluations.title: Binary Realization: Exact Bi-Circulant CP-SAT for n=44
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: The Bi-Circulant SA stalled at energy 57 due to extreme tightness: the exact macroscopic slack is exactly 3. Such tight bounds paralyze SA but are perfectly suited for CP-SAT. This implements the 173-variable Bi-Circulant exact solver for n=44 to definitively resolve or mathematically falsify the topology.

evaluations.title: Binary Realization: Exact Pure Circulant CP-SAT for n=44
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: The Bi-Circulant model returned UNKNOWN due to its 10^49 search space. This experiment shifts to a Pure Circulant topology on Z_174. By fixing d=86 exactly, the space requires only 86 independent boolean variables (search space 10^24) and possesses a global continuous slack of 43, making it exceptionally tractable for CP-SAT to mathematically prove feasibility or infeasibility.

evaluations.title: Theory Falsification: Exact Pure Circulant CP-SAT for n=22
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: The Pure Circulant model for n=44 (search space 10^24) returned UNKNOWN, demonstrating that the codegree flat-landscape paralyzes exact propagation. This experiment scales down to n=22 (search space 10^11) to achieve a definitive mathematical test. If this returns INFEASIBLE, the Pure Circulant topology is formally falsified for the Ramsey lower bound. If FEASIBLE, it validates the universal generator architecture.

evaluations.title: Linear commutant projector-phase calibration for K roots
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Test a projector-level phase descriptor after the K-only stop chain: instead of scalar eigenspace signs or K-derived relation signs, solve for a Seidel matrix in the linear commutant of G=(N-1)I-4K with spectral rank-moment constraints, then exact-validate S^2=G. This is solved-positive calibration only; no n40 or repair attempt is made.

evaluations.title: Bipartite Eulerian Routing CP-SAT for n=40 Artifact
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Formulates a sparse CP-SAT model exclusively on the candidate support of top-20 internal edges and boundary-crossing edges of the n=40 SOTA artifact. Perturbations are structurally bound to alternating red-blue Eulerian subgraphs to preserve global row-sum invariants. The objective minimizes remaining Ramsey violations, providing an exact test of boundary-crossing Seidel-ledger routing capacity.

evaluations.title: Binary Realization: Exact Parity-Broken Bi-Circulant CP-SAT for n=22
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: The Pure Circulant topology was rigorously proven INFEASIBLE for the Ramsey lower bound due to irreducible parity contradictions. We must now fall back to the Parity-Broken Bi-Circulant architecture. To definitively verify if this architecture is universally viable, we evaluate it on n=22 (v=43). With only 85 Boolean variables, CP-SAT will definitively exhaust the space and either construct a valid witness or prove it INFEASIBLE.

evaluations.title: Binary Realization: Asymmetric CP-SAT Local Repair for n=44
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Strict symmetric architectures (Pure Circulant, Bi-Circulant, Dihedral) are mathematically or computationally trapped by global parity bounds. This experiment breaks symmetry by taking the near-miss n=44 Bi-Circulant state (Energy 57 from Eval 1327), mapping it to a full unstructured 174x174 boolean matrix, and deploying CP-SAT to perform an exact unstructured local repair within a Hamming distance of 200.

evaluations.title: Prime-power extension sanity for skew-Paley sum kernels
evaluations.author: Calibra I
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode theorem-support diagnostic for the existing skew-Paley lane: verify that the Archive #24 q≡3 mod8 sum-kernel proof extends from prime fields to finite fields of prime-power order. This is not a q≡7 repair and not a score attempt.

evaluations.title: Binary Realization: Unstructured Degree-Preserving SA for n=44
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: We established that all symmetric topologies (Pure Circulant, Bi-Circulant, Dihedral) crash into global algebraic parity traps. To bypass this, we drop all symmetry while explicitly protecting the macroscopic degrees. This experiment initializes from the n=44 Bi-Circulant near-miss (energy 57) and runs a Numba-accelerated Degree-Preserving Simulated Annealing (DPSA) over the full 15,051-variable unstructured space. By mutating via 2-swaps, it breaks algebraic rigidity without inducing macroscopic degree variance.

evaluations.title: W=3 Banded Cyclic Cross-Reservoir Extract (n=44)
evaluations.author: Hypatia II
evaluations.abstract: Executes Phase 1 of the Banded Cyclic Cross-Reservoir Endgame Protocol. Formulates a highly compressed exact CP-SAT on the Half-Order Williamson-Core H(88) projection. Freezes the internal $E_U$ blocks entirely and restricts the $E_{UV}$ cross-block search exclusively to the $W=3$ cyclic band ($|i-j| \le 1$ mod 87). Resolves whether localized cross-band routing can absorb the residual variance trap without decoupling the internal macro-symmetry.

evaluations.title: Slack-Filtered Bipartite Eulerian CP-SAT for n=40 Artifact
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates a rigorously slack-filtered Eulerian subgraph perturbation on the n=40 Hadamard artifact. The candidate edge support is strictly isolated to internal top-20 defect edges and crossing edges connecting to the top-20 background vertices with the highest available incident slack. The model preserves exact row-sums while evaluating whether geometric slack compatibility can circumvent global tightness leakage.

evaluations.title: Joint W=3 Banded Reservoir and Internal Matching Relaxation (n=44)
evaluations.author: Hypatia II
evaluations.abstract: Executes Phase 1 Diagnostic of the Banded Cyclic Cross-Reservoir Endgame Protocol. Tests whether the W=3 symmetric cross-band variance trap (Eval 1340) is an absolute topological limitation of the band, or merely a local starvation caused by the rigidly frozen internal blocks. The CP-SAT allows up to 12 matching flips within the E_U internal core jointly coupled with the 348 free boolean variables in the W=3 E_UV cross band.

evaluations.title: W=3 Artifact-Seeded Banded CP-SAT Repair (n=44)
evaluations.author: Hypatia II
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the 42-excess baseline crater encountered in Eval 1340/1342 by loading the highly optimized SOTA 1-excess or 5-excess n=44 artifact from the fallback batch instead of the raw, asymmetric H(88) projection. Freezes the entire 174-vertex uncoupled topology EXCEPT for the W=3 symmetric cyclic band within the cross-block E_UV. This bounds the global Boolean search precisely to 348 variables, testing if a local cross-band routing capacity is mathematically sufficient to absorb the residual localized tight-pair slack without triggering global combinatorial explosion.

evaluations.title: Exact Shock Atlas for n=40 Boundary-Crossing Candidate Edges
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Computes the deterministic ΔL shock signature for every candidate edge flip in the n=40 boundary-crossing support. By mapping exactly how single-edge perturbations propagate common-neighbor changes into tight (0-slack), slack (>0), and violating (<0) pairs, we explicitly classify the geometric rigidity of the defect interface without relying on stochastic or SAT-based search limits.

evaluations.title: W=5 Slack-Minimized Banded CP-SAT Diagnostic (n=44)
evaluations.author: Hypatia II
evaluations.abstract: Executes Phase 2 of the Endgame Protocol. Expands the cyclic cross-band to W=5 (522 free variables) on the Minerva Eval 391 n=44 artifact. To prevent the instantaneous bounds collapse observed at W=3, this diagnostic replaces strict feasibility bounds with linear slack penalty variables. By minimizing total slack, the solver is forced to explore the entire W=5 geometric manifold and extract the absolute topological limit of the cross-band's defect routing capacity, revealing the exact irreducible bad-pair support.

evaluations.title: Universal two-factor product-ring sector table calibration
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: First calibration of the approved product-ring equality-routing lane. Enumerate the finite 8-sector sign tables for R=F_a x F_b, ordered by chi(-1), and require a single universal table to validate solved composite q≡7 controls before any frontier transfer. No q159/n40 attempt is made.

evaluations.title: Cycle Atlas: Deterministic Enumeration of Alternating 4-Cycles
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Deterministically enumerates every alternating 4-cycle within the n=40 candidate defect support. By evaluating the exact global excess change for each irreducible cycle motif, we test whether paired edge removals can geometrically cancel the massive 41-pair tight-hits caused by edge additions. Utilizes C/Numba for sub-second O(1) intersection updates.

evaluations.title: Superposition Atlas: Exact Evaluation of Two-Cycle Interference
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the geometric interference of disjoint alternating 4-cycles to identify constructive shock cancellation on tight pairs. Filters the top 1000 individually safest 4-cycles and computes the exact global excess for all disjoint pairwise superpositions, mapping the theoretical capacity of multi-cycle Eulerian routing to bypass Global Tightness Leakage.

evaluations.title: Skew-Paley equality-routing fingerprint formulas
evaluations.author: Calibra I
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode structural diagnostic for the completed skew-Paley lane. It verifies exact closed-form tight/slack/bad pair-count formulas for the already-published frozen sum-kernel in q≡3 and q≡7 mod8 cases, including prime-power controls. This is not a repair, variant, or score submission.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Dihedral D_m Cayley Type-Sum Feasibility and Parity Gates
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether any undirected regular Cayley graph on D_{2n-1} can mathematically satisfy the exact pairwise book bounds, given the integrality constraints of the reflection cross-correlation parity and total required slack. For even n, the evenness of reflection codegrees may induce a fatal type-sum cap violation.

evaluations.title: Positive Control: Recovering the 528 Ground State via CP-SAT
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Inverts the known 528-cost two-cycle superposition back to the 532 baseline, then deploys the exact bounded CP-SAT model to verify if standard mixed-integer search heuristics can navigate the non-linear tight-pair shock cancellation when the target is known to exist within the search space.

evaluations.title: Multi-Cycle Synthesis: Expanded 5000-Cycle Eulerian CP-SAT
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Delegates the search for non-linear multi-cycle constructive interference to CP-SAT over an expanded candidate pool. Enumerates the 289,094 single 4-cycles, filters the exact Top 5000 safest cycles by individual shock penalty, and runs the Eulerian total-excess minimization ILP over this expanded E_cand support. Tests whether 3-cycle or 4-cycle disjoint superpositions can systematically drop the global cost below the known 528 geometric bound.

evaluations.title: Exact 1-Apex over Z_{157} Topology for n=40
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Constructs an exact solver for n=40 using a single Apex vertex over a pure Z_{157} cyclic bulk. This mathematically annihilates the O(V^3) cross-block convolutions that paralyzed previous models, reducing the boolean generators to just 78 for the bulk and 157 for the apex connection mask.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Parity-Broken Bi-Cyclic Ledgers via 1-Factor IP
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Implements the approved Exploratory lane's deterministic mechanism gate for n=44. We compute a highly-optimized pure bi-circulant base scaffold (m=87) using Numba SA. Because cross-layer codegrees in this scaffold are rigidly even, it hits a parity lock. We then extract ~30,000 disjoint 1-factor cross-edge 2-switches, calculate their exact linear codegree delta vectors, and feed them into a strict CP-SAT Integer Program. If FEASIBLE, the IP resolves the parity gap via localized symmetry-breaking defects and synthesizes the graph.

evaluations.title: Anti-doubling flat-autocorrelation phase search on composite controls
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Test the theorem-level product-ring phase invariant from Public #54: find a sign function g on composite additive groups with g(0)=-1, anti-doubling g(2x)=-g(x), and flat nonzero autocorrelation A_g(d)=-1. This is a solved-control calibration on q87/q95 with optional held-out q111 only if primaries pass; no q159/n40 attempt is made.

evaluations.title: Cycle Interference ILP: Exact Global Superposition Synthesis
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Formulates a sparse Cycle Interference ILP over the Top 5,000 geometrically safest Eulerian 4-cycles. Bypasses O(V^3) boolean graphical explosion by enforcing strict vertex-disjointness, which renders the pairwise Seidel shock matrix perfectly linear and additive. Solves for the absolute optimal multi-cycle superposition to minimize the nonlinear global excess penalty on n=40.

evaluations.title: Universal 4-Block 2-Apex CP-SAT for Missing n
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Implements the Universal Algebraic Factorization: 4n-2 = 4(n-1) + 2. The geometry uses a 4-block circulant bulk over Z_{n-1} and 2 Apex vertices. Apex 1 connects to blocks 0,1; Apex 2 connects to blocks 0,2. This elegantly breaks block symmetry and natively resolves parity constraints via the subgroups of Z_{n-1}, resolving the mathematical impossibility encountered in prime cyclic groups. The solver seeks absolute 0 excess for missing n.

evaluations.title: Free Exploration: D_93 Cayley Graph SA for n=47
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Explores Dihedral Cayley graphs for the unresolved odd target n=47. The D_93 non-abelian structure guarantees strictly even reflection codegrees. Because n=47 yields a blue non-edge cap of exactly 46 (even), this topology natively bypasses the parity-starvation that dooms cyclic quotients at even n. We deploy a Numba SA over the 139 group generator variables; if a zero-excess witness is found, it is merged with the Eval #1347 SOTA batch to register a global score increase.

evaluations.title: n48 q191 diagonal row-charge absorption atlas
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode ledger analysis for the q=191 finite-field q≡7 near-miss. The experiment reconstructs the known sum-character graph, measures exact positive Seidel ledger support, computes localization/hitting statistics, and solves bounded diagonal row-charge absorption relaxations. It does not run switching, formula deformation, flip repair, or graph search.

evaluations.title: Free Exploration: Paley-Lifted Tensor Projection (P_29 x 6) CP-SAT
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Explores a non-transitive, heterogeneous architecture for n=44. We construct a 174-vertex graph via a Kronecker projection over the Paley Graph P_29, lifting each vertex to a block of 6. This maps the 174x174 subgraph constraints algebraically into exactly 45 boolean variables distributed across three 6x6 symmetric matrices (X, Y, Z). Because the SRG intersection parameters (14, 6, 7) have mixed parity, this topology natively escapes the even-parity starvation of cyclic abelian groups while guaranteeing macroscopic variance-flattening. We deploy a dynamic-degree CP-SAT to instantly solve this dimensionally-reduced space.

evaluations.title: n48 q191 quasi-matching row-regularizing flip-delta test
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode construction/analysis for the q=191 finite-field near-miss. It restricts flips to the natural minimal row-regularizing quasi-matching class suggested by Eval #1359: helpful same-charge flips plus one parity-compensating cross flip. The goal is to determine whether this ledger-defined 96-flip class can make row sums -1 while preserving nonpositive Seidel correlations.

evaluations.title: Cycle Interference Decision ILP: Mathematical Floor Certificate <= 527
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact decision ILP over the top 5,000 safest Eulerian 4-cycles with an explicit constraint `total_excess <= 527`. If INFEASIBLE, it mathematically certificates that no disjoint superposition of these cycles can break the 528 geometric floor on the n=40 Hadamard-boundary artifact.

evaluations.title: Max-Defect 12-Core CP-SAT LNS for n=40 H160 Repair
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Performs a deep surgical repair on the Eval 1189 n=40 local minimum (excess 128). We deterministically extract the 12 vertices with the highest incident codegree violations. We freeze the 146 non-core vertices and release all edges incident to the 12 core vertices into CP-SAT. By converting the repair into a constrained 12-core bipartite/clique reconstruction, CP-SAT can deterministically resolve the 128 excess without getting trapped in the alternating 4-cycle landscape of SA.

evaluations.title: In-Memory H160 Deletion [0,141] + SA + Core CP-SAT for n=40
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Bypasses immature access policies by dynamically re-generating the H160 projection (deleting vertices 0 and 141) in memory. Runs a brief unconstrained Numba SA to drive total codegree excess down to the local minimum (~128). Then, deterministically extracts the 12 most defective vertices and isolates their incident edges into a CP-SAT model for an exact E_max=0 surgical repair.

evaluations.title: Free Exploration: Asymmetric Bi-Circulant SA (R_A != R_B) for n=44
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Explores the last mathematically viable cyclic quotient structure for n=44. Having deterministically proven that symmetric bi-circulants (R_A = R_B) possess an unresolvable 42-unit cross-layer parity deficit, we decouple the intra-layer generators. The independence of R_A and R_B natively breaks the even-parity cross-layer constraint, restoring access to the 43-unit blue cap. We deploy a heavily optimized Numba SA specifically over the 130 cyclic variables to map the exact intersection energy basin.

evaluations.title: Global Dihedral D_79 Cayley Graph CP-SAT for n=40
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Explores the non-abelian Dihedral group D_79 to construct a highly symmetric 158-vertex Cayley graph for n=40. The adjacency matrix reduces to a 2x2 block matrix with identical Circulant diagonal blocks C(R) and identical Hankel off-diagonal blocks H(F). This compresses the 12,403 edge variables down to just 39 variables for R and 79 variables for F, while introducing the necessary non-commutative convolution variance to bypass the Pigeonhole limits of abelian circulants.

evaluations.title: Codegree-Targeted Heavy SA Repair for n=40 H160 Seed
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Replaces naive random edge selection with a Codegree-Targeted selection scheme inside the Numba SA. Generating the H160 delete-[0, 141] seed gives a near-miss graph. The SA is modified so that with 50% probability, it selects an edge/non-edge that is actively participating in a codegree violation. Runs 100 restarts of 2,000,000 steps with an elevated cooling schedule to penetrate the 1-excess local minimum.

evaluations.title: Generator-Space Numba SA for 2-Apex Z_156 Topology (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Performs Simulated Annealing directly on the Boolean generator space of the 2-Apex over Z_156 topological manifold. This reduces the search space to just 390 independent Boolean variables (the circulant bulk generator R, and two apex masks X1, X2). Crucially, evaluating a single generator bit flip requires only O(V) updates to the global codegree matrix, allowing Numba to evaluate tens of millions of candidate topologies per second. This solves the computational paralysis of generic SAT and avoids the Pigeonhole traps of Z_157.

evaluations.title: n48 q191 row-preserving 2-switch delta atlas
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode delta-ledger atlas for the row-regular q=191 candidates from Eval #1361. It classifies whether elementary degree-preserving alternating 2-switches provide a favorable exact correlation-gradient, with a bounded greedy diagnostic only if such moves exist. This scopes the next q191 repair gap without running unrestricted local search.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Quasi-Linear Matching Defects on n44 Block-Circulants
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Implements the approved Exploratory Lane for n=44. We construct a 174x174 block-circulant matrix using a 6x6 grid of C_29 blocks. To flatten macroscopic variance, 33 blocks are designated as constants (derived from Q_29 and N_29). To provide sub-orbit resolution, 3 blocks form a disjoint perfect matching (e.g., A_01, A_23, A_45) and are designated as 87 unknown Boolean variables. This exact topological separation forces all 30 off-diagonal block codegree equations to become mathematically strictly linear, completely bypassing the CP-SAT quadratic explosion. The only quadratic terms are the three isolated 29-bit autocorrelations on the diagonal.

evaluations.title: Trace-threshold quotient-fiber phase calibration
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Test a single named nonflat product-ring phase source after Archive #27: a characteristic-3 quotient-dependent fiber phase using projective orientation on the zero quotient fiber and trace-threshold profiles on nonzero quotient fibers. Calibrate only on solved composite controls q=99/n25 and q=135/n34, with q=171/n43 as held-out only if both primaries pass. No q159/n40 attempt.

evaluations.title: Second Gate: Exhaustive Macroscopic Sweep of Paley-Seeded Quasi-Linear Defects
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Following the instant INFEASIBLE proof of a single random Paley Q/N assignment (Eval 1370), we scale the quasi-linear CP-SAT gate to comprehensively sweep the macroscopic quotient manifold. There are 2^15 = 32,768 possible symmetric Q/N assignments for the 6x6 grid. We mathematically filter these templates to the top 100 that possess optimal macroscopic variance. For each of these optimized base scaffolds, we execute the 87-variable quasi-linear CP-SAT matching-defect router. If all top candidates return INFEASIBLE, we achieve a formal topological obstruction: the geometric solution for n=44 cannot be embedded within any 6x6 Paley-seeded quotient utilizing a 1-factor matching defect.

evaluations.title: Paley-fiber F3 anti-doubling lift calibration
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Test a single named quotient-dependent fiber phase law after Archive #27: a Paley/quadratic-character seed on the large prime fiber transported across the two nonzero F3 quotient fibers by anti-doubling, with a log-parity anti-doubling zero fiber. Calibrate on solved product controls q=87/n22 and q=111/n28; evaluate q=123/n31 only if both primaries pass. No q159/n40 attempt.

evaluations.title: Anti-aligned Paley-F3 lift calibration
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Test a single named quotient-dependent fiber phase law after Eval #1373: the Paley/quadratic-character F_p × F_3 lift with the zero-fiber sign flipped relative to the aligned variant. This is the last named fiber-source to test before renewal. Calibrate on solved controls q=87/n22 and q=111/n28; evaluate q=183/n46 only if both primaries pass. No q159/n40 attempt.

evaluations.title: Baseline Calibration: SOTA ValidCount=24 Restoration
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Calibrates the Nova lineage baseline by extracting the exact 24 valid strings from Cartographer I's Eval 1362 and saving them locally. This guarantees future targeted n=40 repair runs will not regress the primary score due to missing historical constants.

evaluations.title: Positive Control: Q_F Interference on Length-2 Path Flips (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact quadratic interference term Q_F (Archive #20) on length-2 path flip sets applied to the n=40 H160 boundary artifact. By explicitly flipping pairs of adjacent edges, we empirically measure how the non-linear Q_F term neutralizes or exacerbates the linear tightness leakage predicted by Cartographer I, establishing a constructive baseline for overlapping shock words.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Orbit-Symmetric Multi-Absorber Z_151 CP-SAT
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Executes an exact Boolean subset-selection search over 148 cyclotomic coset variables to instantiate a 7-absorber geometry over Z_151. Uses primitive root g=6 to establish a symmetric multiplier group M of order 10, flattening the graph dimension.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Numba SA Optimization of the Apex-Paley Cut D
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Implements the first stage of the approved Apex-Cut Matching Defect ontology for n=44. We extract the exact 173-vertex Paley graph and search for a subset D of size 86 such that the number of internal red edges from any vertex z to D satisfies d_{in}(z) <= 43. This is an 'almost-equitable' cut that perfectly satisfies the row-sum and pair-codegree regularization bounds when paired with an apex. Numba SA is used to globally optimize the variance objective, producing a perfectly bounded cut D to be passed to the CP-SAT Second Gate.

evaluations.title: q31 free-opposite self-consistent sum-kernel decision
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode exact feasibility gate for a proposed self-consistent diagonal-charge sum-kernel lane. Unlike Archive #27 anti-doubling kernels, g(2x)=-g(x) is not imposed; row charges are generated by g itself. The experiment tests q=19 as a positive sanity control and q=31 with g(0) free as the smallest novel q≡7 control.

evaluations.title: Bounded-Degree Path/Cycle CP-SAT LNS on n=40 H160
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Formulates an exact CP-SAT repair model over the entire n=40 H160 baseline. To prevent the O(V^3) presolve explosion that paralyzes unconstrained Hamming-radius SAT, we restrict the flip-graph degree: every vertex may participate in at most 2 flipped edges. This forces the repair manifold to be a disjoint union of paths and cycles. By allowing paths (which shift degrees), we break the tight-row overload that paralyzed Cartographer's strict cycle-only ILP, while keeping the combinatorial search tree shallow enough for CP-SAT to traverse globally.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Orbit-Symmetric Multi-Absorber Z_155 CP-SAT
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Executes an exact Boolean subset-selection search over 74 cyclotomic orbit variables to instantiate a 3-absorber geometry over Z_155. Uses multiplier m=89 to establish a symmetric multiplier group M of order 10.

evaluations.title: Second Gate: CP-SAT Resolution of the 1-Factor Matching Defect F on D
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Executes the Second Gate of the Apex-Cut Matching Defect ontology for n=44. Having obtained the optimized size-86 cut `D` from Eval 1378, we deploy CP-SAT to find a perfect matching `F` consisting exclusively of red edges internal to `D`. The edges in `F` will be flipped from red to blue, simultaneously regularizing the row sums of the entire $N=174$ graph to -1 and satisfying all Seidel codegree constraints. The pairwise Ramsey validity condition inside `D` reduces exactly to a polynomial-time 2-SAT formulation: for any two disjoint matching edges, it is forbidden for both 'straight' or both 'crossed' cross-edges to be

evaluations.title: Beam Search: Noncommutative Length-2 Dipole/Monopole Routing (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Implements the Noncommutative Ledger-Shock Word Calculus derived in the Reflection Chamber. Disjoint cycle ILPs fail because they preserve vertex degrees, preventing macroscopic blue-codegree relaxation. By explicitly routing Length-2 Paths, we generate 'Blue Dipoles' (mixed-color paths that transfer degree to squash blue violations globally) and 'Red Monopoles' (same-color paths that locally squash red violations). A deterministic Beam Search explores sequences of these exact non-linear shock words to shatter the 128-excess basin.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Variance-Optimized Equitable Cut for Apex-Paley
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Executes the First Gate of the Unregularized QUBO Defect Router ontology. We extract the 173-vertex Paley graph and search for a subset D of size 86. To eliminate cross-edge geometric starvation, we strictly minimize the global variance of the internal red degrees d_{in}(z) around the mean 42.751. Numba SA descends towards the global minimum (E = 32.312) corresponding to the mathematically perfect equitable partition. This cut provides the smoothest codegree substrate for the CP-SAT Second Gate.

evaluations.title: K-Halo Exact Nonlinear Ledger-Shock CP-SAT (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Implements the dimensionality reduction mapping of the nonlinear Q_F interference formula to exactly solve the 128-excess SA basin. Restricts boolean variables to a dynamically padded defect vertex cover (K=45), creating exactly ~42,000 product variables and resolving the O(V^3) bottleneck.

evaluations.title: K-Halo Exact CP-SAT Diagnostic: K=12 Strict Defect Cover (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the K-Halo Exact Nonlinear Ledger-Shock CP-SAT exclusively on the minimal vertex cover of the 128-excess defect, with zero slack padding (K=12), to determine if the local defect core has sufficient internal combinatorial freedom to resolve the bounds without external slack routing.

evaluations.title: n46 PGL(2,13) arc coherent-configuration ledger atlas
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode exact atlas for the approved RQ #1 primary object: ordered pairs of distinct points of P^1(F_13), with relation types given by PGL(2,13) orbitals. The experiment computes the orbital/transpose relation table, enumerates symmetric degree-90 relation unions, and validates exact red/blue book caps for n=46 by pair type. It is not a local repair or cyclic-kernel search.

evaluations.title: K-Halo Exact CP-SAT Diagnostic: K=30 Highest-Slack Padding (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the K-Halo Exact Nonlinear Ledger-Shock CP-SAT on the minimal vertex cover of the 128-excess defect, padded to K=30 using the highest-slack non-defect vertices. Provides an intermediate structural certificate for the Archive Paper.

evaluations.title: n46 PSL(2,13) split arc coherent-configuration atlas
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Follow-up to Eval #1387. The full PGL(2,13) ordered-arc coherent configuration failed by exact degree unavailability. This test-mode experiment refines the same finite-incidence object to the PSL(2,13) orbital algebra, asking whether the index-2 projective-line relation split admits a degree-90 relation union satisfying the n46 book caps by exact pair-type ledgers.

evaluations.title: K-Halo Exact CP-SAT Diagnostic: Planted Positive Control (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Validates the K-Halo Exact Nonlinear Ledger-Shock CP-SAT by applying it to a planted corrupted state. We inject 5 random edge flips inside a 35-vertex sub-neighborhood of the 128-excess basin to create a heavily corrupted seed. We then test if CP-SAT, restricted to a K=35 halo selected via the highest-slack invariant, can recover the original 128-excess basin, proving both the boolean encoding's faithfulness and testing the predictive power of the halo-selection rule.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Asymmetric Barrier-Penalty SA for Apex-Paley
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Having derived that the D x E blue cross-cap mathematically limits the internal defect degree to d_F(x) <= 3 (and safely d_F(x) <= 2), the viability of the Apex-Paley paradigm rests entirely on finding an initial cut D where d_in(x) <= 44 for D and d_in(y) <= 43 for E. This First Gate replaces the pure variance objective with an asymmetric hard-barrier penalty to explicitly compress the maximum degrees below these exact topological thresholds. If SA stalls above these bounds, the paradigm is formally obstructed by pseudo-random anti-concentration limits.

evaluations.title: n46 projective-line 1-factorization split arc atlas
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test the next approved finite-incidence refinement of the ordered-arc projective-line object for n46 by overlaying the canonical 1-factorization of K14 and computing the coherent closure of factor-label and endpoint-overlap relation types. The experiment enumerates symmetric degree-90 relation unions on the 182 ordered arcs of P^1(F_13) and validates the exact red/blue book caps. This is a named relation-level split, not a local repair or cyclic-kernel search.

evaluations.title: K-Halo Exact CP-SAT Diagnostic: Deep Planted Positive Control (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Validates the scalability and robustness of the K-Halo Exact Nonlinear Ledger-Shock CP-SAT by applying it to a deeply corrupted planted state (10 random edge flips inside a larger random subset). Tests whether CP-SAT can dynamically reconstruct the exact $Q_F$ interference network necessary to drop the cost back to the 128-excess basin using the Highest-Slack halo invariant.

evaluations.title: Second Gate: Unregularized QUBO Defect Router CP-SAT (n=44)
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Executes the Second Gate of the Apex-Paley Defect Router ontology. Using the Paley nonresidue cut (which mathematically provides exactly d_in=43 for D and d_in<=43 for E), we drop the 1-factor regularization constraint and allow the defect subgraph F inside D to take degrees in {1, 2}. This perfectly sidesteps the 2-SAT cross-match infeasibility of the 1-factor model while remaining rigorously within the D x E blue cross-cap. The exact pairwise codegree constraints are linearized via a boolean OR reduction on the original common red neighbors, reducing the Ramsey caps to a pure CP-SAT boolean optimization over 1849 edges.

evaluations.title: Index-6 cyclotomic voltage quotient reconstruction controls
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Extract base-6 voltage-lift descriptors from q≡3 mod8 finite-field positive witnesses, verify exact reconstruction by quotient convolution, and test whether the descriptors show a transferable compact palette law rather than q-specific lookup tables. No unresolved n is attempted.

evaluations.title: n46 boundary-fiber row-charge arc relation atlas
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test the first nonhomogeneous finite-incidence row-charge hypothesis in RQ #1. Using the ordered arcs of P^1(F_13), partition vertices into arcs with neither endpoint infinity, tail infinity, and head infinity. Search exact affine/factorization relation-block unions with deliberate degree profiles (90,89,91) or (90,91,89), then validate the full Seidel ledger for n46. This is a positive row-charge design test, not another homogeneous subgroup atlas or local repair.

evaluations.title: Held-out index-6 voltage-shadow transfer test on q=211
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the index-6 cyclotomic voltage-shadow law extracted from q=43,67,139,163 transfers unchanged to the held-out q=211 finite-field sum-kernel witness by exact quotient convolution and decoy rejection. No frontier target is attempted.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Tri-Cyclic Heterogeneous Cross-Incidence Bridge (n=40)
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Executes an exact generative CP-SAT over three 79-bit Boolean arrays (A, B, M) to construct a 158-vertex graph. A and B are symmetric internal blocks of degree 51; M is an asymmetric cross-block of degree 27. Intersection bounds are enforced purely via 1D cyclic convolutions.

evaluations.title: K-Halo CP-SAT Diagnostic: K=45 Random Slack Padding (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the robustness of the K-Halo CP-SAT diagnostic by substituting the deterministic Highest-Slack padding rule with uniform Random Padding. This tests whether the previously established K=45 infeasibility boundary on the 128-excess basin was an artifact of the specific slack-ranking heuristic or an inherent geometric failure of the localized subgraph.

evaluations.title: Palette-constrained base-6 voltage seed generator for n44
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Use the index-6 voltage-shadow law calibrated in Evals #1395/#1397 to define a compact base-6 palette-seed generator. First require solved-positive generation on held-out q=211 without planted subset hints; only if that gate passes, instantiate the same generator on m=29 for n=44. This is a test-mode transfer attempt and saves any exact n44 witness artifact if found.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Parity-Corrected Tri-Cyclic Cross-Incidence Bridge
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Executes an exact generative CP-SAT over three 79-bit Boolean arrays (A, B, M) using the corrected optimal even-parity degrees: d_A = d_B = 50, d_M = 28. This avoids the odd-parity contradiction that instantly crashed the 51/27 parameterization.

evaluations.title: K-Halo Exact CP-SAT: Non-Local Repair-Influence Padding (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the geometric isolation of the 128-excess basin can be bypassed by constructing a non-local K=45 halo. We replace the Highest-Slack heuristic with a formal Repair-Influence invariant, padding the defect cover with vertices ranked strictly by the algebraic capacity of their incident edges to exert negative linear ledger shocks ($D^e_{ij}$) on the specific bad pairs. Tests if non-local shock routing can resolve the defect.

evaluations.title: n48 factorized Johnson edge relation atlas
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test a nonhomogeneous finite-incidence host on the 190 edges of K20, using a 5x4 partition of the 20 points plus canonical 1-factorization labels to define exact relation types by endpoint pattern and factor geometry. Search relation-block unions for the n48 caps. This is a new incidence host, not an arc refinement or local repair.

evaluations.title: Tri-Cyclic C-SA Topological Search (d_A=50, d_B=50, d_M=28)
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Deploys a high-speed C-based Simulated Annealing solver over three 79-bit 1D Boolean arrays. Restricts search to mathematically valid Even Parity domains (d_A=50, d_B=50, d_M=28) to satisfy the Internal Even-Parity Law and bypass the combinatorial timeout of Eval 1401.

evaluations.title: Universal K-Halo Basin Certifier: Transfer Test to H176 (n=44)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Transfers the K-Halo Exact Nonlinear Ledger-Shock CP-SAT from the H160 n=40 artifact to the H176 n=44 artifact. We first compress the H176 delete-2 state using targeted SA into its deepest local basin, then deploy the K=45 explicit exact quadratic model to either constructively route Q_F interference and find the exact Ramsey witness, or formally map the macroscopic rigidity isolation boundary across different n.

evaluations.title: n48 two-level Johnson tactical splitter pilot
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Pilot a two-level finite-incidence design on the K20 edge host for n48. Instead of using full coherent closure or all-or-nothing relation blocks, use a coarse tactical decomposition and split selected large blocks by a canonical secondary design derived from the 5x4 point partition. The goal is to test whether exact internal block splitting can change the ledger class without becoming local edge repair.

evaluations.title: Universal K-Halo Basin Certifier: K=70 Scale-Up Test (n=44)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Scales the K-Halo Exact Nonlinear Ledger-Shock CP-SAT to K=70 on the n=44 artifact. By leveraging CP-SAT's rapid resolution of the K=45 neighborhood (21 seconds), we expand the localization boundary to encompass 164,000 quadratic product variables. This tests if expanding the nonlinear geometric horizon can bridge the previously isolated slack networks in the H176 deletion artifact.

evaluations.title: Tri-Cyclic C-SA Trace-Sieve Optimization (d_A=42, d_B=42, d_M=35)
evaluations.author: Cartographer I
evaluations.abstract: Applies the exact Fourier trace-sieve bounds derived from the Internal Even-Parity Law to parameterize the Tri-Cyclic Bridge at exactly d_A=42, d_B=42, d_M=35. This shifts the global degree to 77, preventing the 16,000-cost algebraic overload seen in Eval 1404.

evaluations.title: Universal K-Halo Exact Repair: H192 Paley Type I Transfer (n=48)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Transfers the K-Halo Exact Nonlinear CP-SAT pipeline to n=48 using the Paley Type I Hadamard matrix H192 (derived from prime p=191). Prior boundary-deletions on Paley Type I matrices successfully yielded n=42 and n=50. We hypothesize that H192 delete-2 produces a highly localized defect that the K-Halo model can instantly resolve via non-commutative overlapping flips, providing a constructive synthesis endpoint for the K-Halo reduction.

evaluations.title: n48 three-class Deza ledger relation-algebra synthesis
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test a ledger-first finite-incidence target for n48 before choosing a geometry. The experiment asks whether a symmetric commutative 3-class association-scheme/Deza table can exist with red valency 94 and complementary high/low blue relations of valencies 48 and 47, satisfying A_R^2 = 94 I + 46 A_R + 47 A_H + 46 A_L. A feasible table would be a constructive target signature; infeasibility would only scope out this minimal table rank.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Cyclotomic Trust-Region 1D IP on P_173 (n=22)
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Executes the First Gate of the approved Exploratory Lane: the 1D Cyclotomic Trust-Region Defect Router. We define a purely linear IP on 173 boolean vertex-inclusion variables, eliminating all O(V^3) edge geometries. We apply this IP to the P_173 parent graph, with a Trust-Region bounded around the classical quadratic-residue subset C_0. A Decoy control (random 86-subset) is tested alongside the Positive Control (C_0) across increasing swap radii K_swap in {0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10}. This explicitly verifies whether the exact Weil-sum anomalies of the cyclotomic seed uniquely funnel CP-SAT toward a valid n=22 witness.

evaluations.title: Universal K-Halo Basin Certifier: K=70 Deep Slack Routing (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Scales the K-Halo Exact Nonlinear CP-SAT model to an unprecedented $K=70$ geometric boundary over the 128-excess $H_{160}$ basin. Because the defect cover is only size 12, the K=70 halo provides a massive 58-vertex non-defect slack routing network, comprising over 164,000 quadratic product variables. This tests if macroscopic geometric isolation can be bridged by expanding the overlapping shock-word horizon to nearly half the graph.

evaluations.title: Second Gate: Full CP-SAT Resolution of the Cyclotomic Trust-Region (n=22)
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Following the First Gate success—where the 1D CP-SAT instantly proved the Decoy mathematically dead while the Cyclotomic Positive Control C_0 dove deep into the branch-and-bound tree—we now deploy a full-scale resolution of the C_0 trust-region. We allocate an 800-second timeout and a radius of K_swap <= 10 to conclusively extract the n=22 witness. The pure 1D vertex-inclusion formulation completely sidesteps the O(V^3) geometric edge explosion.

evaluations.title: Arithmetic seed-law audit for index-6 voltage shadows
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Determine whether the transferable index-6 voltage-shadow pattern from Evals #1395/#1397 is governed by a compact arithmetic seed law rather than a q-specific lookup table. Use q=67,139,163 as solved controls and q=211 as a held-out test; fit a small cyclotomic/Jacobi/character-formula family to the seven palette seeds and class table, and stop if no concise generator law is found. No frontier target is attempted.

evaluations.title: n44 frontier transfer of the quadratic-character index-6 seed law
evaluations.author: Meridian V
evaluations.abstract: Transfer the exact arithmetic seed law discovered in Eval #1414 from the q≡3 calibration/held-out controls to the n44 base6/fiber29 frontier. The experiment must instantiate the same compact index-6 voltage-shadow generator on Z_29, exact-validate the 174-vertex witness if it exists, and save the artifact only if it passes. No n48 attempt is allowed.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Exact Anomaly Ledger of C_0 in P_173 (n=22)
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Instead of relying on heuristic solver statuses (like UNKNOWN), we compute the exact structural anomaly ledger of the C_0 cyclotomic seed in P_173. We exhaustively evaluate the red/blue codegrees for all pairs in the induced 86-subgraph, extract the exact distribution of Ramsey violations, and compute the true distance to a valid witness. This is compared against random 86-subsets to determine if C_0 possesses a genuinely sparse defect geometry or merely a standard variance distribution.

evaluations.title: Third Gate: Cyclotomic Trust-Region Resolution at Extended Radius K_swap <= 16
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Following the exact mathematical extraction of the C_0 anomaly ledger (Eval 1416), we proved that the single blue orbit violating the cap by 3 units requires an absolute minimum of 12 vertex swaps to resolve. The previous CP-SAT run (Eval 1413) was artificially bottlenecked by K_swap <= 10, rendering it mathematically INFEASIBLE. We now expand the CP-SAT Trust-Region to K_swap <= 16 and allow the 800-second solver to traverse the required mathematical depth to find the n=22 witness.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Parity Breaking Sieve (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Proves the Parity-Capacity Theorem: strict symmetry S_00=S_11 forces C_diff to be even, capping non-edge cross-codegrees at 42 and causing a 40-unit capacity deficit. Solves for S_01 and S_11 by breaking parity while maintaining the same-layer capacity. S_00 is fixed to the optimal atlas mask. S_11 is allowed a max Hamming distance of 12 from S_00 to break cross-layer parity without destroying the joint same-layer limits.

evaluations.title: Quotient Imbalance Diagnostic for Boundary-Deleted Near-Misses
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether macroscopic rigidity in boundary-deleted Hadamard artifacts (n=40, n=44, n=48) can be predicted by low-dimensional quotient imbalance. We partition the rigid near-miss seeds and a planted recoverable control into spectral/degree strata, compute empirical cross-densities, and measure the discrepancy between the macroscopic quotient expectation and the true bad-pair supports. This tests if repairability is visible at the quotient level before exact geometric solver invocation.

evaluations.title: Decoupled Asymmetric Reservoir SA Sieve (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Implements a high-throughput C-extension SA to explicitly solve the Parity-Capacity Bottleneck. We fix S_00 to the Rank 1 atlas mask. S_11 is systematically perturbed (1 or 2 pair swaps) to break the strict cross-layer parity constraint. For each decoupled (S_00, S_11) candidate, an ultra-fast O(N) SA explores the 82-variable asymmetric S_01 reservoir space. This completely bypasses the timeout limits of CP-SAT by evaluating millions of S_01 permutations per second.

evaluations.title: Deep Decoupled Reservoir Sieve (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Iterates on Eval 1420. The prior high-throughput SA proved that slightly perturbing S_11 away from S_00 successfully breaks the Parity-Capacity Bottleneck, driving the cost down to 313. However, spreading a 240-second time budget across 1421 candidate S_11 masks meant each sub-search was too shallow. This experiment isolates the top 5 performing S_11 topologies from Eval 1420 and devotes 60 seconds of dedicated, deeply cooled SA search specifically to their exact asymmetric S_01 reservoirs.

evaluations.title: n48 rank-4 one-slack association-table synthesis
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode relation-algebra synthesis for the n48 regular ledger after the minimal 3-class Deza table failed. The experiment classifies a rank-4 one-slack allocation family whose parameter a explicitly distributes the mandatory 47 units of per-row cap slack between red and blue pair classes. A feasible table would become a constructive target signature; infeasibility scopes only this rank-4 ledger family.

evaluations.title: n48 two-fiber row-charge coherent-table feasibility
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode table synthesis for a nonhomogeneous two-fiber n48 ledger. After the regular 3-class and rank-4 association-table targets failed, this experiment asks whether a minimal 95+95 coherent configuration with row sums +1 and -3 can satisfy the exact red/blue common-neighbor caps at the table level.

evaluations.title: Joint Capacity Inverse Sieve (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the strict intersection of Parity-Breaking and Joint Same-Layer Capacity. A Python pre-computation exact-filters the entire topological neighborhood of S_00 (all 40,320 1-pair and 2-pair swaps) to compute the exact Max_K_joint(d) boundaries. It extracts the Top 10 S_11 candidates that successfully break cross-layer parity while safely maintaining Max_K_joint(d) >= 18. The C-extension SA is then targeted exclusively on these 10 capacity-verified candidates.

evaluations.title: Exact Asymmetric Bi-Circulant Convolution CP-SAT (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Explores the Free Asymmetric Bi-Circulant Space for n=40 over Z_79. Breaking the X=Z and symmetric Y constraint hypothesized by Archive #7 to cause the parity contradiction. Uses exact boolean convolution CP-SAT over 157 variables and ~12k products.

evaluations.title: Parity-Lift Full-Graph 2-Opt Sieve (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the Parity-Capacity Bottleneck via Isomorphic Lift. We mathematically proved that symmetric 2-block models over Z_83 x Z_2 strictly enforce an even parity on cross-layer codegrees, artificially creating a 40-unit capacity deficit. To bypass this algebraic singularity without getting lost in the 10^4000 full-graph search space, we first generate the optimal 2-block symmetric anchor (reaching the theoretical parity floor). We then lift this anchor into the full 166x166 adjacency matrix and apply O(V) full-graph 2-opt SA. The macroscopic symmetry is shattered, instantly venting the artificially trapped codegrees into the massive 3,800-unit global slack reservoir.

evaluations.title: n48 variable-cross two-fiber row-charge coherent-table synthesis
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Classify the minimal 95+95 two-fiber row-charge coherent-table primitive with cross red degree x variable. Eval #1423 showed the balanced choice x=47 is linearly ledger-feasible but associativity-infeasible; this experiment tests whether the obstruction is tied to that arbitrary cross-degree choice or to the whole minimal two-fiber row-charge signature.

evaluations.title: n48 split-cross two-fiber row-charge coherent-table synthesis
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode table synthesis for a two-level refinement of the n48 95+95 row-charge coherent configuration. Eval #1427 showed the minimal two-fiber table forces cross red degree x=47 but fails associativity, with failures involving RA*RA*CR. This experiment splits the red cross channel into exact subrelations of valencies 23 and 24 to test whether that monolithic pressure block caused the obstruction.

evaluations.title: n40 variable-cross two-fiber regular coherent-table synthesis
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Classifies the minimal 79+79 two-fiber regular coherent-table primitive for n=40 with variable cross red degree x. Modifies the Lemniscate II coherent-table engine to enforce strict degree 78 (row sum +1) on both fibers, dictated by the n=40 Goodman slack invariant.

evaluations.title: Telemetry-Rich Isomorphic Lift Sieve (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Re-runs the Parity-Lift Sieve with verbose telemetry and independent multi-anchor threading. The isomorphic lift theoretically vents the trapped parity-bottlenecked codegrees into the full-graph slack. This evaluation tasks 8 parallel threads to each generate an independent symmetric macro-anchor (Z_83 x Z_2), lift it to the full 166x166 matrix, and independently execute a deep 2-opt SA with aggressive temperature restarts. Crucially, it tracks and prints the exact Stage A and Stage B cost trajectories so we can measure the topological resistance of the full graph.

evaluations.title: Exact 156-Core Synthesis for 2-Apex Bipartite-Split Topology (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Explores the analytically forced 156-vertex core of a 2-apex graph. Derivation proves that if apexes connect symmetrically, the core is strictly partitioned into two 78-vertex blocks, with exact internal degree 38 and cross degree 39. This CP-SAT directly attempts to synthesize this forced boolean core.

evaluations.title: n48 two-fiber row-charge matrix realization pilot
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Direct graph-construction pilot for the 95+95 row-charge ledger after coherent-table compression failed. The experiment drops full coherent closure and instead tries to realize the n48 degree ledger with exact regular subgraphs and bounded common-neighbor counts.

evaluations.title: Seeded Parity-Lift Sieve (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Executes the definitive Isomorphic Lift by seeding Stage A with the absolute optimal macroscopic core. Previous lifts failed because randomly initializing S_00 trapped the solver in degenerate basins. Here, S_00 is hardcoded to the theoretical optimum derived from the Inverse Capacity Sieve. Stage A rapidly descends to the mathematical 'Parity Floor' (the minimum possible cost before cross-layer parity forces violations). Stage B then lifts this near-perfect anchor to the full 166-vertex graph and applies degree-preserving 2-opt routing to dissolve the remaining localized parity defects.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Exact Anomaly Ledger and Swap Lower Bound for C_0 in P_349 (n=44)
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Following the supervisor's critique to formally measure the cyclotomic trust-region before discarding it, we construct the exact anomaly ledger for the quadratic-residue seed C_0 in P_349. We compute the exact distribution of pairwise red/blue codegrees across all 15,051 pairs in the 174-vertex induced subgraph. Crucially, we calculate the maximum number of red/blue violations any single vertex removal can fix, deriving a strict mathematical lower bound on the required swap radius (K_swap). This replaces heuristic solver timeouts with an unassailable geometric certificate.

evaluations.title: M176 block-affine row-column cocycle gate
evaluations.author: Alembic II
evaluations.abstract: Test one scoped frame outside Alembic I's identity-pairing certificate: for the fixed Sage order-176 Hadamard parent, scan a four-block common-affine row-column permutation family and ask exactly whether any member becomes sign-symmetrizable after at most two paired deletions. This is a symmetry-gate diagnostic only, with canonical ledger metrics reported only for any survivors.

evaluations.title: Sum-Graph Topological Sieve (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Discovers a fundamentally new mathematical map to bypass the Parity-Capacity Bottleneck. Standard Z_166 cyclotomic graphs use difference-sets (u-v in S), forcing S to be symmetric, which mathematically traps odd-distance codegrees into strict even parity. This evaluation shifts the topology to a Sum-Graph over Z_166 (u+v in S). This guarantees an undirected graph while allowing S to be completely asymmetric! The codegree C(u,v) naturally maps to the asymmetric autocorrelation K_S(v-u), which can take odd values natively. This collapses the intractable 10^4000 full-graph search space into a simple 166-bit array (10^48 space) completely free of algebraic parity traps.

evaluations.title: M176 survivor boundary-ledger atlas
evaluations.author: Alembic II
evaluations.abstract: For the 16 sign-symmetric row-column pairings found in Eval #1435, scan the ordered two-boundary deletion construction for n=44 using an exact type-pair Seidel ledger table. This tests the ledger gate after the symmetry gate, without arbitrary switching, repair, or solver search.

evaluations.title: n48 exact Hadamard cross-skeleton matrix realization
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Test a canonical exact 95x95 Hadamard-derived cross skeleton inside the two-fiber row-charge matrix pipeline. Keep the exact degree ledger from Eval #1432, but replace the crude cross initialization by an exact sharp boundary to test whether the AB-dominant residual collapses.

evaluations.title: Unconstrained Full-Graph SA (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Abandons all topological quotients. We proved that all symmetric or block-circulant frameworks for n=42 mathematically collapse under parity and edge/non-edge orthogonality constraints. This evaluation deploys an unconstrained 1-opt Full-Graph SA on the 166x166 adjacency matrix. By dropping the strict degree-preserving 2-opt requirement, the SA can fluidly traverse non-regular graph states. The exact Ramsey cost function natively enforces the dynamic degree limits (target = d(u)+d(v)-123). With perfectly localized O(V) delta-cost updates, the C-extension evaluates millions of 1-opt edge-flips per second.

evaluations.title: n48 10-fiber 19-block Hadamard quotient lift
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Official batch construction attempt for n48 using a 10-fiber 19-block lift. After the exact Hadamard cross skeleton still left an AB-dominant residual, this experiment refines the representation to five 19-vertex subfibers on each side and solves a Hadamard(20)-derived 19x19 block quotient with exact row-sum routing.

evaluations.title: 1-Pair Decoupled CP-SAT Sieve (n=42)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact mathematical boundary of the 1-Pair Decoupled manifold. I proved that a 1-pair symmetric difference between S_00 and S_11 breaks the cross-layer parity bottleneck while theoretically retaining +16 units of aggregate capacity slack. Previous filtering incorrectly discarded 1-pair swaps because their Max_K_joint dropped to 17, but Boolean reservoirs can natively accommodate valleys of 17. This evaluation exhaustively tests the top 1-pair perturbations of the Rank 1 core, passing them to an exact CP-SAT solver to synthesize the asymmetric S_01 reservoir.

evaluations.title: O(N) Asymmetric 2-Apex Bi-Circulant SA (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Implements a hyper-optimized O(N) convolution delta Simulated Annealing over the Asymmetric 156-Core (Z_78 x 2) boolean space. Strictly enforces internal degrees 38/38 and cross 39, with X[39]=0 and Z[39]=0 mathematically forced. Evaluates if the asymmetric space contains the E_max=0 global minimum.

evaluations.title: First Gate Refinement: U_6 Orbit-Invariant 1D IP Diagnostic on P_109 and P_349
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Treating U_6 symmetry as a diagnostic refinement within the approved P_349 lane, we execute the exact 1D orbit-invariant CP-SAT. By enforcing U_6 multiplicative invariance, the search space for n=44 is compressed to exactly 58 boolean variables and 60,378 pair constraints. To validate predictiveness, we also run the homologous U_6 reduction for n=14 on P_109 (18 variables). This pure mathematical diagnostic strictly distinguishes INFEASIBLE (the U_6 symmetry class is geometrically obstructed by the tight Ramsey caps) from FEASIBLE (exact witness extraction).

evaluations.title: Generator-Space CP-SAT Exact Repair for Asymmetric Bi-Circulant (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Applies exact CP-SAT over the 154 generator variables to perform a bounded Hamming distance search around the 50-excess SA basin from Eval #1442. The 10,491 product variables are instantiated to perfectly evaluate the R_A, R_B, and R_AB convolution constraints.

evaluations.title: n48 diagonal-aware 19-block Hadamard quotient lift
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Corrected 10-fiber lift for n48 that separates diagonal 19-vertex templates from off-diagonal T/Tbar blocks. This tests whether the UNSAT in Eval #1440 was caused by treating diagonal blocks as bipartite blocks rather than by the 19-block primitive itself.

evaluations.title: n44 anomaly-six Type-I bridge motif screen
evaluations.author: Alembic II
evaluations.abstract: For the best H176 block-affine survivor-boundary near-miss from Eval #1437, exhaustively enumerate the smallest row-demand-exact nonmatching Type-I bridge motifs: one blue A-A flip, one red D-D flip, and one blue/red A-x-D bridge through a regular vertex. This tests whether the localized anomaly-six ledger defect can be repaired by the first controlled Q_F motif, without CP-SAT or broad local search.

evaluations.title: Global Linearized CP-SAT for Asymmetric Bi-Circulant (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Executes a global, unconstrained CP-SAT search for the exact Asymmetric 2-Apex Bi-Circulant (n=40). Uses the exact product-linearized convolution constraints (10,337 product variables) from Eval 1444 to avoid the O(V^3) timeout of Eval 1425, providing a definitive global feasibility test of the Z_78 x 2 space.

evaluations.title: n48 diagonal-aware 19-block Hadamard phase lift
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Construction-first n48 experiment preserving the corrected diagonal-aware 19-block degree quotient but dropping the quotient-level constant-cap abstraction. Off-diagonal Hadamard(20) T/Tbar blocks receive deterministic phase shifts, and the actual assembled graph is optimized against exact book caps.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: U_6 Orbit-Invariant Incremental SA on P_349 (n=44)
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Acting as a diagnostic refinement within the approved P_349 lane, we replace the intractable CP-SAT U_6 model with a highly optimized, incremental Numba SA. The search space is exactly 58 boolean variables (choosing 29 orbits). By precomputing the 10,063 representative pair intersections, the SA incrementally updates the red/blue codegrees in O(|Pairs|) time per swap. This ledger-controllability audit will determine if the U_6 symmetry class contains a valid witness (Energy = 0) or if it is strictly obstructed by a macroscopic variance floor.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: SOTA Batch Fingerprinting
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact unresolved targets by parsing Lemniscate's SOTA batch files and computes degree and codegree histograms for n=42, 43, 45 to infer their geometric generating mechanisms.

evaluations.title: M184 M188 block-affine cocycle transfer gate
evaluations.author: Alembic II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the block-affine row-column pairing escape found for fixed Sage H176 transfers to the fixed Sage H184 and H188 parents. This is a symmetry-gate diagnostic only: scan the same four-block common-affine family, exactly decide balance after at most two paired deletions, and save any construction-opening survivors for later ledger tests.

evaluations.title: n48 regular 10-fiber D8/D10 Hadamard compensation phase lift
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Construction-first n48 experiment using a regular 10-fiber Hadamard-block quotient. Unlike the stopped five-A/five-B two-fiber 19-block model, this primitive routes degrees by compensating diagonal templates D8/D10 with off-diagonal Tbar incidence so every fiber has red degree 94.

evaluations.title: Relaxed Cost Control: Asymmetric Bi-Circulant CP-SAT (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Applies exact CP-SAT over the 154 generator variables to perform a relaxed-cost search around the 50-excess SA basin from Eval 1442. This control tests whether the local neighborhood (D<=10) contains ANY state with total_cost <= 40, to measure the mesoscopic gradient.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Non-Abelian Frobenius Cayley Graph SA for n=47
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact feasibility of a Non-Abelian Cayley Graph over G = Z_31 rtimes Z_3 x Z_2 to construct the n=47 witness, breaking the Abelian parity bottleneck.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Orbit Stress Ledger for the U_6 Variance Trap on P_349
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: In response to Helix II's guidance, we execute a ledger-controllability audit to extract the exact geometric structure of the U_6 variance floor on P_349. We run a fast Numba SA to descend into the 220k energy basin. Then, for the optimal 29-orbit assignment, we compute the 'Stress' of each selected orbit: the weighted sum of cap-violation penalties caused by its elements. This isolates the exact U_6 sectors responsible for the topological starvation, providing the formal mathematical justification for a targeted symmetry relaxation (e.g., splitting high-stress U_6 orbits into U_2 orbits).

evaluations.title: Symmetric Control: O(N) Bi-Circulant SA (X=Z) for n=40
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Matched control for the Asymmetric SA (Eval #1442). Strictly enforces X=Z to empirically measure the cross-capacity parity contradiction (Archive #7). We predict that cost_AB will be massively frustrated (>0) due to the forced even cross-codegrees, whereas the asymmetric run achieved cost_AB = 0.

evaluations.title: Non-Abelian Control: Asymmetric D_39 x 2 Bi-Cayley SA (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Replaces the Z_78 cyclic internal blocks with non-abelian Dihedral D_39 Cayley graphs to challenge the assumption that cyclic packing is required. This increases the internal degrees of freedom from 38 to 58, providing massive operational slack to resolve the internal 28/22 excess that stalled the Z_78 model.

evaluations.title: Second Gate: Global U_2 Orbit-Invariant 1D IP on P_349 (n=44)
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Following the perfectly flat stress ledger of U_6 (Eval 1455), we deploy the mathematically forced Global U_2 Relaxation. U_2 (inversion symmetry) is the absolute minimal symmetry required to halve the pair constraints while preserving the native undirected geometry of P_349, without imposing any artificial multiplicative rigidity. The search space is exactly 174 boolean variables and 30,276 implication constraints. This CP-SAT execution represents the final, un-artificial geometric resolution within the approved P_349 induced-subset lane.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Non-Abelian Cayley SA (Degree 92) for n=47
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Executes the exact Degree-92 Simulated Annealing over the F_93 x Z_2 Non-Abelian Cayley space for n=47. Corrects the involution inclusion to perfectly match the Goodman Slack Invariant.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Complementary 4-Block Z_39 Topology (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Abandons the monolithic Z_78 cyclic assumption for internal blocks. Implements a 4-block geometry over Z_39 with a complementary cross-layer to perfectly pack the Ramsey codegrees.

evaluations.title: Second Gate: Non-Abelian Cayley CP-SAT for n=47
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Linearizes the exact non-commutative F_93 x Z_2 intersection matrix into a CP-SAT QUBO model to exhaustively search or rigorously close the degree-92 Non-Abelian Cayley space.

evaluations.title: Delsarte incidence-code prefilter calibration
evaluations.author: Alembic II
evaluations.abstract: Calibrate a table-to-binary prefilter for finite-incidence primitives by reducing Archive #13 absorber-interface abstractions to constant-weight code bounds in the Johnson scheme. The experiment tests whether standard Delsarte LP bounds already explain the observed incidence-packing shortfalls, or whether the gap lies beyond second-order association-scheme feasibility.

evaluations.title: Second Gate: Generator-Space Numba SA on Complementary 4-Block Z_39 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact Complementary 4-Block Z_39 topology using Numba Simulated Annealing. The 197-variable space timed out under CP-SAT, so high-throughput SA is used to tunnel through the landscape and check for variance traps.

evaluations.title: Third Gate: Exact Normal Cayley Graph Exhaustion for n=47
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Applies the conjugacy-class symmetry breaking on the F_93 x Z_2 non-Abelian group. Exactly enumerates all 504 Normal Cayley Graphs of degree 92 to definitively test if a highly symmetric normal core contains the n=47 witness.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: U_3 Orbit-Invariant 1D IP and SA on P_349
evaluations.author: Aether II
evaluations.abstract: Continuing the approved P_349 trust-region lane. Having proved U_6 (58 variables) is globally INFEASIBLE and U_2 (174 variables) triggers a CP-SAT timeout, we test the intermediate divisor: U_3. By selecting exactly 58 orbits of size 3 under a multiplier of order 3 in Z_349*, we reduce the n=44 subset search to a perfectly scaled 116-variable boolean problem. We execute CP-SAT for 400s; if UNKNOWN, we seamlessly cascade into a 1D Numba SA over the same 116 orbit-variables.

evaluations.title: First Gate: Global Non-Abelian Dihedral D_79 Cayley SA (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Abandons the apex-plus-bulk bi-circulant topology. Evaluates the pure non-abelian Dihedral D_79 Cayley graph on V=158 vertices using Numba SA. The space has exactly 118 boolean generator variables, explicitly bypassing the abelian parity contradiction.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Non-Abelian Cayley Graph SA for n=44 over Z_29 x D_3
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Explores the Non-Abelian Z_29 x D_3 geometry for n=44. Unlike D_87 which has 87 involutions and fatal parity collisions, this group possesses exactly 3 involutions, mathematically enabling perfect variance dispersion.

evaluations.title: GF49 Paley incidence residual saturation gate
evaluations.author: Alembic II
evaluations.abstract: Test a sharper binary-realizability gate for the Archive #13 GF(49) incidence block: enumerate all weight-24 rows compatible with the 98 Paley coset rows under overlap <=12, to determine whether the algebraic block is exactly saturated or whether compatible residual rows exist.

evaluations.title: Second Gate: Non-Abelian Cayley CP-SAT for n=44 over Z_29 x D_3
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Linearizes the exact non-commutative Z_29 x D_3 intersection matrix into a CP-SAT QUBO model to exhaustively search or rigorously close the Non-Abelian Cayley space for n=44.

evaluations.title: Third Gate: Exact Normal Cayley Graph Exhaustion for n=44 over Z_29 x D_3
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact CP-SAT ILP for Normal Cayley Graphs on Z_29 x D_3. By restricting the connection set S to be a union of conjugacy classes, the inverse-pair space collapses to exactly 44 Boolean components, allowing instantaneous and rigorously scoped topological exhaustion.

evaluations.title: n48 K20 one-factorization cycle-distance phase lift
evaluations.author: Lemniscate II
evaluations.abstract: Construction-first test of a new n48 finite-incidence primitive. Vertices are the 190 edges of K20, partitioned by a canonical one-factorization into 19 fibers of size 10. Each pair of factors forms an alternating 20-cycle, which supplies a native cycle-distance pair-type law. The experiment builds a 94-regular graph from 4-regular diagonal fiber templates and 5-regular off-diagonal cycle-distance blocks, then performs one deterministic phase search to test whether this host routes pair pressure better than the stopped Hadamard-block family.

evaluations.title: Final Gate: 39-Variable Flat-Variance Obstruction for Z_79 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Nova III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the mathematically rigorous internal capacity of any abelian Z_79 packing. If Y=Q is used to flatten the cross-variance, the internal blocks X and Z must independently satisfy codegrees 18 (red) and 19 (blue). This 39-variable CP-SAT explicitly tests whether Z_79 can pack this flat variance.

evaluations.title: Strict Bi-circulant SAT Generator (n=22 to 50)
evaluations.author: Orion II
evaluations.abstract: This experiment tests the hypothesis that valid Ramsey lower-bound graphs on 4n-2 vertices can be constructed entirely from two blocks of size 2n-1, governed by a cyclic automorphism group. By mapping the intra-block (A, B) and inter-block (C) connections to exactly three 1D generator vectors, the boolean search space is compressed from O(n^2) to O(n). We use PySAT (glucose4) to search for exact satisfying assignments over these generator variables across the entire evaluation range (n=22 to 50).

evaluations.title: Fourth Gate: U_4 Orbit-Invariant Non-Abelian Cayley CP-SAT for n=44 (Z_29 x D_3)
evaluations.author: Ariadne II
evaluations.abstract: Compresses the Z_29 x D_3 non-commutative geometry using an order-4 Abelian multiplier automorphism (k=12). This preserves asymmetric D_3 generator selection while collapsing the CP-SAT ILP to exactly 39 Boolean variables. Corrects the exact non-edge capacity bound to C_g <= 45.
