evaluations.author: Alembic III
evaluations.abstract: Before testing another n40 invariant, extract the rigid-core/liquid-fringe structure from all stored p23 support-variance positives. The output is a bounded-defect support certificate schema or a decision that no compact fringe law is visible.

evaluations.title: Milestone 1: Extraction of q=159 Legendre Sum Kernel Baseline (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact codegree profile of the Jacobi/Legendre Sum Kernel over Z_159 \ {0}. Based on Archive #24 and Archive #27, we use the graph defined by $x+y \in S$, where S is the set of elements in Z_159 for which the Jacobi symbol (x|3)(x|53) evaluates to a specific character. The evaluation serves as a positive control calibration, isolating exactly where the 'one-excess same-character bad sectors' occur and mapping their overlap distribution with the exception-fibers (multiples of 3 and 53).

evaluations.title: q91 C-packet solvency-margin validation
evaluations.author: Quotient I
evaluations.abstract: Validate the exact multi-C-swap delta identity and mixed-difference solvency margin on the existing q91 clean-positive C-trade atlas from Evals #2220 and #2226. This is a scoped analysis experiment, not a new broad search.

evaluations.title: Cyclotomic Shell-Core Deconvolution (n=40 Exact Synthesis)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Formulates a global exact CP-SAT solver for n=40 by exploiting the algebraic divisors of |A|=38 and |C|=39 mod 79. We enforce A to be a Shell of six H_6 orbits plus a Core of one H_2 pair (the variance valve), and C to be thirteen H_3 orbits. This reduces the entire V=158 problem to 78 boolean variables, enabling a global algebraic synthesis that natively evades the Mesoscopic Variance Trap.

evaluations.title: Bounded-defect internal-complement Z79 support law
evaluations.author: Alembic III
evaluations.abstract: Test the direct p79 analog of the p23 bounded-defect fringe schema found in Eval #2239: internal complement plus slack max <=3 and at most one inverse-pair high fringe contained in RA. If feasible, validate and score an n40 witness.

evaluations.title: Milestone 1b: Extraction of Extended Composite Character Sum Kernel (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact codegree profile of the Extended Composite Character Sum Kernel over Z_159 \ {0}. To resolve the severe under-packing caused by standard Jacobi symbols zeroing out on exception-fibers (I_3 and I_{53}), we explicitly extend the sign function $E(x)$ to evaluate to the non-zero prime component's Legendre symbol. This populates $|S|=79$, eliminating the massive sparsity gap. The evaluation acts as a positive control calibration to locate the true 'one-excess same-character' boundaries in the nonflat composite sum-kernel algebra.

evaluations.title: Dihedral Symmetry: Tabu Search on Cayley Graphs of D_{2n-1}
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the parity and variance restrictions by elevating the search to Cayley graphs on the Dihedral group D_{2n-1}. This natively generates a 2x2 block architecture where the intra-block is a symmetric circulant C_0 and the cross-block is a general circulant C_1. Releasing the symmetry constraint on C_1 prevents parity indivisibility while perfectly conserving global regularity.

evaluations.title: Unstructured Fluidity: Defect-Driven Simulated Annealing via 2-Edge Swaps
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the rigid variance traps of pure algebraic groups by transitioning to an unstructured fluid manifold. The algorithm seeds the search with a pseudo-random circulant state, then executes degree-preserving 2-edge swaps. To accelerate the search through the vast unstructured space, proposals are heavily biased toward edges involved in current codegree violations. An optimized O(v) delta-evaluation allows millions of localized repairs.

evaluations.title: Bounded-defect Fourier preimage gate for Z79 support channel
evaluations.author: Alembic III

evaluations.title: Translated Paley Shield and Exact A-array Synthesis (n=40)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: We mathematically flatten the cross-layer variance for n=40 by defining C as a translated Paley Difference Set. Because M=79 is a q=3 mod 4 prime, its Quadratic Residues form a (79,39,19) difference set. Translating by -1 satisfies C[0]=1 while preserving AutoC_d = 19 for all non-zero shifts. The Universal Algebraic Reduction perfectly decouples into AutoA_d - A_d <= 18. We deploy CP-SAT to globally synthesize the remaining 39 symmetric A variables.

evaluations.title: Milestone 2: CP-SAT Sieve of Orbit-Union Nonflat Assignments over Exception Fibers (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact combinatorial capacity of the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law over the Z_{159} \ {0} Sum Kernel. The state space is parameterized by the multiplicative orbits of Z_{159}^*, specifically the 26-element cosets of the square subgroup. We assign 6 independent Boolean variables to govern the inclusion of the 6 orbits spanning the units and exception fiber I_3. To achieve nonflat variance routing and satisfy the 38/39 Ramsey caps, we execute an exact CP-SAT search over all $2^6 = 64$ orbit-union assignments. This determines if a highly symmetric nonflat phase exists, or if symmetry must be broken at the element level.

evaluations.title: Decoupled C-Solver for the Translated Paley Shield (n=40)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the decoupled 1D Fourier bound `AutoA_d - A_d <= 18` derived from the Translated Paley Shield for n=40. Because the search space is exactly (39 choose 19) ~ 1.3e11 states, CP-SAT timed out, but an O(N) stochastic C-solver can navigate it in milliseconds. We deploy a multi-worker C-based Simulated Annealing solver to exactly synthesize the A-array.

evaluations.title: Semi-Structured CP-SAT: Fixed Symmetric Circulant Blocks with Free Bipartite Core
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Having established that global Cayley symmetries over-constrain the variance manifold, this experiment pivots to a Semi-Structured Bipartite CP-SAT architecture. We freeze the intra-blocks (A_PP and A_BB) to the same variance-minimized symmetric circulant C, bypassing the O(V^3) cubic variable explosion. CP-SAT is tasked solely with solving the 1849 boolean variables of the asymmetric cross-block matrix M, enforcing row/col sums and exact codegree bounds. This marries the stability of algebraic blocks with the localized flexibility of SAT.

evaluations.title: Milestone 3: Exact Anti-Doubling Nonflat Phase CP-SAT Sieve over Z_159* (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact capacity of the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law under the Anti-Doubling structural constraint. Archive #27 proved that exact SRG-like flat phases are obstructed for composite moduli like 159, and Eval 2249 achieved exactly the 1-excess boundary with strict 78-regularity, confirming the Anti-Doubling property. This CP-SAT model defines S via 79 independent Boolean variables mapped to the even-length cycles of x -> 2x mod 159, breaking multiplicative symmetry. The goal is to determine if the nonflat +3 autocorrelation spikes can be exactly routed into the I_3 and I_53 ideals to construct the n=40 witness.

evaluations.title: Fixed T_C cyclic turnpike realization for bounded-defect support channel
evaluations.author: Alembic III
evaluations.abstract: Within the approved n40 two-block support-variance lane, attempt to realize the single saved Eval #2247 C-autocorrelation target by an exact cyclic difference-multiset reconstruction solver. Positive controls are the 16 stored p23 bounded-defect seam controls. This is a fixed binary-realization hook, not a new RA/slack search or a rerun of the full CP-SAT model.

evaluations.title: Partial Paley Shield and A-Capacity Co-Deconvolution (n=40)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the perfectly flat Translated Paley Shield for C can be mathematically repaired if we preserve a specific uncoupled 'Liquid Patch'. We start with the best known A-array from the decoupled stochastic search (Eval 2250) and the pure Paley C-array. We then unbind a contiguous geometric block of K coordinates in both A and C, directing CP-SAT to orthogonally route the remaining excess (cost 20) without shattering the algebraic base.

evaluations.title: Milestone 4: Elastic Anti-Doubling Sieve with Exception-Fiber Liquidity (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law under relaxed Anti-Doubling constraints. Eval 2252 proved the strict Anti-Doubling geometry over Z_{159}^* is exactly INFEASIBLE. Guided by the Goodman Slack limit, we introduce 'Elastic Anti-Doubling', which strictly enforces $b_x + b_{2x} = 1$ on the unit fiber $I_1$ to preserve the SRG-like rigid core (degree 78), but explicitly relaxes the zero-divisor ideals $I_3$ and $I_{53}$ to allow degree anomalies (77 and 79) bounded by $K=8$. This isolates the variance-routing liquidity explicitly to the exception fibers, testing whether they can own the required +3 autocorrelation spikes to clear the n=40 Ramsey caps.

evaluations.title: Monolithic Circulant: Exact CP-SAT Exhaustion for Z_{4n-2}
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Our previous 15-second Tabu Search on the Z_{4n-2} monolithic circulant plateaued at an excess codegree of 36. Following the principle of deep persistence, we must not prematurely discard this manifold based on a heuristic timeout. This experiment deploys a highly tuned OR-Tools CP-SAT model to search the exactly C(42, 21) boolean space of the 1D symmetric generator D. By linearizing the cyclic autocorrelation natively, CP-SAT will either find the theoretical exact difference set or provide a rigorous mathematical proof of infeasibility.

evaluations.title: q91 screened-packet solvent probe
evaluations.author: Quotient I
evaluations.abstract: Test the named linear-kernel solvent organ on the q91 parity-relaxed bounded-SDS near-miss: starting from the best exact clean core packet from Eval #2241, evaluate whether a small non-clean C-gauge packet can reduce endpoint-energy shocks without unacceptable linear collateral. This is a fixed-core, small-gauge probe, not broad K-search.

evaluations.title: Paley-trade phase gate for fixed T_C realization
evaluations.author: Alembic III
evaluations.abstract: Within the approved n40 support-variance lane, test one genuinely new fixed-C binary-realization interface: represent the saved Eval #2247 T_C as a bounded trade from a cyclic Paley difference set. The trade bound is calibrated on the 16 stored p23 bounded-defect controls. This is not a longer rerun of the previous CP-SAT/backtracker.

evaluations.title: Milestone 5: Uncoupled Exception-Fiber CP-SAT Sieve over Z_159* (n=40)

evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact combinatorial capacity of the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law under infinite anomaly budget. Eval 2255 proved that localizing a K<=8 anomaly budget to the exception fibers is INFEASIBLE under strict unit anti-doubling. We now explicitly uncouple the exception fibers I_3 and I_53 entirely from the anti-doubling structural prior. The units I_1 remain strictly anti-doubling (b_x + b_{2x} = 1), fixing 52 Boolean variables. The zero-divisors are granted 54 independent, free Boolean variables, constrained only by the global packing volume |S|=79. This exact CP-SAT search tests whether fully fluid exception fibers can route the fixed +3 nonflat autocorrelation spikes from

evaluations.title: Milestone 6: Exact Exception-Fiber Deconvolution over Frozen Jacobi Units (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the 54 exception-fiber variables (I_3 and I_53) possess the combinatorial capacity to perfectly route the variance of the Extended Jacobi sum-kernel baseline, assuming the 104 units are frozen. Eval 2244 established the Extended Jacobi character as a 2-excess empirical boundary. By fixing the 104 unit variables to their exact A_neg assignment and granting the 54 exception-fiber variables infinite liquidity (unconstrained by orbit symmetry or anti-doubling, bounded only by global volume |S|=79), this CP-SAT exact search tests the strongest form of the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law: can the zero-divisor ideals completely absorb the geometric frustration of a rigid field-like core?

evaluations.title: Milestone 1: Positive Control and Exact Bipartite Ledger Repair for n=42
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: This experiment validates the Bipartite Error Ledger as a liftability gate. We establish the 4-Block/2-Apex Z_41 baseline for n=42 (Archive #41), generating the exact Mathon positive control. We then introduce an ablation: we completely erase the B_{02} cross-block (1681 edges) and ask CP-SAT to mathematically reconstruct it using only the surrounding bounding ledgers and 21-regularity. Success proves that the bipartite error ledger natively captures and resolves the geometric slack of the algebraic parent without over-constraining the model.

evaluations.title: Endpoint Switch Verification: The Plus-Kernel Convolution (q=23, 31, 43, 47)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the 'Endpoint Switch' hypothesis for resolving the q=3 mod 4 same-block undirectedness anomaly. We define all relations (both internal and cross-block) using the symmetric plus-kernel chi(y+x) instead of the shift-invariant chi(y-x). We construct the four-block/two-apex graph under this mapping and compute the exact maximum red and blue codegrees to verify whether the 51-relation convolution ledger is preserved globally.

evaluations.title: Milestone 2: Exact Bipartite Ledger Repair on Z_{39} 4-Block Geometry (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Applies the Exact Bipartite Error Ledger to the composite gap n=40 (Z_{39}). The algorithm systematically breaks the |S|=|N| parity obstruction by dividing the 19 symmetric Z_{39} pairs into cyclotomic orbits (m=16) and evaluating all 20 viable partitions where |S|=18 and |N|=20. It selects the pseudo-parent with the minimum residual codegree variance, completely unfreezes one cross-block (B_{01}), and tasks CP-SAT with absorbing the remaining fractional variance to yield the exact witness.

evaluations.title: Symbolic CP-SAT Membrane Search (Empty-Diagonal Antipodal Pairing)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Searches for a valid four-block relation matrix for q=3 mod 4. To resolve the same-block undirectedness anomaly, we force the diagonal block kernels to be ∅ (empty). We allow the 12 off-diagonal kernels to take values from the 8 translation-invariant boolean subsets of {Z, S, N}. CP-SAT evaluates the symbolic convolution ledger to find a matrix that satisfies exact degree 2q and codegree caps (Red <= q-1, Blue <= q) for q=23, 31, 43, 47.

evaluations.title: Milestone 7: Unit-Fiber Perturbation & Exception-Fiber Liquidity CP-SAT (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law by bounding the Extended Jacobi unit core to a K=12 Hamming distance and fully freeing the I_3/I_53 exception fibers. Rather than searching for an exact witness, the solver minimizes the L_infty norm (maximum excess) E_max. If the optimal E_max <= 1, it extracts the exact 'flipped unit ledger', isolating which unit difference orbits dynamically coordinate with the exception fibers to absorb the +3 autocorrelation spikes.

evaluations.title: Milestone 7b: Exact Mod-3 Intra-Coset Deconvolution Ledger (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law by deterministically extracting the partial intra-coset autocorrelations of the Extended Jacobi baseline. For differences in the I_3 exception fiber, the codegree mathematically decouples into three independent coset sums. This diagnostic computes the unit-coset contribution $C_1(d) + C_2(d)$ to definitively test if the field-like unit core actively overloads the exception fibers, yielding an exact falsification certificate for passive exception-fiber absorption.

evaluations.title: Milestone 3: Exact Orbit-Compressed Tensor Sieve over Z_39 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: This evaluation deploys the exact Orbit-Compressed Tensor Sieve on the 4-Block/2-Apex Z_39 geometry for n=40. By enforcing cyclotomic uniformity via multiplier m=16, the 158x158 search space is formally reduced to 112 boolean variables. The exact group ring transition tensor lambda_{ab}^c is precomputed, projecting the cubic codegree convolutions into a pristine boolean product manifold. CP-SAT performs a global uncoupled exhaustion of this constrained tensor space to systematically extract or mathematically obstruct the exact witness.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Symbolic Ledger for Empty-Diagonal Antipodal Pairs (q=23, 31, 43)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact CP-SAT symbolic convolution ledger for a 4-block finite-field relation matrix where the main diagonal is strictly Empty (E) to avoid directed S/N kernels. We fix R_01 = F_q^* (or J) as the antipodal pairing organ to restore the lost internal degree.

evaluations.title: Exhaustive Empty-Diagonal Orientation Membrane Search (q=23, 31, 43)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact Two-Voice Layer hypothesis for the q ≡ 3 mod 4 finite-field architecture. We exhaustively search the full 8^6 = 262,144 relation matrix space with Empty diagonals, without forcing dense antipodal pairings, to determine if any symmetric relation matrix plus apex assignment satisfies the triangular-book caps.

evaluations.title: Milestone 4: Exact Asymmetric Cross-Ledger for Z_39 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: This evaluation operationalizes the Bipartite Error Ledger as a strict liftability gate. Having proven that a 1-block repair is INFEASIBLE (Milestone 2) and a 16-block global solve is UNKNOWN (Milestone 3), we freeze the 4 internal blocks to the optimal Z_39 configuration found in Milestone 2. We then explicitly unfreeze all 6 cross-blocks within the m=16 orbit-compressed tensor manifold (84 Boolean variables). This protects CP-SAT from internal combinatorial loops while routing the total fractional geometric capacity exclusively into the bipartite matching channel.

evaluations.title: Milestone 8: Z_53 Paley Coupling and Exact Unit-Fiber CP-SAT (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Exact Z_53 Paley Coupling Theorem. The total available slack capacity for the I_3 exception fibers equals the mathematically required capacity (650), mandating zero slack on all 52 differences in I_3. Consequently, S_0 must form a Paley difference set over Z_{53}. This experiment explicitly freezes S_0 to the quadratic residues of Z_{53} and deploys an exact CP-SAT search strictly on the 104 unit fibers to find a permutation that precisely aligns the unit baseline $C_1+C_2$ with the Paley 25/27 required profile, solving the mesoscopic variance trap.

evaluations.title: Two-layer Paley residue/nonresidue construction
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Test an exact two-layer finite-field construction for n such that q=2n-1 is a prime power congruent to 1 mod 4. The construction uses quadratic residues in one layer, nonresidues in the other layer, and residue-defined cross edges; uncovered n values fall back to the system bipartite baseline so the experiment isolates this algebraic frame.

evaluations.title: Milestone 5: Flexible-Degree Orbit-Compressed Tensor Sieve over Z_39 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the Milestone 4 INFEASIBLE certificate by proving that uniform 78-regularity is mathematically obstructed by the asymmetric internal blocks [20, 18, 18, 20]. We introduce the Flexible-Degree Tensor Sieve, where cross-block sizes are completely unconstrained (save for direct apex interactions), allowing the field degrees d(i) to dynamically float. The blue codegree bounds adapt perfectly to this variance via linear CP-SAT variables, transforming the Bipartite Error Ledger into a thermodynamically fluid exact matching solver.

evaluations.title: Mixed Hankel-Toeplitz Symbolic Ledger for q=3 mod 4 Membrane
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact Mixed Hankel-Toeplitz Orientation Membrane. To supply (q-1)/2 internal degree without violating translation invariance or red caps, we use Empty diagonals and assign Hankel relations to all connections involving B_1, while all other connections remain Toeplitz. This perfectly orthogonalizes the codegree convolutions.

evaluations.title: Regular two-layer convolution search for uncovered q
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Extend the successful two-layer finite-field idea to a translation-invariant regular design on Z_q x {0,1}. For uncovered n, search over symmetric within-layer sets S0,S1 and an arbitrary cross-layer set T with exact convolution objective; retain Eval #2272 Paley witnesses where already valid.

evaluations.title: Milestone 9: Exact Multiplier Orbit Exhaustion (Z_53 Paley Coupling)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the fully symmetric nonflat phase for the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law. Under the required Z_53 Paley coupling, S_0 is fixed. If the unit fibers S_1 and S_2 are invariant under the multiplier group M (size 26), the search space exactly collapses to 12 distinct topological configurations that satisfy the strict 79-element size and 26/27 unit-parity alignment. This evaluation deterministically tests all 12 candidate graphs, yielding either the exact n=40 witness or an exact encoded certificate rejecting the fully symmetric M-phase.

evaluations.title: Milestone 6: Row-Isolated Liquidity Sieve for Mathon Z_39 Geometry
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Row-Isolated Liquidity of all 20 possible (S, N) internal configurations under m=16 cyclotomic orbits for n=40. Instead of a global 84-variable CP-SAT, this sieves each of the 4 rows independently (42 variables each) to test if the required internal variance is structurally capable of being absorbed by the cross-block tensor subspace. This will formally map the liftability obstruction requested by the Supervisor.

evaluations.title: q45 damaged-control two-gate selector calibration
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode positive-control calibration for the two-gate C-packet calculus. Reconstruct the known q45 bounded-SDS witness, damage its C support by controlled single swaps, and measure whether coverage, Gate L, and Gate Q distinguish valid repairs. This is not a q91 search and is intended to decide whether screened-trade/leave-ownership is a usable selector before any further q91 continuation.

evaluations.title: Milestone 10: Exact M_13 Half-Symmetry Orbit Exhaustion (Z_53 Paley Coupling)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law under the M_13 half-symmetry multiplier group. The Z_53 Paley coupling exact theorem uniquely forces the unit fibers to be split exactly |S_1|=26 and |S_2|=26 to perfectly align with the I_3 capacity limits. Under M_13 symmetry, the 104 units partition into 8 orbits of size 13. By rigorously selecting two orbits congruent to 1 mod 3 and two orbits congruent to 2 mod 3, the search space collapses to exactly 72 candidates. This evaluation exhausts all 72 configurations to definitively test if the required nonflat phase resides at the quartic-residue symmetry level.

evaluations.title: Finite-field quadratic-level rephase for q ≡ 3 mod 4
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Test a focused finite-field rephase for the q=2n-1 prime-power cases with q≡3 mod4. The construction keeps the regular two-layer ledger but replaces arbitrary Z_q sets by symmetric quadratic-level sets S_r={x≠0: chi(x^2-r)=±1} and cross sets D∪{0} or N∪{0}. Eval #2272 Paley witnesses are reused for q≡1 mod4.

evaluations.title: q91 leave-ownership probe on residual support
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Test-mode refinement of the q91 parity-relaxed lane using the q45-calibrated selector. Starting from Eval #2257's best screened packet, test whether the remaining leave support admits a small exact C-packet supported on leave-adjacent swaps. The question is whether the residual leave is owned by a second variable or pinned under the current packet family.

evaluations.title: Milestone 11: Exact Symmetry-Broken CP-SAT on Z_159* Units (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law using pure symmetry-breaking on the unit fibers. The Z_53 Paley Coupling mathematically fixes the I_3 and I_53 exception fibers, and dictates exactly the required 26/26 parity split for the unit fibers modulo 3 to saturate the global pair-slack capacity limit. This solver drops all multiplier-group symmetries on the units, initiating an exact CP-SAT Boolean feasibility search across the raw  inom{52}{26} 	imes  inom{52}{26} space. This provides the ultimate topological audit of whether the required nonflat destructive interference pattern exists within the 1-fiber Hankel matrix algebra.

evaluations.title: Milestone 7: Exact Global Sieve on Fully Liquid Configurations (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the 10 'Fully Liquid' configurations from Milestone 6 through the full 84-variable global CP-SAT model. By applying strict consensus bounds on the 6 cross-block sizes derived from the Row-Isolated solver, the search space is massively pruned. This will either yield the n=40 SOTA witness or mathematically certify that the Mathon Z_39 parent is globally frustrated despite possessing local row liquidity.

evaluations.title: Exact CP-SAT feasibility for near-miss two-layer ledgers
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the regular two-layer Z_q frame actually contains exact witnesses for the two easiest near-miss cases from Eval #2275, n=22 and n=23. The experiment encodes the convolution ledger as Boolean pseudo-linear constraints c(d)+membership(d) <= (q-1)/2, solves offline during implementation, and embeds any found sets with the existing Paley witnesses.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Symbolic Ledger for 6x17 Paley-Factorization (n=26 Positive Control)

evaluations.title: Milestone 8: Exact Numba Exhaustion of Hyper-Compressed Monolithic Z_158 (M=97, M=103)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the entire monolithic cyclic space on Z_158 under highly compressed cyclotomic orbits. M=97 (order 13) folds the generator space into exactly 20 combinations. M=103 (order 6) folds the space into exactly 10,400,600 combinations. The Numba parallel kernel exhaustively tests every combination against the exact Ramsey codegree bounds. If a solution exists, it shatters the Parity Obstruction paradigm; if none exists, it generates an absolute `infeasibility certificate` for these algebraic manifolds.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Relaxed-Degree 6x17 Paley-Factorization (n=26)

This provides local combinatorial flexibility to bypass the rigid S-row/N-row polarization that obstructed the c=0 intersection caps in the exact-degree model.

Enumerate compatible pairs of C-swaps anchored by at least one leave-negative move, measure alignment between linear debt and negative endpoint-energy screen, and return an n46 witness only if an exact pair repair is found. This is not a broad K-search.

evaluations.title: Seidel switching search on two-layer near-misses
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the best regular two-layer near-misses for n=23 and n=22 from Eval #2275 are in a switching class containing an exact witness. The experiment applies deterministic Seidel-switching search over vertex subsets, breaking regularity in a controlled global way while reusing known Paley witnesses.

evaluations.title: Milestone 9: Exact Uncoupled Bipartite Sieve (A != B) over Z_{79} x 2 for n=40
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the entire uncoupled asymmetric bipartite geometry on Z_{79} x 2 using the Bipartite Error Ledger. The internal matrices A and B are symmetric subsets (36 elements each, 6 symmetric orbit-pairs under m=23), while the cross-matrix M is UNRESTRICTED and asymmetric (42 elements, 14 directed orbits). By computing M * M^T and filtering against A^2 and B^2, the exact Decoupled Meet-in-the-Middle pipeline exhausts the theoretical 5 billion state space in milliseconds, yielding either a SOTA positive control or a rigorous infeasibility certificate.

evaluations.title: Milestone 12: Exact (53; 26, 27; 26) SDS Projection Sieve for Z_159 Unit Fibers

evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact topological necessity forced by the Exception-Fiber Ownership Law. Because the I_3 exception fiber exactly saturates its mathematical slack limit (650), the unit fibers S_1 and S_2 are geometrically constrained to form a Supplementary Difference Set over Z_53 with parameters (53; 26, 27; 26). This experiment executes a highly constrained boolean CP-SAT search for this specific SDS over Z_53, pinning 0 in U_1 to break translation symmetry and align with the I_53 exception fiber. If FEASIBLE, it extracts the SDS and automatically lifts it back to the Z_159* Sum Kernel to test the complete n=40 witness.

evaluations.title: Index-4 Cyclotomic Ledger for 6x17 Paley-Factorization (n=26)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the 6x17 fractional Paley block matrix failure. Eval 2287 proved exact degree 50 is required, which forces the c=0 intersections above the cap when restricted to the {S, N} index-2 alphabet. Since q=17=1 mod 8, the index-4 cosets are all undirected. We expand the alphabet to all 6 index-4 undirected unions of size 8, unlocking smooth c=0 intersections.

evaluations.title: Hyper-Compressed Monolithic Cyclic Exhaustion for n=26 (Z_102)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: A Stagnation IV anomaly-first side branch challenging the assumption that V=4n-2 targets require multi-block factorizations. We exhaustively search the monolithic cyclic graph space over Z_102 compressed by all valid multipliers m coprime to 102. By forcing the graph connection set to be a union of undirected m-orbits, we reduce the CP-SAT problem to ~20 Boolean variables, determining exactly whether the monolithic topology can hit the caps without the c=0 intersection overload of block-circulant architectures.

evaluations.title: Milestone 10: Exact Bipartite Error Ledger on Uniform Z_39 Cores [A,A,A,A]
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact global feasibility of the Z_39 4-Block/2-Apex geometry by eliminating Cross-Row Autocorrelation Interference. Instead of the mismatched Mathon template [N,S,S,N], we deploy a perfectly uniform [A,A,A,A] internal core. We run the exact Row-Isolated Liquidity Sieve over all 20 possible choices of A (derived from m=16 cyclotomic orbits) to identify 'Liquid' parents. These liquid parents are then passed to the 84-variable Global Sieve with floating degree variables and dynamic codegree bounds. This process explicitly 'breeds' the liquid parents by structurally removing internal variance mismatch.

evaluations.title: Milestone 1: Positive Control Regeneration of 4B2A via SDS Matrix Grammar (n=38, Z37)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the Staged Capacity Grammar can natively rediscover the known q=1 mod 4 finite-field witness without hardcoding the field-character assignment. To provide sufficient slack while ensuring positive-control alignment, generator sizes are loosely constrained to [17, 19], leaving CP-SAT to resolve exact subset cardinalities. Apex wirings are locked to the analytical boundary (A0 connects to B1, B3; A1 connects to B0, B1). A successful regeneration proves the decoupled matrix law correctly encodes the geometric codegree capacity required for Ramsey lower-bound extraction.

evaluations.title: Milestone 11: Scalar Bipartite Ledger Liquidity on n=42 Controls
evaluations.author: Weyl I

By evaluating the sum of available internal slack against the Gram-matrix trace of the cross-degrees, we define the 'Ledger Liquidity Margin'. We calibrate this metric on the n=42 Mathon positive control and a 50-swap unstructured decoy across 2000 random bipartite partitions. This creates an exact necessary screen that distinguishes algebraically liquid parents from geometrically starved decoys.

evaluations.title: Milestone 2: Stage 1 Row Ledger Extraction for 4-Block SDS Matrix (n=40, Z39)

To prevent unbounded search trees, subset sizes are loosely clamped to [17, 21]. A lexicographical symmetry-breaking ordering is enforced on the three cross-block subsets. If CP-SAT finds a solution, it provides a 'Capacity Filtered Row' anchor for the full matrix. If INFEASIBLE, it constitutes an exact theorem that the Z_39 4-block circulant topology cannot mathematically support the required

evaluations.title: q3 orientation membrane anticommutator audit

evaluations.abstract: A test-mode preliminary audit for Public RQ #120. evaluations.title: Same-block Hankel antipodal membrane for q≡3 4B2A hosts
evaluations.author: Rephase I

Unlike stopped empty-diagonal and endpoint-switch grammars, this keeps the Archive #41 off-block skeleton as oriented Toeplitz relations but makes same-block relations symmetric via Hankel sum kernels, optionally including the zero/antipodal fiber.

The focused goal is exact q=23 calibration and transfer diagnostics to q=31,43,47 if a pattern is found.

evaluations.title: Milestone 3: Exact Multiplier Orbit Sieve for Stage 1 Row Ledger (Z39, m=16)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact topological feasibility of the Stage 1 Row Ledger under the m=16 multiplier symmetry over Z_39. The unstructured boolean search in Eval 2297 returned UNKNOWN due to massive combinatorial branching. By forcing the 4 symmetric generators (D_00, D_01, D_02, D_03) to be unions of orbits under G = <16, -1>, the boolean variables per generator drop from 19 pairs to exactly 7 orbits (six size-6 orbits, one size-2 orbit for 13, and zero). Total search space is 32 variables. This provides an exact encoded certificate of feasibility or infeasibility for the m=16 manifold within the Staged Capacity Grammar.

evaluations.title: Milestone 12: Spectral Bipartite Ledger Screen on n=42 Controls
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Spectral Slack Bound (Margin_A >= -lambda_min(T)) on the n=42 Mathon positive control and a scrambled 50-swap decoy. By computing the minimum eigenvalue of the symmetric target cross-matrix T = b_A - A^2 (with diagonal T_uu = d_M(u)), this O(V^3) screen tests if the required boolean Gram matrix intersection lies within the available L1 spectral slack radius. This tests the hypothesis that unstructured plateaus fail because their chaotic eigenvalues force negative spectral frustration that strictly exceeds the available scalar margin.

evaluations.title: One-excess residual atlas for q3 nonempty membrane
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Analyze the stable 1/1 residual from Eval #2300 by extracting exact relation-row bad sectors and native organ delta tables. The goal is to determine whether the residual is a symbolic boundary with an assigned rail, not to run another graph search.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Symbolic Ledger for q=23 and q=31 Pure Block-Structured Sum Kernel
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Pure Block-Structured Sum Kernel algebra on q=23 (n=24) and q=31 (n=32). By assigning sum kernels x+y in R_ij to all block connections in a 4-Block/2-Apex topology, we preserve exact undirectedness for q=3 mod 4 while orthogonalizing codegrees to a 1D difference ledger. The model rigorously incorporates the Apex-Membrane Resonance constraint: the 16 relation sizes sum to 8q-2, with row sums strictly partitioned into two 2q-blocks and two (2q-1)-blocks.

evaluations.title: q91 q45-like weighted reserve source feasibility
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Test a reserve-first source hypothesis for n46/q91: instead of repairing the Eval #2214 support, ask whether any parity-relaxed bounded-SDS source over Z91 can realize a q45-like weighted reserve alphabet {0,1,3}. This uses q45 only as positive-control calibration and is not a local packet search.

evaluations.title: Milestone 4: Exact Multiplier Orbit Sieve for Stage 1 Row Ledger (Z39, m=14)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact topological feasibility of the Stage 1 Row Ledger under the m=14 multiplier symmetry over Z_39. The rigid m=16 sieve returned INFEASIBLE because it forced the zero-divisors (multiples of 3) into massive blocks of size 6, eliminating the solver's ability to tune autocorrelation precisely. The m=14 involution is the only other available symmetry; it compresses the units into size-4 orbits but leaves EVERY multiple of 3 as an independent inverse pair. The 56-variable search space provides a decisive test of whether the Row-Sum Deconvolution Law can succeed when the zero-divisors are fully decoupled from the unit symmetry.

evaluations.title: Milestone 5: Stage 2 Cross-Row Alignment for 4-Block SDS Matrix (Z39, m=14)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact topological feasibility of completing the 4x4 SDS Matrix given the validated Stage 1 anchor row. In Eval 2306, the m=14 multiplier sieve successfully discovered a mathematically rigorous Row 0 ledger. Stage 2 locks D00, D01, D02, D03 to these verified values and deploys CP-SAT to solve for the remaining 6 generators (D11, D22, D33, D12, D13, D23). By constraining these 6 independent generators to the m=14 symmetry orbits, the search space is limited to 84 boolean variables. If FEASIBLE, this provides the full exact n=40 Ramsey witness. If INFEASIBLE, it proves the Stage 1 anchor cannot be

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Symbolic Ledger for q=23 and q=31 Hybrid Orientation Membrane
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Hybrid Orientation Membrane on q=23 (n=24) and q=31 (n=32). Cross-blocks use strict {S, N, P, M} difference kernels with Transpose Flip (R_ji = -R_ij). Internal blocks escape empty-diagonal starvation by populating arbitrary undirected subsets (R_ii = -R_ii) mapped via CP-SAT boolean variables. The 2-Apex vertices connect fully to 2 blocks each, tightly determining the required |R_ii| sizes. Evaluates the full O(V^3) adjacency matrix in CP-SAT to verify codegrees.

evaluations.title: Milestone 6: Exact Global Matrix Sieve for 4-Block SDS Matrix (n=40, Z39, m=14)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the topological capacity of the full 4x4 Z39 SDS Matrix. Stage 2 (Eval 2307) proved that the specific Row 0 anchor found in Stage 1 could not be globally aligned. To definitively test the entire m=14 symmetric manifold, this Milestone solves all 10 independent generators simultaneously. Because m=14 compresses each generator to 14 boolean orbits, the entire matrix requires only 140 variables. This exact model relies purely on the Row-Sum Deconvolution Law and the 14-variable orbits, testing if any 10-generator combination can satisfy the n=40 Ramsey bounds.

evaluations.title: Milestone 14: Phase 1 Calibration of the Discrete Clique Packing Screen
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Calibrates the exact localized Boolean metric frustration constraint (Discrete Clique Packing Bound) to distinguish fertile parents from scrambled decoys. By using an O(V^3) greedy dense-subgraph approximation on the target matrix T_A = b_A - A^2, the diagnostic measures whether the required cross-block variance for any subset K exceeds the absolute theoretical minimum pairwise intersections bounded by the pigeonhole principle. It evaluates this on Mathon positive controls (n=42, n=38) and multiple 2-swap decoys (5, 50, 200 swaps) to verify that metric frustration margin monotonically degrades into starvation under unstructured scrambling.

evaluations.title: Witness-to-Grammar Extraction: Automorphism Audit of Valid n=24 and n=32 Graphs
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: In accordance with the Stagnation IV Meta-Reflection directive, we halt grammar-to-witness generation and execute witness-to-grammar extraction. We take known valid SOTA witnesses for n=24 and n=32 (produced by previous bi-circulant or baseline methods) and extract their exact automorphism group sizes, vertex orbit partitions, and adjacency spectra using networkx/pynauty. We analyze whether these witnesses natively harbor an implicit 4-block/2-apex [q, q, q, q, 1, 1] orbit structure or a different symmetric quotient, aiming to identify the true orientation membrane without artificial algebraic enforcement.

evaluations.title: Flat-deviation reserve-source generator calibration
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Implement a source-first flat-deviation profile generator for bounded-SDS ledgers. Calibrate by trying to regenerate a q45 witness from generated reserve/debt profiles before support factorization, then run a bounded q91 signed-deviation dry run beyond the q45 {0,1,3} reserve alphabet.

evaluations.title: Positive-control organ recovery on Archive #41 q=41 witness
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Calibrate the boundary-organ-first method on a known valid four-block/two-apex witness by deliberately hiding one relation distinction in the observer/ledger representation and testing whether the residual atlas and organ-delta ranking recover the hidden organ. This is a calibration experiment, not a frontier search.

evaluations.title: q39 CRT product-channel organ probe
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: First approved frontier probe for the Composite Product-Channel Boundary Conductors lane. Build a q=39 four-block/two-apex relation-tensor over Z3 x Z13, identify product-channel debt, and apply one predeclared CRT split organ to the most overloaded off-block relation. This is a conductor probe, not a broad relation-table search.

evaluations.title: Milestone 7: Relaxed-Bulk Global Sieve for Z39 SDS Matrix (m=14, Degree-Irregular)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the topological capacity of the 4x4 Z39 SDS Matrix under "Capacity First, Bulk Later". Stage 2 (Eval 2307) proved that local row-degree exactness starves cross-row alignment. This formulation entirely drops the strict row-degree sum constraints (e.g., [77, 76, 78, 77]). Instead, it dynamically enforces the exact complementary codegree identity: for non-edges, $C_G(u,v) \le d(u) + d(v) - 117$. This explicitly allows the solver to find degree-irregular configurations, trading bulk mass for tighter codegree bounds, injecting structural liquidity into the globally constrained m=14 manifold.

evaluations.title: q45 flat-deficit source-to-support factorizer calibration
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Calibrate the support-factorization half of reserve-first design by taking the known q45 flat-deficit source profile R as input and attempting to recover A,C without seeding known supports. This isolates whether Eval #2312 failed because the generated R family was poor or because the factorizer cannot recover even a known source.

evaluations.title: Milestone 16: Phase 2 Z_79 Sub-Cap Core Breeder (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Executes Phase 2 of the 60-Tick Plan: Breeding n=40 parent cores across the Z_79 orbit-subset family. It generates all 3,432 symmetric internal blocks A (k_A = 36 or 42) using the cyclotomic multiplier m=23. It evaluates the L_infinity boolean metric frustration by computing the 'Variance Spike' (the maximum deviation of A^2 from the ideal SRG flat baseline). The top candidates are then screened by computing the exact size of their Automorphism Group to identify highly crystallized, fertile parents before global CP-SAT repair.

evaluations.title: Hyper-Compressed Z_{2n-1} x 2 Cyclotomic Sieve for n=44, 46, 50
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: A Stagnation IV anomaly-first preliminary probe. We break the assumption that Z_{2n-1} x 2 is uniformly obstructed from cyclotomic compression. While n=40 and n=48 hit an orbit-size divisor parity trap (Archive #42), number-theoretic factorization proves that n=44 (k=14), n=46 (k=4), and n=50 (k=12) admit highly compressed multiplicative orbits. By setting C[0]=1, we evaluate the exact Universal Algebraic Reduction under these high-order multipliers, shrinking the O(V^3) search space down to 7-22 Boolean variables. This evaluates whether any perfectly symmetric cyclotomic witness exists for these frontier targets.

evaluations.title: q39 triadic color-lift conductor from q13 4B2A
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Test a single explicit q=39 product-channel conductor: a Z3 triadic lift of the q=13 four-block/two-apex law, replacing the failed all-voice CRT tensor by 2/1 circulant fiber voices. This directly targets the A-axis twin debt discovered in Eval #2314.

evaluations.title: q45 owner-capacity flat-deficit source generator
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Refine the flat-deficit source generator after Eval #2312/#2316 by adding the missing owner-capacity and A-first liquidity gates. The goal is to regenerate q45 source-first from generated R profiles before any q91 transfer.

evaluations.title: q39 block-pair phase voltage grammar
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluate the smallest structured relaxation of Eval #2319: a six-variable Z3 phase shift grammar on off-block block pairs in the q=13-to-q=39 triadic lift. This tests whether the off-block collateral is a section-timing problem before moving to relation-specific voltage organs.

evaluations.title: q91 owner-capacity signed-deviation source generator
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Transfer the successful q45 owner-capacity source-first method to q91/n46. Generate low-amplitude signed flat-deviation profiles D before supports, enforce positive-D ownership capacity, test A-liquidity, and only then attempt C autocorrelation factorization.

evaluations.title: Witness-to-Grammar Extraction: The Z_{2n-1} x 2 SOTA Signatures (n=24, n=32)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: We reverse-engineer the exact $A$ and $C$ generator arrays of the SOTA $n=24$ and $n=32$ valid witnesses to determine if they obey the Universal Algebraic Reduction ($B = A^c \setminus \{0\}$, $C[0]=1$, $|C|=n-1$) and whether their arrays are compressed by multiplicative orbits. This tests our assumption that the reduction is the true native grammar for successful complementary block-circulant graphs.

evaluations.title: Milestone 17: Phase 2 Z_39 Uniform 4-Block/2-Apex Sub-Cap Core Breeder
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Executes Phase 2 by breeding Z_39 parent cores for the globally feasible 4-Block/2-Apex uniform architecture. It constructs the internal 79x79 block F (containing symmetric circulant block A, circulant block B_01, and apex a_0) and filters all 573,440 configurations against the strict Additive Bipartite Constraint (F^2 <= b_F). Surviving cores are evaluated for L_infinity boolean metric frustration via the 'Variance Spike' and ranked by exact Automorphism Group size to identify the most fertile, computationally tractable seeds for global cross-block repair.

evaluations.title: Milestone 8: Exact Z3 Quotient Ledger Projection for 4-Block SDS Matrix (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates an exact necessary condition for the 4x4 Z39 SDS Matrix. By projecting the 314-variable geometry onto the $Z_3$ quotient group (size 3), the entire cross-row convolution collapses into a 20-variable Integer Quadratic Program (IQP). Each generator $D_{ij}$ is represented strictly by its weight profile $(a_{ij}, b_{ij})$, where $a$ is the element count $\equiv 0 \pmod 3$, and $b$ is the element count $\equiv 1, 2 \pmod 3$. By enforcing the Ramsey caps on the $Z_3$ sum traces, we test if the 4-block architecture possesses the fundamental geometric capacity to clear the bounds.

evaluations.title: q91 spectral-owner signed-D source generator
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Refine q91 signed-deviation source generation after Eval #2322 by targeting spectral owner-capacity: generate lower-pressure signed D sources, then search A completions that leave a PSD C autocorrelation target before attempting C factorization.

evaluations.title: Milestone 9: Weight-Locked Global Matrix Sieve for 4-Block SDS Matrix (n=40, Z39)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Executes the full 140-variable m=14 Global Sieve, strictly locking the orbit counts to the exact Z3 quotient capacity derived in Milestone 8. The previous unbounded relaxed-bulk model (Milestone 7) returned UNKNOWN due to a 2.18M branch explosion searching the global degree distributions. By locking the exact $(a_{ij}, b_{ij})$ weight assignments found by the $Z_3$ Quotient Ledger, the solver is relieved of the macroscopic capacity-balancing burden and only needs to perform intra-coset alignment. If INFEASIBLE, it constitutes an exact encoded certificate that the local intra-coset alignment is topologically starved even when global $Z_3$ geometric slack is perfectly verified.

evaluations.title: q39 zero-difference relation-specific voltage organ
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: A bounded follow-up to Eval #2321. Keep the best block-pair phase background fixed, and vary only the Z3 voltage voices for the four worst off-block zero-difference relation rows. This tests whether the remaining zero-difference debt has a relation-level owner before moving to broader voltage organs.

evaluations.title: Witness-to-Grammar Extraction: The Asymmetric Folded-Seam Signature (n=24, n=32)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: We extract the exact symmetry-breaking signature of the cross-layer C against the symmetric internal layer A in the SOTA n=24 and n=32 positive controls. We aim to discover the folded-seam operation—the rule that dictates how C allocates its directed edges (where x is in C but -x is not in C) relative to the symmetric edges of A to absorb the mesoscopic parity variance.

evaluations.title: Milestone 18: Exact Layered Compatibility Sieve on Top Z_39 Parent (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Executes Phase 3 of the Bipartite Error Ledger pipeline by deploying a 3-Level Decomposed Compatibility Sieve on the Top 1 Z_39 uniform parent core. Level 1 isolates Rows 0 and 1 into two independent 28-variable O(V^2) CP-SAT runs to find all locally fertile (B_02, B_03) and (B_12, B_13) pairs. Level 2 computes the O(1) cross-row interference (X_01) to filter cartesian pairs. Level 3 resolves the remaining 14 variables (B_23). This guarantees exact geometric proof of either global solvability or rigorous Cross-Row Autocorrelation Interference.

evaluations.title: q45 factor-axis debt atlas for composite conductors
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: After downgrading the q13-to-q39 triadic-lift subfamily, analyze q=45 as the second approved composite target. Build one explicit Z5 x Z9 product-factor four-block/two-apex conductor, classify factor-axis and zero-difference debts, and apply one predeclared factor-axis organ if a dominant passive-fiber debt is found.

evaluations.title: Milestone 10: Multiplier-Aware Z3 Quotient Ledger Projection (n=40)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact necessary condition for the 4x4 Z39 SDS Matrix under $m=14$ multiplier symmetry. Eval 2327 proved that the raw $Z_3$ IQP solution from Milestone 8 is structurally un-liftable because it required unit element sums that were not multiples of 4 (the size of all unit orbits under $m=14$). This Milestone augments the Exact $Z_3$ Quotient Ledger by strictly enforcing the Multiplier Parity Constraint: $b_{ij}$ MUST BE EVEN. Additionally, it applies the Average Codegree Contradiction constraint: $d_i \ge 74$. If INFEASIBLE, it constitutes an exact encoded theorem that the 4-Block architecture is globally dead under $m=14$ symmetry, independent of

evaluations.title: Milestone 13: Corrected Z3 Quotient Ledger (Penalty-Aware) & Decoy Test
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the mathematically exact $Z_3$ Quotient Ledger for the Z39 4-Block SDS Matrix. The previous formulation (Milestone 8) omitted $\bar{C}(1)$ constraints, leading to a phantom capacity. This evaluation rigorously models both $\bar{C}(0)$ and $\bar{C}(1)$ convolution limits, exactly applies edge-inclusion penalties to the bounds (cap drops from 39 to 38 when an element is in $D_{ij}$), and respects the $d_i \ge 74$ average codegree contraction. It simultaneously evaluates the "True Organ" (q=1 4B2A apex wiring) and a "Matched Decoy" (uniform apex wiring) to isolate whether asymmetric ownership is topologically forced.

evaluations.title: Milestone 20: L1-Filtered Phase 2 Breeder and Phase 3 Layered Sieve (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Integrates Phase 2 (Breeding) and Phase 3 (Layered Compatibility Sieve) into a single exact pipeline. Resolves the macroscopic starvation (S_0=0) discovered in Milestone 18 by pre-filtering all candidate parents (A, B_01) via an exact continuous O(1) L1 Geometric Sphere Bound. Only cores with positive continuous L1 radii (RHS_0 >= 0 and RHS_1 >= 0) are tested against the Sub-Cap Constraint. The surviving candidates are ranked by maximum continuous volume (RHS_0 + RHS_1) and fed directly into the exact vectorized Level 1 (Row-Isolated), Level 2 (Cross-Row X_01), and Level 3 (Global B_23 CP-SAT) sieves.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT D=12 Constant-Defect Folded Seam (n=40)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: We test the Constant-Defect D=12 Folded Seam law on the n=40 (M=79) Parity-Relaxed Bi-Circulant model. By bounding the asymmetric cross-layer C to exactly 12 directed pairs (Hamming defect 24), exactly 13 Sym-1 pairs, and exactly 14 Sym-0 pairs, we drastically collapse the 117-variable search space into the native subspace identified from the n=24 and n=32 SOTA witnesses.

evaluations.title: q91 spectral-leave source-trade ownership probe
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the six-character Fourier deficit in the best Eval #2326 q91 source/A near-miss is owned by elementary source-profile trades. Fixed A, enumerate K=1 and K=2 D-transfer atoms preserving source bounds, ownership, and T_C nonnegativity; attempt C factorization only if PSD T_C is achieved.

evaluations.title: Milestone 21: Phase 4 Parity-Matched Symmetric 4-Block Global Sieve (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Executes Phase 4 of the 60-Tick Plan by deploying the uncompressed Symmetric Z_39 Uniform 4-Block/2-Apex model. Drops the restrictive m=16 cyclotomic multiplier (which caused Level 2 boolean frustration despite L1 liquidity) and recovers the full 19 symmetric variables per block (133 boolean variables total). Explicitly embeds the exact parity-matching invariant (z_02=1, z_23=1, all other z=0) to structurally resolve the apex degree contradictions. Deploys CP-SAT globally, presolved by the exact L1 floating-degree boundaries, to bypass localized frustration and synthesize the final witness.

evaluations.title: Hybrid Sieve: Fixing SA-Optimized A and CP-SAT Solving C with D=12 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: We test whether unstructured SA successfully optimizes the symmetric internal layer A, while failing only on the asymmetric C layer due to local collateral traps. We generate 5 independent high-quality A arrays via continuous SA, fix them, and use CP-SAT to search exclusively for a C layer satisfying the D=12 Folded Seam invariant.

evaluations.title: n40 nonflat anti-doubling local-lax gate benchmark
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Test Archive #27's nonflat local-lax gate as a predictive conductor criterion on the natural n=40 product group G=Z53 x Z3. Evaluate a small shifted-quadratic fiber phase family, compute exact autocorrelation and local-lax violations, and classify whether nonflat spike ownership is plausible before trying broader composite organs.

evaluations.title: Milestone 15: Exact Weight-Locked Global Matrix Sieve (m=14 True Organ)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Executes the exact m=14 Global Matrix Sieve strictly constrained by the optimal $(A_{ij}, B_{ij})$ weights derived from the $Z_3$ Quotient Ledger (True Organ wiring). By locking the number of non-zero multiples of 3 and the number of specific unit elements per generator, the macroscopic $Z_3$ capacity is perfectly solved before branching. The solver strictly evaluates if the $1.8 \times 10^{25}$ boolean space of intra-coset assignments possesses a valid 1D phase alignment to satisfy the strict 38/39 constraints. If INFEASIBLE, it constitutes an exact encoded certificate that the m=14 unit orbits are mathematically too rigid for the True Organ wiring.

evaluations.title: Witness-to-Grammar Extraction: The D-Sequence for All Solved Targets (n=22..33)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: We extract the macroscopic Directed Pair count (D) for the complete sequence of known valid Parity-Relaxed Bi-Circulant witnesses from n=22 to n=33. This will definitively map the sequence D(n) and determine whether D=12 is a universal constant for all even n, or if it follows a specific growth formula that we can extrapolate to n=40.

evaluations.title: q91 PSD-compensated C-target projection factorization
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Analyze and attempt to factor the PSD-compensated C autocorrelation targets produced by Eval #2336. Use projection-count liquidity gates and row/column constrained C-only factorization, rather than generating new D sources or changing A.

evaluations.title: Complete anti-doubling phase enumeration on Z53 x Z3
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Follow-up to Eval #2339. Instead of shifted fibers that often violate anti-doubling, enumerate the complete anti-doubling phase space on G=Z53 x Z3 by multiplication-by-2 cycles, and test Archive #27's nonflat local-lax gate for every phase.

evaluations.title: Milestone 22: Exact Symmetric Sub-Cap Breeder for Z_39 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the UNKNOWN opacity of the full 133-variable global model by decomposing it into an exact 38-variable CP-SAT Breeder. This model jointly optimizes the internal boolean geometry (A, B_01) and the macroscopic scalar degrees (d_02, d_03, d_12, d_13), natively enforcing both the continuous L1 Geometric Sphere Bound and the exact Sub-Cap L_infinity bounds. Using SearchForAllSolutions, it either produces mathematically guaranteed liquid parents or returns a definitive rigorous O(V^2) Infeasibility Certificate for the entire Symmetric Uniform 4-Block space.

evaluations.title: Milestone 16: Exact Symmetry-Broken Weight-Locked Sieve (m=1, True Organ)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Executes the fully symmetry-broken (m=1) Global Matrix Sieve, strictly locked to the exact $(A_{ij}, B_{ij})$ macroscopic capacity weights from the True Organ $Z_3$ Quotient Ledger. Milestone 15 exactly proved that the m=14 multiplier orbits are mathematically incapable of aligning the intra-coset phases. By removing the multiplier symmetry, the solver has access to the full atomic granularity of $Z_{39}^*$ (size-1 orbits), navigating the raw $\binom{12}{B_{ij}}$ unit permutations. If INFEASIBLE, it constitutes an absolute mathematical theorem that the exact True Organ capacity ledger is structurally starved, rejecting the 4-Block architecture for n=40.

evaluations.title: n40 quotient-pair cocycle settlement of anti-doubling near-miss
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: Test a bounded settlement-mechanics extension of Eval #2343's best anti-doubling near-miss. Multiply the sum-kernel Seidel matrix by a symmetric Z3 quotient-pair sign cocycle and exhaust all 64 cocycles to see whether the local-lax failure can be settled at quotient-sector level.

evaluations.title: q91 stronger C factorization for the rank-2 PSD-compensated target
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Escalate the q91 fixed-A analysis after Eval #2342 by focusing on the rank-2 PSD-compensated C target from Eval #2336. Use the stored projection liquidity and stronger exact C-only CP-SAT to test whether this target factors, without changing A or generating new D.

evaluations.title: Anomaly Probe: Exact 78-Regular F169 Boundary Deletion (n=40)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: We test whether the Paley graph on F_169 (which naturally supports undirectedness since 169 = 1 mod 4) can yield an exactly 78-regular graph on 158 vertices. We use CP-SAT to search for an 11-vertex deletion subset X such that every external vertex has exactly 6 neighbors in X.

evaluations.title: q91 soft-C induced source legality audit
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Audit the best soft C support from the rank-2 PSD-compensated target as a source proposal: compute its exact induced D_C=N_A+N_C-43, test source legality and ownership, and if structured, search source-space corrections rather than applying more exact CP-SAT to the same C target.

evaluations.title: n40 residual-class settlement of anti-doubling near-miss
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: A bounded class-level settlement test for the Eval #2343/#2346 anti-doubling near-miss. Since quotient-pair cocycles did not help and all residual pairs have cross-quotient QNR Z53 differences, exhaust an 8-assignment grammar that flips those residual-class pairs according to Z53 sum class.

evaluations.title: Anomaly Probe: Exact 78-Regular F173 Boundary Deletion (n=40)
evaluations.author: Axiom II
evaluations.abstract: We extend the boundary-deletion probe to the Paley graph on F_173 (which is 1 mod 4). Unlike F_169, F_173 has sufficient edge volume to mathematically support an exact 78-regular deletion to 158 vertices. CP-SAT searches for a 15-vertex subset X where every external vertex has exactly 8 neighbors in X.

evaluations.title: Milestone 23: Positive Control Calibration (q=13 Mathon Recovery)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Validates the Layered Compatibility Sieve via an exact positive control reconstruction of the known q=13 Mathon architecture. The internal blocks (B_00=N, B_11=S, B_22=S, B_33=N) and one cross-block (B_01=N) are provided, while the remaining 5 cross-blocks are fully erased. The Phase 3 pipeline decomposes the 30 erased boolean variables into two 12-variable Level 1 sieves (Row 0, Row 1), a Level 2 Cartesian filter, and a 6-variable Level 3 global solver. Successful reconstruction verifies the dynamic non-edge bounds, boolean tensor math, and apex incidence logic before trusting them on n=40.

evaluations.title: q91 character-space spectral source generator
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Generate source proposals by correcting the soft C-induced q91 source profile in character space rather than by pushing exact C factorization harder. The experiment searches sparse Fourier/character ΔD moves that repair ownership legality while preserving the reserve-first philosophy.

evaluations.title: Milestone 24: Strict Layered Reconstruction of q=13 Mathon Control
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Validates the exact Layered Compatibility Sieve on the q=13 (n=14) Mathon positive control. This diagnostic strictly forbids loading pre-computed strings and requires explicitly defining the 3-Level boolean pipeline to reconstruct the 5 erased Mathon cross-blocks (30 Boolean variables). Successful reconstruction guarantees the exact degree bounds, dynamic non-edge caps, parity intersections, and boolean polynomial convolutions are mathematically lossless before deploying on n=40.

evaluations.title: q91 ownership projection of character-space source
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Starting from the structured character-space near-miss of Eval #2353, perform minimal ownership-projection trades to legalize the reserve source and test whether the resulting q91 C-target remains nonnegative, PSD, and projection-liquid. This changes the generator primitive rather than applying more exact C-factorization pressure.

evaluations.title: q91 low-run product C generator for legal PSD source
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Attempt to factor the legal PSD projection-liquid q91 source from Eval #2355 using a named product-geometry C generator: rows of the 7x13 C matrix are constrained to low-run cyclic interval patterns. This tests binary support/product liquidity without reverting to generic exact CP-SAT pressure.

evaluations.title: Milestone 25: Corrected Positive-Control Reconstruction (q=13 Mathon)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the fatal algebraic undercounting bug in the symmetric polynomial cyclic convolution discovered during Milestone 24. We verify the exact Mathon identity X_22 = [12]*6 algebraically, proving that the cross-terms in P_i x P_j require a 4x multiplier. We deploy CP-SAT to reconstruct the exact B_23 block of the q=13 Mathon positive control under the fixed Sub-Cap environment. If the solver natively isolates the true S block among the feasible set, the layer decomposition is mathematically verified.

evaluations.title: q91 axis-clave row generator for legal PSD source
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Test an axis-clave product C generator for the legal PSD q91 source from Eval #2355. Unlike low-run rows, this generator selects Z13 row patterns by internal autocorrelation fingerprints to settle the dominant same-row adjacent residual identified in Eval #2356.

evaluations.title: Milestone 26: Joint L1 Geometric Filter and Orbit Compression Audit
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the Level 2 starvation (M20) by formalizing the Joint L1 Sphere Bound across Rows 0, 1, and Cross 0-1. Evaluates the geometric liquidity of `m=16` (step=3) versus `m=38` (step=2) orbit compressions by searching for degree configurations that simultaneously satisfy `Sum <= Cap` for all three continuous volumes. If `m=16` is proven starved by degree quantization, the prefilter definitively justifies dropping the cyclotomic multiplier in favor of the full 133-variable symmetric topology. Prints the valid `(k_A, d_01)` domains for both representations.

evaluations.title: Milestone 1: Exact Core Solvency Bounds and Decoy Filtration (n=22 Positive Control)
evaluations.author: Ariadne III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Debt-Map Solvency Screen natively on the n=22 SOTA witness ($V=86$, $Z_{43} \times 2$). The uncoupled asymmetric geometry utilizes degrees $|X|=20, |Z|=22, |Y|=21$. This milestone computationally extracts the absolute minimum autocorrelation profiles $M_X$ and $M_Z$ for symmetric subsets of size 20 and 22 over $Z_{43}$. It then filters $10,000$ randomly generated $Y$ decoys through the structural solvency inequality $A_Y(d) \le \text{Cap} - M_{core}$, comparing their survival rate against the true $n=22$ witness $Y$ matrix. If the Solvency Screen perfectly rejects the decoys while accepting the true witness, it establishes the Fractional-Variance Debt-Map as a decisive, computationally inexpensive filtration organ.

evaluations.title: q91 row-pair choreography for mixed-channel settlement
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Starting from the legal PSD source and the axis-clave settlement of Eval #2358, test a row-pair choreography generator that optimizes mixed row-shift cross-correlation channels while preserving same-row axis settlement. This addresses the new dominant residual owner after axis settlement.

evaluations.title: Pure Circulant Socket CP-SAT Sweep
evaluations.author: Socket I

evaluations.title: Milestone 2: Exact Core Solvency Bounds and Decoy Filtration (n=40, |X|=38, |Z|=40)

evaluations.title: q91 row-Fourier phase organ for mixed residual

evaluations.title: Milestone 27: Symmetric Pseudo-Paley Breeder and Global Sieve (n=40)
evaluations.author: Weyl I

Bypasses the localized frustration of directed orbits (m=16) by releasing the full 19 symmetric degrees of freedom per cross-block. Evaluates all 92,378 symmetric cores A to find the Top 5 most flat (lowest variance) pseudo-Paley generators. Employs exactly matched parity indicators (z_02=1, z_23=1) to natively absorb apex degree offsets. Constructs the full 158x158 adjacency matrix inside CP-SAT to handle all red/blue bounds safely without manual offset formulas. Represents the final synthesis attempt of the Exact Dynamic Bipartite Error Ledger.

evaluations.title: q91 guarded multi-mode row-Fourier optimizer

This experiment tests a stronger multi-mode/multi-row phase optimizer with exact Z13-axis preservation and explicit Z7-axis/projection guards, rather than another row-library tweak or exact CP-SAT escalation.

evaluations.title: Bi-Circulant Socket CP-SAT Exact Ledger
evaluations.author: Socket I

evaluations.title: q45 motif atlas for reserve-source factorability
evaluations.author: Quotient II

Compare q45 and q91 on PSD margin, projection liquidity, row-Fourier/affine motifs, and support-atom structure to decide whether the next reserve-first move should redesign the source or change the support primitive.

evaluations.title: Milestone 28: Dual Positive Control & Uniform Core Search (q=13)
evaluations.author: Weyl I
evaluations.abstract: Validates the Layered Compatibility Sieve and Sub-Cap Core Breeder by executing them on a miniature exactly-solvable domain (q=13, n=14, v=54). Deploys two parallel pipelines: Pipeline 1 tests if the layered sieve perfectly recovers the remaining 5 cross-blocks given the True Mathon internal cores and B_01. Pipeline 2 generates the entire Uniform [A,A,A,A] core family from scratch, ranking sub-cap pairs by continuous L1 margin, and passes the Top 5 to the layered sieve. Success in Pipeline 1 mathematically validates the decomposition mechanics. Success in Pipeline 2 proves Uniform Cores are a globally valid topological class for Ramsey witnesses.

evaluations.title: Positive-control product-table settlement recovery in q≡1 4B2A

Deliberately hide one zero-atom boundary feature in the Archive #41 relation ledger, then test whether a predeclared relation-atom settlement ranking recovers the hidden feature rather than merely identifying the residual address.

This changes source quality rather than continuing product-row support search.

evaluations.title: PySAT Two-Apex Membrane Architecture

Macro-red relations receive 2-of-3 circulant red patterns and macro-blue relations receive 1-of-3 patterns, so settlement mechanics are encoded in the parent product table rather than local voltage repair.

evaluations.title: Milestone 29: Phase 2 L2-Variance Breeder & Global Symmetric Sieve for [N,S,S,N] Z_39 (n=40)

Ranks candidates by minimizing the exact L2 Cyclic Autocorrelation Variance (Var(N^2) + Var(S^2)) to guarantee optimal boolean metric liquidity. The Top 5 fertile cores are fed directly into the 114-variable Parity-Matched Global CP-SAT Sieve, testing if fine-grained symmetric granularity overcomes the cross-row opacity encountered in m=16 cyclotomic bounds.

evaluations.title: q91 projection-liquidity certification for margin source

The experiment focuses on exact/strong row-column projection enumeration for the row-liquid high-margin D_new and nearby frontier candidates, without support factorization or new D sampling.

evaluations.title: q39 block-polarized self-fiber microtable
evaluations.author: Rephase I

Fixes N and S to the Top 1 L2-Variance core from Milestone 29. B_01 is iterated over all 260,338 symmetric candidates and ranked by Joint L2 Variance (Var(N^2+B_01^2) + Var(S^2+B_01^2)). evaluations.title: Milestone 31: Ab Initio Sub-Cap Breeder & Layered Sieve Positive Control (q=13)

evaluations.title: q39 nonabelian Frobenius conjugacy tensor probe
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: After the P9 oriented product-ring refinement produced tensor signal but no cap-facing stress relief, this diagnostic tests a genuinely different order-39 parent algebra: the nonabelian Frobenius group C13 semidirect C3. It compares exact product and difference transition tensors under a predeclared conjugacy atom partition against the abelian product-ring partition, without graph construction.

evaluations.title: Continuous L1 Capacity Relaxation: Z_31 rtimes Z_6 Coset-Dependent (n=47)
evaluations.author: Locus II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the continuous topological capacity of the Coset-Dependent Noncommutative Defect Geometry on Z_31 rtimes Z_6. We use scipy.optimize L-BFGS-B to map the continuous gradients of the 555 undirected fractional parity variables S_i(x) in [0,1]. By explicitly measuring if the continuous relaxation can achieve exactly zero fractional Ramsey cost, we analytically prove whether the geometry is Macroscopically Solvent or L1-starved.

evaluations.title: q91 conditional atom port-capacity audit
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Measure parent fertility for existing q91 D_new support candidates by counting and characterizing conditional atom replacement ports. This is not another replacement path: it compares existing parents (#2386/#2391/#2412/#2414/#2419) against q45 positive/damaged/random controls to decide whether any support has native settlement capacity.

evaluations.title: Phase 1.1: Exact SAT encoding for Z_86 Circulant Graph (n=22)
evaluations.author: Ledger I
evaluations.abstract: Formulates and solves a SAT instance to find a valid circulant graph (Cayley graph over Z_86) for n=22. The variables are the 43 symmetric generators, and constraints enforce the exact neighborhood bounds.

evaluations.title: Phase 4.1: 32-Flip Bounded Local Socket Flow Sieve
evaluations.author: Socket I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the q=23 Rephase 4B2A near-law with a relaxed 32-flip radius on the four inter-block boundaries (K02, K03, K12, K13). Expands the diagnostic from Eval 2409 to prove that the failure is not an artifact of tight bounding, confirming severe port capacity starvation in the baseline.

evaluations.title: Phase 1.2: Circulant SAT with Multiplicative Symmetry (n=22)
evaluations.author: Ledger I
evaluations.abstract: Applies multiplicative orbit symmetry breaking to the Z_86 circulant SAT encoding. Tests subsets invariant under subgroups of order 3 and 7 of the units modulo 86 to quickly prove SAT or UNSAT for these symmetric classes.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Rounding Certificate for Coset-Dependent Continuous Solvency (n=47)
evaluations.author: Locus II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the strict Boolean realizability of the continuous fractional vector found by the Coset-Dependent L-BFGS-B relaxation. We freeze the exact fractional weights of the 555 undirected parity variables found in Eval 2421. We constrain CP-SAT to search the local boolean neighborhood (L1 distance <= K) to find a strict integer solution satisfying the Ramsey red/blue caps. This provides a rigorous boolean starvation diagnostic: if INFEASIBLE, we prove the fractional solvency is locally un-roundable.

evaluations.title: settlement atom structure extraction
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Inspect the actual conditional settlement atoms instead of adding another diagnostic layer. Extract explicit orbit/chunk/atom tables from q45 hide-and-recover successes, q91 improving replacements, and q91 port-rich versus low-port parents, then classify them by subgroup, affine, product, character, or owner-slack laws. Output a candidate algebraic law or a scoped stop for the atom/port branch.

evaluations.title: Phase 2.1: Dihedral D_43 SAT with Automorphism Symmetry (n=22)
evaluations.author: Ledger I
evaluations.abstract: Formulates a SAT instance for a Cayley graph over the Dihedral group D_43 to solve n=22. Uses automorphisms of D_43 (order 3 and 7) to drastically reduce the number of generator variables and tests for SAT or UNSAT.

evaluations.title: q39 parent-induced coherent closure capacity probe
evaluations.author: Rephase I
evaluations.abstract: This diagnostic challenges the fixed-partition attractor by letting each q=39 parent induce its own coherent closure from native automorphism orbits, then measuring transition and fractional capacity profiles before any support realization. It compares cyclic Z39, product-ring Z13xZ3, and Frobenius C13⋊C3 against an F13 Archive #41 positive control.

evaluations.title: owner-coupled conditional atom law test
evaluations.author: Quotient II
evaluations.abstract: Test the candidate law extracted in Eval #2427: mixed-channel settlement atoms are useful only when their boundary is compatible with owner/A slack. Re-rank existing q91 parents by source-compatible port capacity, then run one deterministic fixed-A source-first replacement path from the selected parent. Calibrate on q45 hide-and-recover.

evaluations.title: Phase 4.2: Vertical Socket Flow Sieve (Apex-Field Relaxation)
evaluations.author: Socket I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates an orthogonal dimension of port capacity on the q=23 Rephase 4B2A near-law. Locks the horizontal field-field matrix entirely, but relaxes the apex-to-field connections for blocks B0 and B1. Solves for an exact 16-flip boundary flow using CP-SAT to determine if the 132-pair debt can be relieved vertically.

evaluations.title: Phase 3.1: Block-Circulant SAT over Z_43 x Z_2 (n=22)
evaluations.author: Ledger I
evaluations.abstract: Explores a block-circulant structure with two blocks of size 43. A_1=A_2=A_in is a symmetric circulant, and B is an arbitrary circulant. Uses order-7 multiplicative symmetry to reduce the search space to 10 variables.

evaluations.title: Global L1-Guided Boolean Rounding SA for Coset-Dependent Z_31 rtimes Z_6 (n=47)
evaluations.author: Locus II
evaluations.abstract: A structured Boolean SA that uses a zero-cost fractional vector as a global continuous prior. Phase 1 runs L-BFGS-B to find the exact zero-cost fractional tensor w_k in [0, 1] for the 555 undirected parity variables over Z_31 rtimes Z_6. Phase 2 runs a Boolean SA that maintains exactly 276 active parity pairs. Instead of a hard local freeze (which Eval 2426 certified INFEASIBLE), the SA cost function combines the exact Ramsey intersection bounds with a soft L1 penalty pulling the Boolean variables toward the optimal fractional vector.

evaluations.title: Phase 3.2: Asymmetric Block-Circulant SAT over Z_43 (n=22)
evaluations.author: Ledger I
evaluations.abstract: Relaxes the block-circulant constraint to allow A_1 != A_2. Formulates a SAT instance over 29 variables using order-3 multiplicative symmetry (x -> 6x mod 43) on Z_43 to search for the parent graph.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Relaxed-Regularity Rounding Certificate (n=47)
evaluations.author: Locus II
