evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Corrected Exact SA for K-Twisted Degree-Split Bi-Circulant (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Rerunning the k=5 K-Twisted SA with exact degree-dependent caps. Eval #3814 used naive 38/39 caps everywhere, ignoring the BCN formula: BCN(u,v) = V - 2 - d_u - d_v + CN_G. For a 79/77 split, the true non-edge caps are: V0 (deg 79)=41, V1 (deg 77)=37, V01=39.

evaluations.title: Modified Attempt 2: Defect-Coupled CP-SAT LNS around +1/+1 K-Twist
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: The k=5 degree-split SA (Eval #3820) hit a +1/+1 near-miss where the V01 cross-layer had exactly 0 debt. The remaining debt (6 units in V0, 6 in V1) is due to 1-circulant rigidity. We deploy CP-SAT to search a sparse L1-neighborhood of non-circulant symmetric edge flips (Delta A, Delta B) to absorb this debt, keeping the perfect cross-layer C fixed.

evaluations.title: Matching-Defect Grammar: CP-SAT Inversion of S_X K = -4 I
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Searches for the cross-layer matching-defect solution for even n. We require S_X * K = -4 I over the cyclic group Z_{2n-1}, where S_X is a symmetric +/- 1 sequence, K is symmetric in {0, +/- 2}, and their cyclic convolution is strictly the identity.

evaluations.title: Multiplicative Quotient Cross-Mask Search for q7 Residual
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Graph-facing source diagnostic after the B-only reservoir no-hit. Freeze the q7 split same-layer bulk, but constrain the cross-layer reservoir to a multiplicative quotient mask B(r,s)=b(s/r) over the quadratic-residue group. In this coordinate, the same-layer bad condition chi(r+s)=-1 becomes chi(1+lambda)=-1, and the cross-layer pair-shadow is the cyclic autocorrelation of b. Search this source geometry for max-ledger movement.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Defect Ledger Extraction of Z_158 1-Circulant Plateau
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Extracts the exact Defect Ledger matrix (A_D) from the Z_158 LNS plateau using Actuator's module. Because Z_158 is a 1-circulant, A_D is a 1-circulant vector. We will map its exact integer/fractional values to identify the true boundary demand.

evaluations.title: Direct Attempt: Twisted Complement K-Twist CP-SAT (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Using the newly discovered Twisted Complement Law: B = J - I - A_k. This guarantees the cross-layer V01 is exactly flat (CN <= 38/39). We deploy CP-SAT over just A (size 40) and C (size 39) to find a full exact zero-excess witness for n=40.

evaluations.title: Co-born Quotient Relation Algebra for q7 Two-Layer Core
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Graph-facing source diagnostic after the cross-only quotient mask no-hit. Work in the multiplicative quotient coordinate lambda=s/r over the quadratic-residue group, where chi(r+s)=chi(1+lambda). Instead of freezing same-layer signs, co-design the plus-plus, minus-minus, and cross-layer quotient masks as one relation algebra, and test whether changing same-layer and cross-layer owner rows together can move the q7 maximum ledger.

evaluations.title: Matching-Defect Grammar: Coupled CP-SAT for S_A, S_B, S_X
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Searches for the cross-layer matching-defect solution for even n by solving S_A, S_B, S_X jointly in CP-SAT. This enforces both S_X (S_A + S_B) = -4 I and the strict intra-layer codegree bounds S_A^2 + S_X^2 <= 0 and S_B^2 + S_X^2 <= 0.

evaluations.title: Balanced sign-code generator pilot
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test a non-residue, non-repair construction source: graphs generated from balanced binary/sign codewords with Hamming/dot-product thresholds and role-specific biases. This is a focused generator pilot calibrated on small solved n and matched random controls, intended to challenge the Station's cyclic-residue and near-witness repair attractors.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Exact SA for Twisted Complement K-Twist (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: CP-SAT returned UNKNOWN for the 118-variable Twisted Complement formulation (B = J - I - A_k). We deploy Simulated Annealing directly over this 1D space. Since the cross-layer is algebraically flattened to 0 debt, SA only needs to minimize the internal V0 and V1 excesses.

evaluations.title: Online row-budget generator pilot
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test a non-residue construction source that builds triangular-book graphs row-by-row from degree targets and partial codegree budgets. This is a generator attempt from scratch, calibrated on small solved n and compared with matched random degree-profile controls.

evaluations.title: Irregular role-table block generator pilot
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test a non-residue, non-repair generator whose primitive variables are role sizes, role-pair density/codegree budgets, and block realization rules. The pilot targets small solved n with exact validation and matched block/density controls.

evaluations.title: q31 co-born quotient-mask archaeology and deterministic lift test
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Diagnostic evaluation to dissect the q=31 exact valid masks found in the co-born quotient relation algebra of Eval #3826, canonicalize their structure, extract quotient/autocorrelation invariants, and test only deterministic lift hypotheses on larger q. This is a non-score archaeology run, intended to identify a source identity before any further optimization.

evaluations.title: Modified Attempt 3: Involution-Defect Twisted Complement (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: The 1D Twisted Complement SA plateaus at 8 excess. To break the 1-circulant symmetry without causing 'global smearing' across the cross-layer M, we must use a defect matrix that commutes with M. I discovered that if C is symmetric, the involution matching E(u, -u) = 1 perfectly satisfies E M = M E! We deploy CP-SAT over A, C, and an involution defect subset to find an exact zero-excess witness.

evaluations.title: Matching-Defect Grammar: Exact Sequence Inversion via R_A(d)^2 = 3003 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Formulates an exact CP-SAT search for the Z_79 bi-circulant defect inversion. Imposes the newly discovered invariant sum(R_A^2) = 6006 to heavily constrain the search space of Seidel sequences before cross-correlation.

evaluations.title: Latin-OA label generator pilot
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test a non-residue label generator using small Latin-square/orthogonal-array incidence features. Vertices receive row/column/symbol labels with deletion or multiplicity schedules, and edge colors come from simple agreement/parity score rules. The pilot uses exact validation and matched label-shuffled/random controls.

evaluations.title: Exact q103 co-born quotient channel feasibility
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Exact CP-SAT feasibility/optimization diagnostic for the co-born quotient relation algebra at q=103. The goal is to replace bounded LNS evidence with an exact channel-level statement: either find a valid q7 quotient witness for n=26, prove the smallest A/C/B quotient algebra cannot achieve t=0 at q=103, or return a carefully scoped UNKNOWN with incumbent and bound.

evaluations.title: Modified Attempt 4: Unrestricted SA on K-Twist Scaffold (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: The 1-circulant K-twist natively plateaus at +1/+1 (8 units of debt). CP-SAT over the sparse defect neighborhood timed out (Eval #3821). We now deploy a high-speed C-based Simulated Annealing solver over the FULL 79x79 symmetric adjacency matrices A and B, keeping the cross-layer C fixed, to absorb the residual debt via unstructured sparse defects.

evaluations.title: Orthogonal Block Design: Sequence Inversion for n=22 via Parseval Filter
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact bipartite defect grammar over Z_43 x 2 for n=22. Uses the sum-of-squares Parseval constraint to instantly filter the sequence space of S_A and S_X, testing whether the parity/unit collapse strictly forbids symmetric abelian block-circulants here.

evaluations.title: Exact q103 C=-A co-born quotient feasibility
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Restricted exact diagnostic for the co-born quotient relation algebra at q=103: impose the symmetry C=-A suggested by both q31 exact-valid masks and the Archive #24 row ledger, but do not otherwise force regularity in the primary model. The goal is to obtain a scoped feasibility result for this row-symmetric subgrammar before deciding whether the next mechanism must break C=-A.

evaluations.title: Matching-Defect Grammar: CP-SAT Search for Complementary Sequences (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the complementary sequence equation S_A^2 + S_X^2 = 157 I is feasible for Z_79. If infeasible, it mathematically closes all strictly bipartite defect ledgers for bi-circulants, even with asymmetric blocks.

evaluations.title: Direct Attempt: Low-Temperature SA on GF(157) + Apex Seed (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: With the Z_79 x 2 topology mathematically blocked by the global smearing obstruction, we pivot to the V=158 GF(157) + 1 Apex topology. The base graph is an extraordinary near-miss (only S-S edges/non-edges fail). We deploy a low-temperature C-compiled Simulated Annealer using 1-flips and 2-switches to explore the local neighborhood of this seed and fix the residual caps.

evaluations.title: Archive #24 skew-Paley Seidel ledger sanity check
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Non-score verification of the exact Archive #24 skew-Paley sum-kernel identities. The evaluation should instantiate the declared character construction for prime q=4n-1, verify the row-sum, correlation, and Seidel cap-translation formulas, and print the q≡3 versus q≡7 mod 8 sector tables. This is not a witness search.

evaluations.title: q103 quotient channel-relaxation ledger extraction
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Non-score diagnostic to derive and solve quotient-channel feasibility relaxations for q=103 before further graph-level CP-SAT. The goal is to extract the exact per-offset correlation inequalities induced by t=0, compare q31 valid masks to q103 frozen split at the channel level, and test whether relaxed channel budgets already expose an overpreserved source identity or a viable target profile.

evaluations.title: Variance-owned block toy calibration
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Build a reduced exact toy for variance-owned block/OA assignment: choose small role blocks and solve edge variables with explicit same-color codegree owner-row caps, then compare to matched shuffled/block-random decoys. This tests whether the next non-residue branch has a real generator mechanism before task-scale attempts.

evaluations.title: Orthogonal Block Design: Corrected Row-Sum Diophantine Inversion for n=22
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact bipartite defect grammar over Z_43 x 2 for n=22 using the rigorously derived row sums. The identity S_A^2 + S_X^2 = 85 I forces s_A^2 + s_X^2 = 85. With the graph regularity condition s_A + s_X = 1, this strictly isolates s_A = -6 and s_X = 7, resolving the parity collapse that caused UNKNOWN in previous solver iterations.

evaluations.title: Matching-Defect Grammar: Dirac Inversion of Asymmetric S_X (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the mathematically derived exact requirement for the 38-degree split bi-circulant: the symmetric sequence A and asymmetric sequence S_X must yield a Dirac-delta convolution A * S_X = [-2, 0, ..., 0].

evaluations.title: Variance-owned toy scaling ladder
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Follow up Eval 3844's positive variance-owned toy by testing tighter/task-like and larger toy sizes with full-pair codegree owner-row constraints, matched decoys, and active-row summaries. This remains a reduced calibration, not a task score attempt.

evaluations.title: B-drumhead autocorrelation synthesis for q103
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Object-bearing construction attempt after Eval #3843. Synthesize an actual q103 cross-layer quotient mask B whose cyclic autocorrelation realizes the channel target of lowering BB on bad offsets, then validate the full two-layer graph ledger with controlled A,C. The goal is to distinguish BB autocorrelation unrealizability from mixed-channel collateral, not to run another abstract relaxation.

evaluations.title: Orthogonal Block Design: Sequence Inversion for Model C (n=22)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates Model C of the bipartite defect grammar over Z_43 x 2 for n=22. Relaxing identical blocks (Model B) to non-identical blocks A and B, the required condition is S_A S_X + S_X S_B = -4 D_X. We use exact Parseval sum-of-squares to bound the sequences.

evaluations.title: Phase-coupled A/C compensator for q103 B-drumhead
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Object-bearing follow-up to Eval #3848. Keep the actual soft B-drumhead mask that partially reduces bad-sector BB, and synthesize actual same-layer A/C masks to absorb the displaced autocorrelation energy on chi-positive offsets. This tests whether the B object is salvageable by phase-coupled same-layer retuning, rather than running another free channel relaxation.

evaluations.title: Matching-Defect Grammar: General Degree-Split Cross-Equation Infeasibility (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the cross-block equation S_A S_X + S_X S_B = -4 D_X is feasible for asymmetric blocks (S_A != S_B) under the parity-forced d_X = 3 defect split.

evaluations.title: Direct Attempt: Boundary Healing of GF(81)x2 Frobenius Witness (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: The Frobenius-character map on GF(81)x2 yields a perfect n=41 witness on 162 vertices (Eval #3793). To solve n=40 (158 vertices), we deploy my native mechanism: Boundary Healing. We use CP-SAT to select exactly 4 vertices to delete, while allowing a strictly sparse budget (<= 10) of boundary edge flips to resolve any residual capacity violations.

evaluations.title: Selected-owner compression for variance-owned toys
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether Eval 3844's variance-owned toy positives contain a compressible owner-row law. Use rule-defined selected codegree constraints to generate toys, direct-validate all pairs, compare to full-owner/oracle/underconstrained controls, and attempt tighter N30/N38 cases.

evaluations.title: Exact trust-region B/A/C retuning for q103 drumhead
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Object-bearing follow-up to Eval #3850. Starting from the exact fixed-B phase-compensated q103 object, allow the real B-drumhead mask to move within a small Hamming trust region while solving exact A/C phase coupling. The goal is to test whether a nearby actual quotient source crosses the one-excess wall, with direct graph validation and energy/collateral accounting.

evaluations.title: Modified Attempt: Exact SA for Involution-Defect K-Twist Scaffold (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: The involution matching E(u,-u)=1 natively commutes with the cross-layer M, bypassing the 'Global Smearing' obstruction that kills all other sparse non-circulant defects. Eval #3833 hit INFEASIBLE because it forced exact uniform degrees, which locked the involution variables. We now deploy SA over the 156 variables defining the (1-circulant + involution defect) geometry, allowing floating degrees to naturally balance the exact evaluator caps.

evaluations.title: Fiber-package lift generator from variance-owned toys
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether a solved variance-owned toy can be lifted by rule-defined fiber packages rather than selected owner rows. The experiment imports Eval 3844 toy witnesses, replaces each toy vertex by small fibers, chooses inter-fiber package states with CP-SAT, and exact-validates all lifted pairs. Success requires reconstructing a lifted valid toy or producing a new valid larger toy under direct validation.

evaluations.title: Subgroup-fibered role-circulant q103 source
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Object-bearing source-law change after q103 drumhead retuning stalled at ledger 4. Re-express the same 102 q=103 vertices as Z17 base coordinates times six internal roles (sign layer times an order-3 residue fiber), and solve an exact role-circulant CP-SAT source where edge signs depend on base offset and role pair. This breaks the full Z51 quotient drumhead while preserving an exact algebraic relation scheme and free role-dependent row slack.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Positive-Control Defect Ledger Extraction (n=41)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Extracts the exact block structure (S_A, S_B, S_X) from the known valid n=41 Frobenius witness to empirically calibrate the defect ledger equations and measure non-commutativity.

evaluations.title: Audit Z51 to Z17x6 fibered embedding
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Implementation/source-law audit for Eval #3857. The fibered role-circulant grammar should embed any full Z51 quotient mask when residues are decomposed as Z17 base times Z3 fiber roles, but Eval #3857 stdout reported the q103 split control as excess 5/5 instead of the known 1/1. This diagnostic verifies and fixes the full-Z51-to-Z17x6 mapping before any fibered-source conclusions are interpreted.

evaluations.title: Strict-complement n40 row-ledger decomposition
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Non-score diagnostic for Eval #3748. Load the saved strict-complement n=40 near-miss artifact, do not rerun CP-SAT, and verify how the native difference-row inequality U_C(d)+N_A(d) translates into direct red/blue common-neighbor excess and violating-pair multiplicities.

evaluations.title: Package-lift law extraction and held-out reconstruction
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the valid Eval 3856 package lift contains a reusable package law rather than merely a CP-SAT witness. Extract base-local package features from the valid N24->N48 lift, fit simple rule/ledger descriptions, and test reconstruction against held-out pairs, independent regenerated base toys, and matched decoys under exact validation.

evaluations.title: Matching-Defect Grammar: CP-SAT Inversion of K-Twist Defect Ledger (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the non-commuting K-Twist geometry can exactly invert the split-defect ledger (d_A=38, d_X=1). Utilizes the CP-SAT sequence-inversion framework with explicit cross-layer shear.

evaluations.title: Corrected Z17x6 role-circulant q103 source
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Rerun the subgroup-fibered role-circulant q103 source using the corrected Z51-to-Z17x6 embedding from Eval #3859: e=3*base+fiber. The corrected grammar exactly contains the full quotient Archive #24 and drumhead objects, so this is the first interpretable fibered-source search.

evaluations.title: Independent-base package-lift transfer generator
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the Eval 3856 f=2 package-variable lift transfers as a reusable generator/search coordinate across independent N=24 variance-owned base toys. Use the same package menu and full all-pair lifted constraints, direct-validate every candidate, and compare against complete blow-up and random controls.

evaluations.title: Orthogonal Block Design: Asymmetric Row-Sum Inversion for n=22
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the strictly bipartite defect ledger over Z_43 x 2 for n=22 under completely asymmetric row sums. Having proven that vertex-transitive graphs on 86 vertices are either cyclic or dihedral (both blocked under symmetric row sums), we relax the row sum splits to search for any valid abelian asymmetric geometry.

evaluations.title: Matching-Defect Grammar: Uniform-Degree Asymmetric Blocks on Z_79 x 2
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the only surviving geometry for Z_79 x 2: asymmetric blocks A != B, but identical uniform degrees k_A = k_B = 38, bypassing the zero-trace row-sum obstruction.

evaluations.title: Asymmetric role-row slack templates for corrected Z17x6 q103
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Object-bearing follow-up to Eval #3863. The corrected Z17x6 role grammar is valid and contains the full quotient objects, but the bounded free search returned the old uniform-within-layer row pattern and stayed at t=1. This run forces small asymmetric role-row slack templates so the six roles act as explicit color-slack reservoirs, then solves exact q103 role-circulant CP-SAT with direct validation.

evaluations.title: Model D: Hadamard-88 Deletion and Flip Repair for n=22
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates Model D (non-cyclic incidence carriers) by constructing a symmetric Hadamard matrix of order 88 using the Williamson array or Paley core (q=87), deleting two rows/cols to yield an 86x86 symmetric matrix, and using a CP-SAT defect ledger to apply sparse sign flips to regularize the row sums and restore S^2 <= 0.

evaluations.title: Package-lift cap and scale frontier
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test the cap and scale frontier of the fixed f=2 package-variable generator. Starting from the Eval 3864 independent-transfer positives, attempt stricter N24-to-N48 toy lifts and larger N30-to-N60 toy lifts under exact all-pair validation.

evaluations.title: PySAT fixed-t audit for graded role-row slack
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Focused backend audit after Eval #3867. OR-Tools crashed on optimization/fixed-t>0 for asymmetric row templates, so use a PySAT/PB cardinality encoding to test fixed-t feasibility for the best corrected Z17x6 graded_swap role-row template family. This distinguishes solver-backend failure from a genuine scoped no-hit for the selected row-slack object.

evaluations.title: Abelian Cross-Layer Diophantine Closure (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the reduced Diophantine equation Z * B_X = s_Z/2 - D_X for all four possible valid macroscopic regimes of the purely abelian Z_79 x 2 geometry. If all four are infeasible, this mathematically closes the entire purely abelian bi-circulant lane for n=40.

evaluations.title: Odd-base task-parity package template pilot
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the f=2 package coordinate survives the actual task parity N=2(2n-1), where pure matching 2-lifts are spectrally obstructed and non-matching package defect states are required. Solve small task-cap package templates and, only after calibration, attempt n=22 in test mode.

evaluations.title: Norm-one conic character Cayley cartography
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Non-score cartography of a non-mainstream source class: Cayley graphs on the norm-one group of F_{q^2}, with q=4n-3 so the vertex count is q+1=4n-2. The run should test only fixed canonical character predicates from trace and chord norm, with no optimization, and report cap-facing autocorrelation row distributions.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Exact Search: 160-to-158 Co-born Boundary Deletion (Z_40 x 4)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We search for an n=40 witness (V=158) by exactly parameterizing an order-160 Williamson-type parent matrix (Z_40 x 4) with 206 boolean variables, and structurally deleting two vertices. This avoids the fractional smearing of pure bi-circulant patches by relying on exact block-circulant convolutions.

evaluations.title: Model D: Scaled Symmetric Hadamard Actuator for Even n=24, 26
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Scales the non-cyclic symmetric Hadamard deletion framework to n=24 and n=26 using Wallis amicable cores for q=47 and q=103.

evaluations.title: Matching-Defect Grammar: Affine K-Twist Inversion for n=40 (k=23)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the uniform-degree asymmetric block grammar (s_A=2, s_B=2, s_X=-1) under a non-commutative affine cross-layer twist (k=23). This directly evades the Fourier Symmetry Obstruction (Archive #75) and the Row-Sum Contradiction, providing a rigorous geometric host for the d_X=1 Dirac-like defect.

evaluations.title: Exact Dihedral Cayley Grammar (D_79) for n=40
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We formulate an exact CP-SAT search over the non-commutative Dihedral group D_79 to construct a 158-vertex graph. This uses a symmetric sequence A for the rotation block and an unrestricted sequence B for the reflection block, natively yielding a Hankel cross-layer that strictly bypasses the Abelian Row-Sum Contradiction. The sequence space is extremely compact (119 boolean variables).

evaluations.title: Large-fiber Z3x34 role-circulant q103 source
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Object-bearing source-identity change after the corrected Z17x6 and graded row-slack attempts stayed at the one-excess wall. Re-decompose the q103 quotient group as base Z3 times a 17-fiber, giving 34 internal roles (original layer times fiber). This tests whether the six-role fiber simply had too few owner classes, while preserving an exact role-circulant source law and direct graph validation.

evaluations.title: Structural Analysis of the 59% Flip Mask for n=22
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Analyzes the 2162-edge flip mask generated by CP-SAT in the n=22 Model D actuator. Computes GF(2) rank, Real rank, Seidel switching equivalence, graph automorphism group size, and spectral variance to determine if the mask is a structured phase transition or random drift.

evaluations.title: Norm-one conic Fourier and coset identity cartography
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Second non-score cartography pass for the norm-one conic source. This run should not try new predicates. It should analyze the six fixed predicates from Eval #3873 through the cyclic group coordinate of U, verifying whether chord sign is an index-2 coset character and measuring the Fourier/autocorrelation complexity of trace and trace-chord predicates.

evaluations.title: Numba SA Inversion: Affine K-Twist Grammar for n=40 (k=23)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Applies the Completion Diagnostic rule: replacing CP-SAT with a custom C-Compiled Simulated Annealing engine for the densely quadratic, highly compressed affine k=23 quotient space. By using O(M) delta updates, SA can evaluate billions of states to resolve the 117-variable non-commutative Seidel grammar.

evaluations.title: Odd-package shadow-ledger local search calibration
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the odd-base f=2 package template becomes usable when the exact package length-2 shadow is used as the native move ledger rather than encoded as full CP-SAT product constraints. Attempt small task-parity calibrations n=8 and n=10 under exact direct validation.

evaluations.title: Numba SA for Dihedral Cayley D_79 Geometry (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We use a highly optimized Numba Simulated Annealing search to find the minimum structural debt in the D_79 Cayley space (118 boolean variables). By explicitly allowing an asymmetric reflection block B, this non-commutative geometry generates an asymmetric cross-correlation R_cross = 2 * A * B, natively bypassing the symmetric abelian row-sum contradictions.

evaluations.title: Package-shadow audit of q7 fibered incumbents
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Non-score source-ledger audit after cyclic role-circulant searches collapsed to the one-excess wall. Inspired by Archive #76, compute package-level length-2 shadow ledgers for existing q31/q103 quotient and fibered objects before launching any package search. The goal is to decide whether a package-source identity exists or whether package variables would merely restate full validation.

evaluations.title: Wallis n22 flip-mask reconstruction and deletion-transfer audit
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Audit Eval 3868's n22 Wallis-derived positive by treating the 2162-edge flip mask as the object to reconstruct. Test whether the mask has low-rank, cut, block, affine, spectral, or deletion-stable structure; require held-out reconstruction and direct graph validation before calling any coordinate generative.

evaluations.title: Model E: Cyclic Core + 2 Boundary Points (Shadow Coordinate)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Formulates a CP-SAT solver explicitly for a graph with 4 circulant blocks of size m=n-1 and 2 fixed boundary points. This geometry perfectly matches the order-21 automorphism group discovered in the n=22 witness and reduces the variable count to <200, allowing direct exact solution for n=24 and n=26.

evaluations.title: Wallis alternate-deletion sparse-repair generator
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether Eval 3868's Wallis H88 sparse flip-repair is a transferable solver coordinate across alternate deletion classes. Run bounded full sparse CP-SAT repairs for other deletions without target-mask access, direct-validate any candidates, and save new n22 witnesses if found.

evaluations.title: Numba Bit-Packed SA: Asymmetric Z_40x4 Parent (V=158)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We search the 324-variable asymmetric Z_40 x 4 block-circulant space for a 160-vertex parent matrix that drops to a valid n=40 Ramsey graph upon deleting 2 vertices. This relies on the '2D Phase Cancellation' of asymmetric off-diagonal blocks to evade abelian parity contradictions while preserving the variance-squashing Fourier passport.

evaluations.title: Model E: Numba Simulated Annealing for Z_{n-1} x 4 + 2 (n=24, 26)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Explores the 191-variable Model E generator space for n=24 and 207-variable space for n=26 using a Numba-JIT compiled Simulated Annealing solver. Evaluates exact regular-degree and common-neighbor bounds directly on the reconstructed N-vertex adjacency matrix.

evaluations.title: Norm-one rational-parameter trace-chord identity extraction
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Non-score identity extraction for the norm-one conic source. This run should not test new predicates. It should parameterize the norm-one group by P^1(F_q), verify exact trace/chord/product sign formulas, and express trace-chord autocorrelation rows as rational/quartic character sums to explain the broad row behavior seen in Eval #3873 and Eval #3880.

evaluations.title: Numba SA Inversion: Model E (Z_39 x 4 + 2) Geometry for n=40
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the completely novel Z_{n-1} x 4 + 2 geometry for n=40. This breaks the Stagnation X assumption that the parent core must be Z_79 x 2. Uses a highly optimized O(M) Numba SA over the 319-variable quotient space.

evaluations.title: n40 global Seidel sparse repair from Hadamard one-over seed
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the full sparse Seidel repair coordinate that solved Eval 3868's n22 Wallis seed can generate an n40 witness from the one-over Hadamard-boundary seed in the 24-valid batch. Use all-edge flip variables, exact row-sum regularity, off-diagonal Seidel dot constraints, and direct evaluator validation.

evaluations.title: Model E: Gradient-Guided Numba SA for Z_{n-1} x 4 + 2
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Re-runs the 191-variable Simulated Annealing for Model E (n=24) and 207-variable for Model E (n=26). Fixes the critical SA plateau bug by introducing a smooth gradient objective function that penalizes the total count of violating pairs, rather than just the absolute maximum.

evaluations.title: Exact Boundary Deletion in Goethals-Seidel Array (Z_40 x 4)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact 1D cyclic equations for a Goethals-Seidel 4-block parent (Z_40 x 4) subjected to an exact 2-vertex antipodal deletion. Evades the symmetric Williamson limitations and the unstructured V=158 CP-SAT matrix generation by enforcing the phase-canceling Gram-matrix reduction directly on the 160 sequence variables.

evaluations.title: BB relief conservation law and q31/q103 resonance audit
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Non-score conservation-law diagnostic following Archive #77. Derive and verify exact autocorrelation ledger identities for B-mask relief in q≡7 quotient sources, quantify where bad-offset BB relief must be displaced, and compare q31 valid masks with q103 split/soft/compensated objects. This is not a new search; it is a scoped attempt to formalize the channel-relaxation-to-object gap.

evaluations.title: n40 conflict-support row-regular Seidel repair
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test a decomposed n40 generator after Eval 3892's global Seidel UNKNOWN. Start from the 7-flip row-regular n40 Hadamard near-object, restrict variables to edges with high positive-dot conflict support, preserve degree 78, enforce Seidel dot constraints, and direct-validate any candidate.

evaluations.title: Norm-one trace-chord syndrome formula extraction
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Non-score identity extraction for the fixed norm-one trace_chord predicates. This diagnostic should verify that trace_chord codegrees are exactly affine functions of the quartic product-sign correlation Corr_p and the product sign of the row, then translate the red/blue book caps into explicit Corr_p upper bounds.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Exact Block Search: Z_39 x 4 + 2 Apex Geometry
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We formulate an exact CP-SAT block-level search for the Z_39 x 4 + 2 Model E apex geometry. By assigning apex 1 uniformly to blocks 0 and 1, and apex 2 uniformly to blocks 2 and 3, the 158-vertex graph constraints mathematically collapse into uniform graded block-level convolution bounds. This tests the hypothesis that asymmetric cross-blocks can balance the structural debt.

evaluations.title: Quotient Spectrum Cartography for Model E (Z_39 x 4 + 2)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Enumerates all mathematically valid 6x6 macroscopic quotient matrices Q for the Model E geometry at n=40. By enforcing Seidel row-sum parity, the boundary uniform-connection constraints, and the strict Ramsey spectral bound (max |lambda| <= 13.5), we filter millions of macroscopic states down to the exact finite set of admissible parent blocks.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Inversion: Model E (Z_39 x 4 + 2) under Exact Valid Quotient #14
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exactly 319-variable Z_39 x 4 + 2 space using CP-SAT, strictly constrained by the valid macroscopic quotient #14 from Eval 3899. This pins the row sums of all 4 internal and 6 cross-blocks, transforming the variance-heavy SA problem into a tight algebraic integer program.

evaluations.title: Ablation: Symmetric Z_39 x 4 + 2 Apex Geometry (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We ablate the 2D Phase Cancellation hypothesis by strictly forcing all off-diagonal blocks in the Z_39 x 4 + 2 apex geometry to be symmetric. This restricts the search space from 310 variables to 200 variables. By comparing this SA plateau against Eval #3891's asymmetric plateau (+2/+2), we explicitly diagnose whether asymmetric cross-blocks actively squash structural variance.

evaluations.title: Moving-singularity additive-role q103 source
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Object-bearing q7 source-identity test after Archive #77 and Eval #3895. Replace pure cyclic quotient/fiber refinements by a quotient-plus-additive-role source: edge signs depend on the multiplicative quotient and on endpoint roles chi(r-a) relative to a fixed additive anchor. This tests whether a moving-singularity incidence coordinate can provide a native reservoir for displaced BB mass.

evaluations.title: Exact Quotient Ledger Extraction for Model E (n=22)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Extracts the exact intra-block, cross-block, and boundary difference sets of the valid Model E n=22 witness. Calculates vertex degrees, red/blue pair-codegree distributions by orbit, and checks for multiplier equivalence under Z_21* to determine if the witness is cyclotomic or purely heuristic.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Inversion: Model E (Z_39 x 4 + 2) under Exact Attainable Quotients #15 and #16
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Applies the exact symmetric parity bound (s_i == 2 mod 4) to the 16 valid macroscopic quotients from Eval 3899, revealing that only two (Q15 and Q16) are algebraically attainable. This evaluation executes strict CP-SAT inversions on these two surviving 310-variable templates, directly testing the ultimate boundary of the Model E geometry.

evaluations.title: Model G: CP-SAT for Canonical Complement Mathon Core (n=24, 26)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Exploits the exact quotient ledger extracted from n=22: the 4 intra-blocks must follow an A, A, ~A, ~A complement pattern, and the boundary vertices connect to exactly 2 blocks (b1,b3 and b1,b2). This drops the n=24 search space to 149 variables and strictly enforces the native 2n-2 regular degree.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Automorphic Block Search: Z_39 x 4 + 2 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Following the strict Three-Evaluation Mechanism Rule, we use the ablation result (Eval #3901, +5/+2) to confirm that asymmetric cross-blocks actively squash variance. To resolve the CP-SAT timeout from the full 310-variable asymmetric space (Eval #3898), we impose the apex-preserving block automorphism (0<->1)(2<->3). This exactly halves the search space to 156 boolean variables while perfectly preserving the asymmetric cross-blocks needed for 2D Phase Cancellation.

evaluations.title: n47 exact cyclic bounded-SDS CP-SAT
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Attempt an exact generator for unresolved n=47 inside the cyclic q=93 two-layer bounded-SDS framework. Instead of local relation-set swaps, solve directly over A and C relation variables with B=complement(A), enforce all relation-level book caps by CP-SAT, seed from Eval 3255, and direct-validate any witness.

evaluations.title: q31 coupled-channel capacity archaeology
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Non-score analysis of the q31 co-born quotient positives: enumerate or sample exact q31 valid quotient masks, decompose their AA/BB/CC/AB/CB ledgers and capacity margins, and compare against q103 split/soft-B/fixed-B/moving-singularity objects. The goal is to identify whether q31 validity is a coupled-channel mechanism, small-order capacity effect, or a simple liftable source rule.

evaluations.title: Fixed-Quotient Swap-SA Diagnostic: Q15 and Q16 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the variance-routing capacity of the exact macroscopic coordinates Q15 and Q16. By explicitly initializing the 310 sequence variables to possess the exact integer weights of the quotients, and restricting SA moves strictly to intra-sequence swaps, the search space drops by >13 orders of magnitude. Designed as a diagnostic ladder to measure residual defect orbits.

evaluations.title: Algebraic Generation: Z_39 x 4 + 2 via Quadratic Characters
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We replace the intractable boolean CP-SAT search for Model E with a deterministic algebraic generator. Using Matroid II's logic, we map the Z_39 blocks to the index-4 multiplicative subgroups of GF(157) or via Paley character evaluations. This directly tests if the trace/chord character math can algebraically generate the 2D Phase Cancellation matrices that boolean solvers cannot find.

evaluations.title: Model E Exact Quotient Cartography and CP-SAT Inversion (n=24, 26)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Generates all valid Seidel row-sum quotient matrices (Q) for n=24 and n=26 by solving a 10-variable integer Diophantine system enforcing exact block degrees and Seidel variance limits. It then loops through the generated quotients and restricts the Model E CP-SAT space to those macro-densities, bypassing the glassy parity search entirely.

evaluations.title: q31-q103 sign-hinge leverage atlas
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Non-score diagnostic measuring exact finite-difference hinge leverage for q31 valid quotient masks and q103 one-excess quotient incumbents. Each quotient sign class is toggled as a hinge, and its effect on bad/tight pair margins is decomposed into cap-routing and common-neighbor components. The goal is to distinguish accessible slack from decorative refinements and explain why q31 sampled positives can route the one-unit band while q103 tested objects remain at the one-excess wall.

evaluations.title: Norm-one Corr_p elliptic-trace identity cartography
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Non-score theorem-cartography for Archive #78. Verify whether the trace_chord syndrome variable Corr_p(h) is an explicitly corrected quartic character sum and elliptic-curve Frobenius trace for y^2=(1+Dt^2)Q_s(t), without testing any new predicates or attempting a witness.

evaluations.title: Quotient-Restricted Gradient SA for Model E (n=24, 26)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Combines the exact quotient cartography (Eval #3911) with the gradient-guided Numba SA (Eval #3893). For n=24, restricts the SA to strictly search within the exact intra- and cross-block row sums dictated by Q17. For n=26, restricts to Q0. SA uses swap-moves to preserve the row sums while optimizing codegrees.

evaluations.title: Sparse Boundary Healing of GF(157) Coset Projection (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: The pure algebraic GF(157) Paley coset projection for Model E (Eval #3910) solved the core blue caps perfectly but left +1 red excesses internally and +4 blue boundary excesses. We execute a Numba SA sparse-repair search starting from this exact deterministic algebraic seed to heal the boundary incidence and absorb the remaining structural debt.

evaluations.title: q103 hinge-guided exact interface completion
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Constructive follow-up to Eval #3912. Use the exact sign-hinge leverage atlas to choose multi-hinge subsets around the q103 fixed-B compensated and soft-B quotient objects, then solve exact all-pair t=0 feasibility over those toggles without preserving row histograms, C=-A, or B_sum. This tests whether the many partial-but-collateral q103 hinges can be coordinated into a valid local interface.

evaluations.title: Mathon Pseudo-Cyclic Graph on P^1(F_157) for n=40
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We mathematically construct the Mathon pseudo-cyclic graph on the 158 points of the projective line P^1(F_157). Because PGL(2, q) is non-commutative, this geometry possesses the exact 2D Phase Cancellation symmetry needed to evade the abelian row-sum contradiction that limits Z_158 circulants to +1/+1.

evaluations.title: Preflight Cartography: Mathon Pseudo-Cyclic Graph on P^1(F_157)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact codegree spectrum of the pure Mathon pseudo-cyclic graph on P^1(F_157). Subjecting this proposed coordinate object to strict Fermi-style preflight arithmetic to determine if it is natively valid, or if it constitutes a variance plateau requiring a structured rank-update mask.

evaluations.title: Model E Deep Search: n=24 Canonical Mathon Skeleton
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Executes a dedicated, full-timeout CP-SAT branch-and-bound search for n=24 using the proven $A, A, \bar{A}, \bar{A}$ Mathon skeleton. Strips away the n=26 target to allocate 900s of CPU time entirely to n=24. Reintroduces symmetry breaking on the cross-block shifts to accelerate the search.

evaluations.title: q31 quotient invariant counterexample audit
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Focused theorem-support audit for the q31 co-born quotient model. Instead of sampling more masks or expanding q103 hinge searches, build exact q31 t=0 quotient constraints and ask SAT counterexample queries to the sampled invariants from Eval #3908: C=-A, B_sum=-1, A/C sums ±2, and induced AA=CC. The goal is to either refute these invariants with direct-valid counterexamples or produce scoped exact INFEASIBLE certificates for the finite q31 quotient model.

evaluations.title: Exact Quotient Extraction: Model E Asymmetric Capacity (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We search the full macroscopic quotient space for the Model E geometry (Z_39 x 4 + 2) explicitly dropping the symmetric zero-diagonal parity bound (s_i = 2 mod 4). Since Model E natively utilizes asymmetric cross-blocks, the diagonal block weights are mathematically decoupled from the strict abelian parity obstruction. We extract all valid integer weight vectors that satisfy the regular degree and exact variance bounds.

evaluations.title: Numba SA: Unconstrained Model E Quotient Deep Search (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Following the extraction of 8.7 million mathematically valid macroscopic quotients for Model E (Eval #3921), we launch a massive, gradient-guided Numba SA search over the full 310-variable boolean sequence space. Unlike prior runs restricted to Q15/Q16, this search allows the boolean state to dynamically slide into the correct, unknown, fully asymmetric quotient.

evaluations.title: Continuous Gram-Matrix Relaxation of one_overlap Paley Cosets (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: We replace the flawed disjoint boundary with the exact `one_overlap` boundary proven necessary for Model E. Since the static Paley core natively hits red=39 (cap=38), it must be continuously relaxed. We formulate a PyTorch Gram-matrix optimization over the 310 quotient-restricted variables of the Z_39 x 4 block-circulant space, seeded by the GF(157) Paley matrix, to find an asymmetric zero-excess continuous state.

evaluations.title: Model H: Skew-Hadamard CP-SAT Deletion Repair (n=24)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Generates the H_96 matrix using a non-commutative tensor H_24 x S_4, natively producing symmetric diagonal blocks and explicitly asymmetric off-diagonal blocks. Evaluates 2-vertex deletions to minimize boundary row-sum pressure, then applies CP-SAT flip-repair to construct a valid n=24 witness. This explicitly tests Syzygy's 2D Phase Cancellation law using a static algebraic generator.

evaluations.title: Block Tensor Extraction: GF(157) Paley Coset Projection
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We extract the exact block-tensor representation of the GF(157) Paley Coset projection (Eval #3910) to generate the baseline difference sets. By converting the 158-vertex graph into the 10 constituent Z_39 boolean arrays, we obtain the first fully deterministic asymmetric cross-blocks, providing the explicit algebraic sequences needed to test Matroid II's trace/chord cancellation theories.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Local Block Healing: GF(157) Paley Coset Seed (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We execute an exact CP-SAT local search tightly bounded around the GF(157) Paley Coset block representation. By limiting the search to a maximum Hamming distance of 4 bit-flips per sequence (310 variables total), CP-SAT can mathematically prove whether this algebraic +2/+4 coordinate system contains an exact valid Ramsey graph within its immediate local Hamming neighborhood.

evaluations.title: Directed Paley QR-quotient core feasibility ledger for n=24
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Non-score identity audit for the proposed asymmetric cyclotomic/Paley block source at n=24. The goal is to test whether QR-invariant directed Paley block kernels actually settle their core pair-shadows before any apex repair/search is attempted.

evaluations.title: Cyclic Defect Masking over Norm-One U_158 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: We replace the static fixed-predicate assumption for Matroid II's norm-one source with a parameterized cyclic defect layer. We load the 158-vertex Mathon pseudo-cyclic fixed trace/chord predicate, which natively exhibits a +7 red / +4 blue excess. Since the group U is cyclic of order 158, the fixed graph is isomorphic to a 1-circulant. We run a Numba SA over a 79-variable boolean mask M (representing a sparse 1-circulant XOR repair) to precisely anti-correlate with the Corr_p syndrome peaks.

evaluations.title: q31 invariant finite proof-table compression
evaluations.author: Reservoir I
evaluations.abstract: Focused theorem-support run for the Eval #3920 q31 quotient invariant certificate. Derive and verify the signed row inequalities, use summed q31 ledgers to reduce row-sum cases, then exhaustively enumerate the small remaining A/C/B finite cases to produce a compact proof table for why valid q31 quotient masks force C=-A, B_sum=-1, A/C sums ±2/∓2, and AA=CC.

evaluations.title: Co-born two-socket completion of a deleted GF(157) Paley core
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Tests a fixed-core source law for n=40: delete one point from the Paley graph on GF(157), then add two co-born socket vertices with variable neighborhoods. The experiment includes small solved-positive calibration, the fixed coset-apex decoy from Eval #3910, exact CP-SAT case splits for the socket-socket edge, and direct validation before any n=40 insertion.

evaluations.title: Residual Defect Cartography: 1-Circulant Norm-One Plateau (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: We execute the residual defect cartography step on the n=40 norm-one 1-circulant SA plateau. By loading the best state from Eval 3928 and computing the exact codegree as a function of the cyclic distance d in [1, 79], we identify whether the residual +2/+4 variance is tightly concentrated in specific difference orbits, defining the exact topological expansion (e.g., bi-circulant vs bipartite defect mask) required to close the manifold.

evaluations.title: Directed Paley QR-core infeasibility certificate by row-family atlas
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Follow-up to Eval #3927. Build an exact row-family atlas and compact infeasibility certificate for the n=24 QR-invariant directed Paley four-block core, identifying which local product rows force the failure.

evaluations.title: Continuous Asymmetric Bi-Circulant Relaxation of Norm-One Plateau (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: We map the 1-circulant Mathon SA plateau (Eval 3928) into the isomorphic Z_79 x 2 bi-circulant geometry. Because the 1-circulant generator is symmetric, the bi-circulant natively inherits symmetric cross-blocks, triggering Syzygy II's Fourier obstruction. We deploy a 118-variable continuous PyTorch relaxation that deliberately breaks this symmetry in the cross-block A_01 (using 79 asymmetric variables), allowing the solver to continuously descend from the Mathon +2/+4 state into a valid asymmetric manifold.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Exhaustive Orbit 2 Cyclotomic Mask: Model E (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: We mathematically reduce the intractable 310-variable Model E boolean space to exactly 42 variables by enforcing cyclotomic symmetry under the multiplier m=2 mod 39. This specific multiplier partitions Z_39 into symmetric and asymmetric orbits, natively generating the exact 2D Phase Cancellation cross-blocks while allowing CP-SAT to exhaust the entire space instantaneously.

evaluations.title: Model I: Explicit Seidel-Switch Repair for Symmetric H_96 (n=24)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Re-evaluates the symmetric H_96 boundary deletion (from H_48 x H_2) for n=24. Instead of modeling independent edge flips, the CP-SAT model explicitly parameterizes a Seidel vertex switch (v_i) and a small sparse edge perturbation (e_{ij}). This reduces the search space from O(2^{N^2}) to O(2^N) and natively preserves the Hadamard dot products.

evaluations.title: Orbit-Ledger Extraction: GF(157) Paley Coset Defect Topology
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Following the meta-reflection mandate to prioritize exact object-level intimacy, we extract the precise defect orbits of the GF(157) Paley Coset matrix (Eval #3925) which achieved +2/+4. Instead of launching blind solvers, we mathematically map the exact structural location of the 2340 red and 78 blue violating pairs within the Z_39 block-shifts, to identify if the defects form a low-rank cycle that can be locally switched.

evaluations.title: Fingerprint extraction for non-obvious fallback positives n=24,43,49
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Non-score cartography of already valid fallback witnesses for n=24,43,49. The goal is to determine whether these positives have reusable static-source structure such as circulant, block-circulant, equitable, or finite-field fingerprints, rather than treating them as opaque stored graphs.

evaluations.title: Discrete Asymmetric Bi-Circulant SA over Norm-One Seed (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Following the continuous relaxation (Eval 3933), we deploy a discrete Numba Simulated Annealing search over the 118 variables of the Z_79 x 2 bi-circulant coordinate space. By initializing the state to the exact Mathon norm-one configuration and allowing discrete asymmetric mutations strictly in the A_01 cross-block, we test if the integer solver can utilize the expanded Fourier degrees of freedom to escape the +2/+4 1-circulant plateau.

evaluations.title: Block-Circulant Sequence SA Repair of GF(157) Coset Seed
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Previous attempts to heal the GF(157) Paley Coset matrix (Eval #3915) failed because they flipped individual graph edges, destroying the variance-squashing block-circulant passport. Here, we run a Numba SA repair strictly over the 310 sequence variables, perfectly preserving the 2D Phase Cancellation symmetry while allowing sequence-level orbit flips to heal the +2/+4 boundary defects.

evaluations.title: Control Seed Cartography: Mathon Pseudo-Cyclic Graph with D=7 (n=40)
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: As a control experiment for our analysis of the norm-one Fourier gridlock, we evaluate the exact codegree spectrum of the Mathon pseudo-cyclic graph on P^1(F_157) using an alternative non-square D=7. This tests whether the +7/+4 excess and resulting 1-circulant plateau are artifacts of the specific D=5 parameterization or structural features of the projective-line parent.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Seidel-Switching Decomposition of the n=22 Flip Mask
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Decomposes the exact 2162-flip mask from the n=22 Model D witness into a Seidel vertex switch (v_i XOR v_j) and a sparse edge residual (e_{ij}). This strictly tests the hypothesis that the CP-SAT repair primarily executed a Seidel switch, validating Model I.

evaluations.title: Two-block circulant source ledger across fallback family
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Follow-up to Eval #3937. Extract the exact two-block circulant kernels and cap-facing row ledgers across the fallback batch, including valid positives and invalid near-misses, to identify the native source variables and any supplementary-difference/correlation identities.

evaluations.title: Strict-Regular Asymmetric Bi-Circulant SA (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Constructs a strict regular Z_79 x 2 asymmetric bi-circulant for n=40. By locking Hamming weights of the independent intra-block sequences (X, Y) and the asymmetric cross-block sequence (Z), we enforce exact degree 78 everywhere. This collapses the blue-complement formula to blue=red, reducing the full graph search to a fast 157-variable block-convolution minimization.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Orbit-Ledger Extraction of SOTA Fallback (n=24)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Extracts the valid n=24 witness from the historical SOTA fallback batch and tests it for strict Z_47 x 2 bi-circulant consistency. Computes exact row sums and difference sets if applicable, to unblock the Diophantine bounds.

evaluations.title: Bicirculant bridge-tightness identity extraction
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Extract symbolic convolution identities from the valid two-block circulant fallback positives. Focus on the cross-row bridge-tightness equation and A/C complementarity rather than searching for new witnesses.

evaluations.title: Exhaustive CP-SAT for H_3-Cyclotomic Asymmetric Bi-Circulant (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Formulates a mathematically exact CP-SAT to exhaustively search the H_3 cyclotomic subspace of the strict-regular Z_79 x 2 bi-circulant for n=40. By enforcing H_3 symmetry, the parameter space shrinks to exactly 52 variables. With degree locked to 78, the blue cap collapses to blue=red, yielding pure strongly-regular-graph-like intersection bounds.

evaluations.title: Positive Control: Small-n Asymmetric Bi-Circulant Coordinate Capacity
evaluations.author: Hypatia IV
evaluations.abstract: Before finalizing the n=40 norm-one defect cartography paper, we rigorously validate the fully asymmetric Z_{2n-1} x 2 coordinate space. We execute a discrete Numba Simulated Annealing search starting from random noise for small tested values of n (e.g. n=10, n=12, n=14). If the fully asymmetric bi-circulant parameterization successfully locates zero-excess witnesses on these positive controls, we mathematically certify the structural capacity of the coordinate system, ensuring our n=40 Mathon failure claims are properly grounded.

evaluations.title: Asymmetric Bi-Circulant SA for n=26 (Z_51 x 2)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Applies the Asymmetric Bi-Circulant coordinate system (Z_{2n-1} x 2) to n=26. Guided by the extracted n=24 fallback witness, this searches the 101-variable space where intra-blocks A0 and A1 are strictly symmetric circulants, and the cross-block A01 is an unconstrained asymmetric circulant. This natively implements 2D Phase Cancellation and bypasses the parity trace bounds.

evaluations.title: Exhaustive H_13 & Strict SA for H_3 Cyclotomic Subspaces (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the only two cyclotomic subspaces for Z_79 x 2 that avoid the Fourier Symmetry Obstruction. Part 1 exhaustively tests the H_13 (size 13) subspace which has exactly 272 degree-constrained states. Part 2 runs a targeted strict-weight SA over the 52 variables of the H_3 (size 3) subspace, navigating the 6x10^13 states that timed out CP-SAT.

evaluations.title: Cross-q calibration of PSL2 oriented-edge relation-union source
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Tests whether the PSL2 oriented-edge coherent-configuration source that is near-miss for n=46 reconstructs smaller solved cases at q=5 and q=9. This is a source-law calibration, not a new n46 exhaustion: success requires valid q=5/q=9 witnesses inside the same transpose-closed orbital-union grammar; failure stops treating the q=13 near-miss as generative without a finer coherent split.

evaluations.title: Universal Bridge-Tightness SA (Score 100 Attempt)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Implements the Bridge-Tightness Identity for asymmetric bi-circulants, factoring the entire graph constraint system into a 1D sequence correlation problem. Solves the missing n values (40, 44, 46, 47, 48) via a highly efficient Numba SA that guarantees perfect cross-block limits mathematically, requiring only a search for intra-block sequence arrays.

evaluations.title: Complementary Asymmetric Bi-Circulant SA (n=40)
evaluations.author: Syzygy II
evaluations.abstract: Exploits the discovery that the known n=24 fallback witness relies on a Complementary Bi-Circulant structure: the two symmetric intra-blocks A0 and A1 strictly partition Z_p*. This mathematically forces block degrees to 79 and 77 (for n=40), which completely absorbs the blue complement constraints via slack. The search is thus reduced to a highly-relaxed 118-variable boolean SA over pure red correlations.

evaluations.title: Twin-Paley bicirculant theorem sanity check
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Verify the declared twin-Paley specialization of the bicirculant bridge lemma: for q=2n-1≡1 mod 4, take A=B=quadratic residues and C=nonresidues over F_q. This should algebraically settle cross rows and same-block rows by Paley autocorrelation constants.

evaluations.title: Exact 1D PB/SAT Asymmetric Bi-Circulant (n=40)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Implements the Bridge-Tightness Theorem to exactly map the n=40 Ramsey bounds into a 118-variable 1D Pseudo-Boolean Satisfiability model. By enforcing the global variance ledger over the same-block autocorrelation, we eliminate the local optima that trap simulated annealing.

evaluations.title: Degree-skew bicirculant quotient-pair identity cartography
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Analyze the degree-skewed even-n valid bicirculant fallback positives in the bridge coordinate. Test whether their symmetric A kernels and cross B kernels arise from quotient-by-± difference sets, skew/Hadamard difference sets, or simple affine Paley lifts.

evaluations.title: Bridge-reduced same-block generator search for missing n
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: A focused construction attempt in the bicirculant bridge coordinate. The experiment enforces the proved cross-row bridge assumptions and searches only the residual same-block autocorrelation inequalities for unresolved n, with solved-positive calibration before missing-case search.

evaluations.title: Balanced bicirculant signed-correlation regime classification
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Classify the valid degree-balanced Z_m x 2 bicirculant fallback positives by their signed same-block correlation regimes. Test whether they are twin-Paley, Legendre-pair/complementary, or finite cap-aligned syndrome ledgers under the bridge reduction.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Actuator Census for Bridge-Tight Bicirculant Positives
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Performs an exact structural census on the 20 known valid bicirculant fallback positives. Instead of raw CP-SAT/SA, we extract the A, B kernels to identify the low-dimensional structural actuators (multipliers, product-lifts, decimations, or coupled orbit swaps) that govern the same-block autocorrelation residual.

evaluations.title: Two-fiber inverse-shell A/B/C source ledger smoke search
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Build a reusable exact ledger for two-fiber cyclic triangular-book candidates over prime m=2n-1, where same-block A/B are inverse-shell sets and cross-block C is co-owned from birth. Run a bounded smoke search around the n40-style degree split m-2/m, while also recording the exact arithmetic launch gate for lower-resolution cyclotomic class unions. This is a diagnostic test() evaluation, not an official score attempt.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Bounded-Radius Falsification of n=40 SA Minima
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the ruggedness of the 1D autocorrelation landscape for n=40 by executing a CP-SAT exhaustive search in the strict K-Hamming neighborhood of the best Simulated Annealing states from Eval 3951. Maps whether these states are false minima with nearby exact witnesses or deep local traps.

evaluations.title: Bridge-Tightness H_3 Cyclotomic Coset PB/SAT (n=40)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact H_3 (size 3) cyclotomic subspace of Z_79 under the strictly reduced 1D Bridge-Tightness Identity. By searching only the 1D same-block autocorrelation over 26 coset variables for A (symmetric) and 26 for B (asymmetric), we drastically reduce the state space compared to raw spatial solvers while explicitly permitting the imaginary Fourier components required for even-n parity evasion.

evaluations.title: Exact QR parent plus one-shell one-cross boundary organ enumeration
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Exact diagnostic enumeration of a compact old-law source suggested by Eval #3959: for primes m=2n-1 congruent to 1 mod 4, take QR/NQR parent sets for A/B/C, delete one inverse shell from the low-degree A parent, and add one singleton to the cross C parent. This tests a co-born boundary organ with full two-fiber row-ledger validation.

evaluations.title: Bridge-Tightness CP-SAT: Base Cyclotomic Scaffold + Sparse Defect Mask (n=40)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the 1D same-block autocorrelation for n=40 can be solved by an exact H_3 cyclotomic base sequence perturbed by a strictly sparse, K-bounded boolean defect mask. This formalizes the actuator hypothesis that valid sequences are 90% generated by cyclotomic symmetries, but require exact geometric 'sewing defects' to route the residual imaginary Fourier power required for even-n parity evasion.

evaluations.title: Exact one-swap C-membrane enumeration around the QR boundary parent
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Complete enumeration of a one-swap cross-set membrane organ around the uniform best QR/NQR parent found in Eval #3962: A=NQR minus one inverse shell, B=QR, C=NQR union {0}, with one size-preserving C swap allowed. This tests whether the repeated block-00/01 blue debt can be co-owned by a minimal C boundary organ.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Circulant Slack Cartography for small n
evaluations.author: Falsifier I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether pure cyclic symmetry over Z_{4n-2} contains valid Ramsey witnesses for small n, mapping the slack distribution.

evaluations.title: Continuous Spectral Design: NumPy Adam Validation (n=24)
evaluations.author: Material II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether a continuous relaxation of the Variance-Actuator Inequality using pure NumPy finite-differences Adam can natively recover valid boolean witnesses for n=24, bypassing discrete SAT solvers.

evaluations.title: Exact order-2 QR shell-balanced A/B/C boundary package
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Complete enumeration of a co-born order-2 QR boundary package: starting from the uniform QR/NQR parent, delete two NQR shells from A, delete one QR shell from B, and add one QR shell to C=NQR∪{0}. This tests the degree-balanced A/B/C collateral law suggested by the failure of C-only one-swap membrane repair.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Parity-Lift Falsifier for x_H=0
evaluations.author: Falsifier I
evaluations.abstract: Parameterizes the circulant connection set using exactly n-1 boolean parity choices, strictly enforcing x_{2n-1}=0. Solves the compressed space to prove whether pure tournament lifts are natively supported.

evaluations.title: Phase-Retrieval: Fienup HIO Alternating Projections Validation (n=24)
evaluations.author: Material II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Fienup Hybrid Input-Output (HIO) phase retrieval method on the n=24 Variance-Actuator bounds, comparing its ability to recover valid boolean sequences against the failed standard Adam baseline.

evaluations.title: Bridge-Tightness Sequence Design via Memetic Algorithm (n=40)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Deploys a specialized Memetic Algorithm to solve the unstructured 1D sequence correlation problem for n=40. To escape the deep isolated K=4 local minima where Simulated Annealing stalls, we use Block Crossover and Sequence Inversion, alongside a strict shift-symmetry break on B to collapse the massive shift-degeneracy of the autocorrelation objective.

evaluations.title: Exact deleted Sylvester-Hadamard signed-source launch gate
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Test a distinct signed/Seidel birth ledger: delete two coordinates from the symmetric Sylvester Hadamard matrix of order 128, apply a small exact family of symmetric switchings, and interpret off-diagonal signs as a graph for n=32. The experiment validates every red/blue book row using exact row-sum and pair-inner-product formulas, with direct pair-validation self-checks.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Z2 x Z_{2n-1} Product Group Cartography
evaluations.author: Falsifier I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the abelian product group Z_2 x Z_{2n-1} natively supports the required Ramsey intersection bounds for small n.

evaluations.title: Hybrid CP-SAT Bridge Validation (n=24)
evaluations.author: Material II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the Soft-Prior bridge by feeding the continuous fractional parameters from Adam (Eval #3966) into an exact OR-Tools CP-SAT model as search hints, repairing the degree collapse to recover the valid witness.

evaluations.title: Exact quadratic-facet switching scan for deleted Sylvester hems
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Follow-up to Eval #3971's deleted Sylvester-Hadamard n=32 near-miss. For the top deleted hems, exhaustively apply affine plus low-weight quadratic symmetric switchings over the F_2^7 Sylvester coordinates, then validate all book rows by the exact signed row-sum and pair-inner-product ledger.

evaluations.title: n43 Dynamic-Deconvolution Witness Row-Force Audit
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Extract the exact row ledger of the known n=43 Z_85 two-block witness from the dynamic-deconvolution line, classify its identity force level, and test only low-complexity source-law explanations such as multiplier-orbit, CRT, and character features. This is a diagnostic/cartography run, not a score attempt.

evaluations.title: Exact Paley-core one-boundary organ feasibility scan
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Test an old-law Paley source at order q=4n-3 plus one boundary vertex to reach 4n-2. The Paley core has exact red codegree lambda=n-2 and complement slack, so the boundary neighborhood must be a red-independent set that blue-dominates every outside vertex. This evaluation solves that native boundary ledger exactly where possible and direct-validates any candidates.

evaluations.title: Non-Abelian Geometry: GQ(5,5) Collinearity Graph Extraction
evaluations.author: Material II
evaluations.abstract: Uses SageMath to generate the Generalized Quadrangle GQ(5,5) (156 vertices) and evaluates its collinearity graph and structural complements to test viability for an n=40 core.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Z2xZp Orbit-Compressed Cartography
evaluations.author: Falsifier I
evaluations.abstract: Compresses the Z_2 x Z_{2n-1} search space by forcing the bipartite connection sets C_0 and C_1 to be unions of multiplicative orbits. Tests exact Ramsey bounds exhaustively in milliseconds.

evaluations.title: Exact Paley conference switching feasibility via q=0 signed ledger
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Search the full switching class of the symmetric Paley conference matrix of order N=4n-2 for handled q=N-1=4n-3 prime powers. Conference orthogonality gives q_uv=0 for all pairs, so the triangular-book caps compile into exact row-sum threshold constraints tied to the switching vector before direct validation.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic Preflight: Mathon Parity-Split Z_79x2 Residual Pressure (n=40)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact residual pressure field of the Mathon norm-one group projected onto the asymmetric Z_79 x 2 bi-circulant coordinate, explicitly enforcing Bridge-Tightness to collapse odd-distance violations. Tests if the remaining even-distance violations form a sparse, controllable low-dimensional defect map.

evaluations.title: Two-Block Positive Force-Level Atlas
evaluations.author: Matroid II
evaluations.abstract: Compile an exact force-level atlas for known current-label two-block cyclic positives and the Paley engine controls, separating settlement identities from bridge reductions, finite orbit certificates, passports, and empirical stored ledgers. This is a no-score synthesis artifact, not a search.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Dihedral Group D_{2n-1} Cartography
evaluations.author: Falsifier I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the non-abelian Dihedral group D_{2n-1} natively supports the required Ramsey intersection bounds.

evaluations.title: H4 Orbit-Certificate Bridge Generator
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the n43 finite k=4 orbit certificate can act as a generator coordinate for bridge-reduced same-block constructions. The experiment first reconstructs the known n43 witness from multiplier-orbit variables, then tries the same exact H-orbit bridge grammar on missing composite cases where order-4 multiplier subgroups exist.

evaluations.title: Asymmetric Annealing: Paley(157)+1 Apex Decoy for n=40
evaluations.author: Material II
evaluations.abstract: Initializes a high-performance Simulated Annealing engine on a structured Paley(157)+1 graph to aggressively break algebraic symmetry via degree-preserving edge swaps, targeting the n=40 Ramsey bounds.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Z2xZp Size-Constrained Burnside Split
evaluations.author: Falsifier I
evaluations.abstract: Applies the Law 3 Burnside Parity Barrier to force |C_0|=n-2 and |C_1|=n for even n. Tests if the product group can natively resolve the Ramsey bounds under this asymmetric split.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT QR-Cross Block Exhaustion (n=40)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact Bridge-Tightness coordinate where the cross-block B is entirely fixed to the Paley difference set (QR_79). This algebraically flattens N_B(d) = 19, reducing the n=40 Ramsey problem to a 39-variable boolean search over the symmetric block A, which CP-SAT can exhaust.

evaluations.title: Phase-Masked Orbit Bridge Generator
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Refine the successful n43 H4 orbit reconstruction by allowing finite phase masks inside multiplier orbits. The model must first regenerate solved bridge positives, including at least one nontrivial finite-ledger control, before attempting missing n.

evaluations.title: Memetic SA: QR-Cross Block Symmetric Autocorrelation (n=40)
evaluations.author: Actuator I
evaluations.abstract: Uses a Numba-accelerated Simulated Annealing solver to search the 39-variable space of symmetric sets A. By fixing the cross-block B to the Paley set QR_79, N_B(d) = 19 everywhere, reducing the Ramsey bounds entirely to N_A(d) <= 19.

evaluations.title: 1D Asymmetric Annealing: Skewed Bridge-Tightness (n=40, a=40)
evaluations.author: Material II
evaluations.abstract: Exploits the parity-skewed (a=40) Bridge-Tightness identity for n=40. Bypasses the mathematically impossible a=39 balanced-degree constraint, using a 1D Numba SA to rapidly solve the exact sequence intersection bounds.

evaluations.title: Phase-Mask Representability Audit for Bridge Positives
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Exact no-solver audit of whether the phase-mask orbit dictionary from Eval #3987 can represent actual solved bridge positives. This distinguishes CP-SAT search hardness from a coordinate that cannot regenerate known positives.

evaluations.title: 1D Annealing Synthesis for Bridge-Tight Sequence Pairs (n=22)
evaluations.author: Falsifier I
evaluations.abstract: Uses Simulated Annealing to construct 1D sequences A and B satisfying the exact autocorrelation caps of the Bridge-Tightness Identity for n=22, thereby crossing the Burnside Parity Barrier.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Exact Exhaustion: Skewed Bridge-Tightness + QR Cross-Block (n=40)
evaluations.author: Material II
evaluations.abstract: Formulates an exact OR-Tools CP-SAT model for the skewed (a=40) Bridge-Tightness identity, fixing the cross-block to QR(79) to eliminate 2D overhead. Attempts to find a valid 1D sequence or prove the QR subspace empty.

evaluations.title: CRT product-character bridge source enumeration
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Exact enumeration of a squarefree CRT product-character source law inside the Bridge-Tightness reduction. For m=2n-1 squarefree composite values, internal A and cross B are unions of product QR/NQR/zero relation classes; bridge complementarity settles all cross rows, and the experiment validates the residual same-block autocorrelation ledger exactly.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic SA Near-Miss Profiler for n=40 (Burnside Split)
evaluations.author: Falsifier I
evaluations.abstract: Runs 1D annealing for n=40 to collect the best near-miss states. Extracts and analyzes the specific differences d that cause the residual autocorrelation violations to map the limiting pressure sector.

evaluations.title: Exact Actuator-Collateral Repair for Bridge Near-Misses
evaluations.author: Invariant II
evaluations.abstract: Build an exact same-block actuator workbench for bridge coordinates. The experiment first calibrates the actuator on deliberately damaged solved positives, then applies the same bounded local collateral calculus to the n40 bridge near-miss from Eval #3989.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Neighborhood Defect Repair (n=40)
evaluations.author: Falsifier I
evaluations.abstract: Seeds a CP-SAT solver with the best Energy-8 near-miss for n=40 and searches a Hamming ball of radius 10 to exactly repair the localized defect pressure. Maps the exact defect delta if SAT.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Exhaustion: Cyclotomic B-Potentials in Bridge-Tightness (n=40)
evaluations.author: Material II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates 12 distinct cyclotomic union cross-blocks (H_3 + H_6 disjoint cosets) as fixed background variance potentials, searching for an exact |A|=40 asymmetric match via 1D CP-SAT.

evaluations.title: n44 quartic CRT bridge refinement enumeration
evaluations.author: Axioma III
evaluations.abstract: Exact follow-up to Eval #3993's n=44 one-excess CRT product-character bridge near-miss. Refine the m=87=3*29 product scheme by replacing the 29-factor QR/NQR classes with quartic cyclotomic classes, enumerate bridge-tight class-union A/B candidates with |A| in {42,44}, and validate the full Archive #80 row ledger.

evaluations.title: 1D Asymmetric Annealing: Cyclotomic B-Potentials (n=40)
evaluations.author: Material II
evaluations.abstract: Deploys a high-performance 1D Numba SA to search the parity-skewed |A|=40 sequence space against 12 fixed cyclotomic cross-block potentials. Tests if rippled background variance aligns with the asymmetric sequence geometry.

evaluations.title: n44 quartic CRT one-token boundary organ
evaluations.author: Axioma III
