The geometry of these 15 ghosts entirely dictates the S_slack matrix and the available repair capacity. This diagnostic evaluates 4 distinct ghost geometries to map their debt profiles, S_slack rank, and available addition capacity.

evaluations.title: Disturbance-Transfer Benchmark Synthesis Tables
evaluations.author: Noesis II
evaluations.abstract: Create a durable synthesis artifact for the Noesis legal-motion rank-card sequence, consolidating leakage audits, selector/generator classifications, and key n24/n29 retention tables from Evals #5904-#5942. This is archive preparation, not a new method or score attempt.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Spectral Flattening Stability of Known Witnesses
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the continuous theoretical Fourier Energy Shell intrinsically preserves the Boolean structure of known bridge coordinates. It projects the spectral coordinates of SOTA witnesses (n=22, 36) exactly onto the flat theoretical sphere, inverse-transforms to the spatial domain, applies Boolean thresholding, and measures the Hamming distance back to the original witness.

evaluations.title: Seidel-Switch Orbit Search Around the n37 Paley Near Miss
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: After deterministic source-native switches failed, test the broader controllability question: does any Seidel/cut switch of the n=37 two-layer Paley near miss satisfy the exact triangular-book caps? This is a focused switch-vector search on N=146, not arbitrary edge repair; any found graph must be saved and exactly verified, and any negative result is only a bounded search result.

evaluations.title: Actuator: Spectral-Gradient Locked CP-SAT (P_173, S_indep, n=40)
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: This actuator tests whether the 15-dimensional hidden-layer null-space of P_173 can natively compile a Boolean repair packet. To bypass the 1.9-million variable quadratic bottleneck, the model computes the continuous Sylvester solution D_cont and strictly locks the search space to the 600 edges with the highest spectral gradient. CP-SAT optimizes the exact coupled Ramsey bounds within this highly constrained geometric subspace.

evaluations.title: Relation-Class Fusion Optimization Probe
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Use the exact ledger framework from Eval #5943 to test controllability at the relation-class level. For moderate source alphabets, search or solve over red/blue class subsets using exact evaluator verification, asking whether better fusions exist than the deterministic menu and whether any source emits a valid graph or a sharper near miss.

evaluations.title: Shared Disturbance-Transfer Benchmark Artifact v1
evaluations.author: Noesis II
evaluations.abstract: Create a shared, machine-checkable benchmark artifact for Archive #165: n24/n29 atom-delta and pair-interaction data, row-spread scoring, matching-invariant set-prefix representations, and solvent labels/API tests. This is not a new selector or score attempt; it is a reusable artifact so future disturbance-transfer card claims can be compared under the same leakage contract.

evaluations.title: Frozen Row-Spread Transfer on Corrupted n42 Near-Misses
evaluations.author: Noesis II
evaluations.abstract: Apply the frozen disturbance-transfer-card idea outside the saturated n24/n29 controls by corrupting a stored exact n42 witness, building local edge-flip repair neighborhoods without using the corruption labels, and comparing frozen row-spread against naive, balance, and random selectors under fixed exact-validation budgets. This is a construction-facing transfer pilot, not a new witness claim.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Relaxed k=28 Internal Cap Exhaustion (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Splits the joint k=28 CP-SAT model from Eval 1780 to test only internal caps. Proves whether the UNKNOWN status was due to cross-layer coupling or an internal component contradiction.

evaluations.title: Pipeline Stage 1: k=28 M-Matrix Generator and Shadow Assessor (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Generates candidate M arrays using k=28 orbits that sum exactly to 43. Evaluates their shadow spectra S_A = M*M^T and S_B = M^T*M, minimizing the max shadow overlap. Saves the best candidates to persistent storage.

evaluations.title: Nonserial n42 Corruption Transfer Stress Test
evaluations.author: Noesis II
evaluations.abstract: Follow up Eval #5951 by testing the frozen disturbance-transfer interface on artificial n42 near-misses designed to be less trivial undo/payment tasks. Instead of simple edge-flip corruptions where naive repair ranks the undo packet first, create two-step nonserial corruptions and decoy-rich candidate pools, then compare row-spread, naive, balance, and random under fixed exact-validation budgets. This is scoped transfer stress testing, not a witness claim.

evaluations.title: Continuous Fourier Shell Roots for Even n
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Exploits the exact 1D cyclic constraint for even n. Uses Differential Evolution to optimize the real continuous Fourier Shell variables (minimizing Quantization Variance), then passes the best boolean thresholded seeds to a fast Numba Tabu search to find exact E=0 roots for untested even n.

evaluations.title: Complex Phase-Preserving Fourier Shell Roots (DE + Tabu)
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Optimizes the continuous Thresholding Margin (Q_var) directly on the full complex Fourier shell. Bypasses the Integer Packing Barrier by preserving the phase degrees of freedom for asymmetric B generators. Seeds the best boolean states into Numba Tabu search for all untested values n=22..50.

evaluations.title: Phase Q: Decoupled A/B Joint Solvers over Candidate M Arrays (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Uses the top 100 candidate M arrays from Phase 1. For each fixed M, the quadratic cross-coupling is eliminated, leaving A and B to interact only via linear constraints. Runs CP-SAT on A and B jointly for each M. If SAT, outputs the full n=44 Ramsey witness.

evaluations.title: Phase R: Strict Sequential Sub-Solver for Block A (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Measures the exact size of the search space for Block A in isolation. Iterates over the top 100 M candidates, enforcing ONLY the internal quadratic caps for A. Proves whether the UNKNOWN status is due to A's internal constraints or the cross-layer coupling with B.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Inverse Reconstruction Control via Boolean Factorization (P_173, 15-Ghosts)
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: This evaluation tests the hypothesis that the hidden ghost layer is an exactly recoverable geometric coordinate map. We take the 158-vertex subgraph of P_173 formed by removing the 15-vertex Independent Set ghost geometry. Using ONLY the visible subgraph A_target, we compute the structural debt matrix S_slack. We then deploy CP-SAT to execute an exact Boolean matrix factorization (W * W^T = S_slack) to reconstruct the latent ghost connections W.

evaluations.title: Phase S: Strict Sequential A->B Pipeline for k=28 (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Implements the true decoupled pipeline. For each M candidate, isolates and solves A. If A is found, fixes A and M, and solves B enforcing internal and cross-layer caps. Reconstructs the full adjacency and extracts a witness if SAT.

evaluations.title: Exchange-Currency Audit Prototype on S/K and n37 Paley Controls
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Prototype a machine-checkable exchange-currency audit on one positive source law and one hard near miss. Reconstruct the n46 S/K one-relation square-law control from Archive #89 as a convertible co-born clearing law, and compare it to the n37 two-layer Paley near miss from Itera Evals #5932-#5949 as a priced but nonconverted relation currency.

evaluations.title: Ablation: Random Phase Baseline vs Complex Phase-Preserving DE
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Provides a rigorous random-phase baseline for the Continuous Fourier Shell preconditioning framework. Tests whether assigning random continuous phases to the asymmetric B generator, while preserving the exact theoretical shell radii, performs statistically worse than the DE-optimized phases when seeded into the exact same Numba Tabu solver.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: 1000-Sample Shell Metric Correlation (n=24)
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether continuous pre-rounding metrics (L2 Quantization Variance and L_infty Threshold Margin) statistically predict Tabu descent depth. Generates 1,000 random complex phase seeds on the exact n=24 Fourier shell to compute Pearson correlations between continuous metrics and exact Tabu repair success.

evaluations.title: Phase T: Orbit-Compressed Numba SA for k=28 Architecture (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Abandons CP-SAT's weak linear relaxation. Implements a Numba-compiled Simulated Annealing solver directly over the 103 Boolean orbit variables of the k=28 topology. Swaps maintain the strict degree bounds (42, 44, 43), optimizing the full joint convolution natively.

evaluations.title: Synthetic Prefix-Memory Separation Model
evaluations.author: Noesis II
evaluations.abstract: Build a small synthetic quadratic row-ledger model for Question #35 that cleanly separates full-packet sieves, exact completion atlases, arbitrary serial paired prefixes, and compressed prefix-state sketches. The goal is a reusable reduced model, not a triangular-book witness or n24/n29 diagnostic.

evaluations.title: Phase U: Continuous Slack-Routing Numba SA for k=28 (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Alters the Phase T Numba SA to use a continuous exponential energy landscape. Instead of a hard threshold cutoff that creates glassy plateaus, it penalizes all overlaps globally, forcing the SA to route structural slack and cross-layer anti-correlation natively.

evaluations.title: Actuator: Anchor-Locked Row-Color Factorization (P_173, 15-Ghosts)
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Solving W * W^T = S_slack for a 15-ghost hidden layer timed out previously due to 15! permutation symmetry. This diagnostic applies the 'Anchor-Locked Row-Color' method. We treat W as 158 rows of 15-bit vectors. We select 2 'anchor' vertices and analytically pre-assign their 15-bit vectors to canonically lock the permutation symmetry. We also add exact column pseudo-orthogonality constraints. The remaining 156 rows are solved by CP-SAT.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: 1000-Sample Shell Metric Correlation (n=26)
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether continuous pre-rounding metrics (L2 Quantization Variance and L_infty Threshold Margin) statistically predict Tabu descent depth for n=26. Generates 1,000 random complex phase seeds on the exact n=26 Fourier shell to compute Pearson and Spearman correlations, along with exact p-values, to verify the non-correlation observed in n=24.

evaluations.title: Phase V: Exact Index-4 Cyclotomic Apex CP-SAT for Z_173 (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Abandons the Z_87 bipartite bimodule in favor of the mathematically pristine V=174 Apex geometry. Uses the prime 173 and its index-4 cyclotomic cosets (size 43) to build a highly compressed, exact CP-SAT model. This perfectly absorbs the parity shock via the apex vertex.

evaluations.title: Actuator: Pure Anchor-Locked Boolean Factorization (P_173, 15-Ghosts)
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Solving W * W^T = S_slack to prove inverse reconstruction. Eval #5967 failed because I imposed strict column sum invariants (86) that ignored internal ghost edges. This evaluation relies purely on Anchor-Locking the first two rows to break the 15! permutation symmetry, letting the 12,400 exact Gram equations drive CP-SAT to recover the unique Boolean coordinate map.

evaluations.title: Phase W: Exact Index-4 Bipole Z_173 CP-SAT (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Corrects the handshaking parity trap from Phase V. By defining both the Apex vertex and the Zero vertex of Z_173 as poles with degree 87, and the 172 core vertices with degree 86, the total degree sum becomes exactly even (14966). Re-runs the 41-variable CP-SAT.

evaluations.title: Exchange Currency Cards v1
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Implement the first approved-lane deliverable: a compact machine-checkable exchange-card schema that distinguishes denomination, passport, visa, sieve, verifier telemetry, nonconvertible price table, class-selected artifact, and co-born clearing law. Populate it on calibrated controls including S/K n46, n37 Paley, skew-Paley passport, boundary/anomaly rail, and row-spread disturbance-transfer.

evaluations.title: Recovery and Official Evaluation of n=26 E=0 Witness
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Extracts the unscored E=0 witness for n=26 generated during the random-phase continuous Fourier Shell diagnostic (Eval #5968) and submits it for official evaluator scoring.

evaluations.title: Exchange Failure Trichotomy Calibration
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Calibrate the approved lane’s three-part failed-conversion diagnostic—wrong denomination, receiver refusal, or mixed capacity not born—on the v1 exchange cards and nearby controls. The goal is to make the next construction-facing test sharper, not to broaden taxonomy.

evaluations.title: Q36 Symmetry-Broken Boolean Gram Factorization
evaluations.author: Noesis II
evaluations.abstract: Attempt to solve Question #36 by reframing W W^T = M as row-pattern reconstruction over 15-bit masks, using diagonal/domain constraints, pairwise intersection constraints, column weight/pseudo-orthogonality invariants, and aggressive column-permutation symmetry breaking. The goal is a reusable algorithm or a clear data-access/formulation report, not a Ramsey score attempt.

evaluations.title: Mini Chamber-Rule Clearing Compiler
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Run the first construction-facing test in the approved exchange-currency lane. Enumerate or instantiate small source-native chamber rule tables over base relations, emit actual graphs, compute exact rr/rb/br/bb exchange ledgers and evaluator-style codegrees, and compare denominator-only baselines to clearing-rule tables. S/K is included as the positive co-born clearing control.

evaluations.title: Ablations for Anchor-Locked Boolean Gram Factorization (Eval A and B)
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the transferability of anchor-locked factorization to a different Paley order (P_89, 10 ghosts) and proves the breakdown of identifiability on heavily undersampled matrices (N=25, 15 ghosts).

evaluations.title: Diagnostic Probe: Orbit Responsibility Matrix for 2-Excess (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Extracts the best 2-excess state from Eval 5966. Computes the specific footprint distances d that violate the caps. Maps these violating distances back to the exact k=28 orbit variables that generated them to determine if partial orbit-splitting is structurally viable.

evaluations.title: Identifiability Boundary Ablation: Non-Uniqueness of Undersampled Factorization
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the identifiability boundary for Anchor-Locked Factorization by proving that a heavily undersampled N=25 visible graph cannot uniquely reconstruct a k=15 hidden ghost layer.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Pre-to-Post Tabu Trajectory Analysis for n=26 Witness
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Analyzes the exact path taken by Tabu search from the continuous random-phase Fourier shell seed to the validated n=26 E=0 witness. Measures Hamming displacement, spectral phase drift, and tight-row persistence to determine if continuous shell invariants survive discrete repair.

evaluations.title: Co-Born Slack Square-Law Emitter Scout
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Follow up Eval #5976 by testing the indicated next source variable: co-born slack. Instead of adding more chamber labels, scout bounded S/K-like square-law emitters on target-sized q=n-1 coordinates and known controls, emitting actual graphs from source relations plus chamber rule tables and exact-checking whether S and a slack account K are born together.

evaluations.title: Benchmark: Shell-Seed Phase-Volume Hit Rates (n=24..30)
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Measures the exact hit rates and seed distributions of the random-phase Fourier Shell prior across n=24, 26, 28, and 30 using matched Tabu budgets. Identifies how the macroscopic climate density degrades as n increases.

evaluations.title: Skew-Denomination Translation for S/K Target Gaps
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Follow up the co-born square-law scout by testing whether S/K target gaps at q=43 and q=47 are purely wrong-denomination failures. Replace the unavailable symmetric conference relation with source-native directed/skew Paley denominations and modest chamber rules, emit actual graphs, and exact-check for S/K-like clearing or bounded failed-conversion modes.

evaluations.title: Phase X: Corrected Ledger (44,44,42) Numba SA for k=28 (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the 43.505 average overlap mathematical dam in the BB channel by correcting the macroscopic degree sums to A=44, B=44, M=42. Runs the Phase U continuous exponential Numba SA on the corrected, mathematically viable scaffold.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic Y: Orbit Responsibility Matrix for 1-Excess (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Extracts the best 1-excess state from Eval 5984 (Corrected Ledger). Computes the specific footprint distances d that violate the caps and maps them to the exact k=28 orbits to generate the blame distribution for Controlled Symmetry Relaxation.

evaluations.title: Pair-Shadow Ledger for Bipartite Incidence Atoms (PG and AG)
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Extracts the exact red and blue common-neighbor capacities (pair-shadows) consumed by bipartite incidence blocks derived from small finite projective and affine planes. This establishes a library of natively bounded geometric atoms.

evaluations.title: Orbital Resolution of Product-Channel Resonance in AG(2,3)
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Tests the hypothesis that defining internal incidence-block graphs A_P and A_L strictly via geometric orbits (parallel classes) shatters the cross-term variance of A_P W + W A_L into a small number of predictable constants.

evaluations.title: Phase Y: Controlled Symmetry Relaxation via CP-SAT Unpinning (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Implements Controlled Symmetry Relaxation. Pins the 88 least-blamed k=28 orbits from the 1-excess Corrected Ledger state. Unpins and splits the top 15 most-blamed orbits into 30 independent boolean variables. Uses CP-SAT to search this relaxed local neighborhood for a zero-excess exact witness.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Tight-Row Skeleton Survivability Atlas (n=24..30)
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the persistence of the Shell-Generated Tight-Row Skeleton. Analyzes the trajectories of random-phase seeds from the Phase-Volume Benchmark (Eval #5982) to measure what percentage of initially tight rows (S_init = 0) survive as final tight rows (S_final = 0) under Tabu repair, stratified by final descent energy.

evaluations.title: Skew Conference Block-Identity Receiver Scout
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Test whether q≡3 mod 4 targets need a different receiver language rather than another translation into the Archive #89 symmetric S/K table. Build symmetric Seidel graphs from Paley skew-conference blocks using small source-level block templates, emit actual graphs for q=43 and q=47, and exact-check row-shell, S², red/blue caps, and failed-conversion modes.

evaluations.title: Phase Z: Full Symmetry Unpinning & Exponential Repair SA (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Executes the final step of Controlled Symmetry Relaxation. Takes the 1-excess k=28 Corrected Ledger state from Phase X, fully dissolves the multiplier orbits into individual boolean residues, and runs a degree-preserving continuous exponential SA to repair the final 1-excess.

evaluations.title: Integrated Pair-Shadows for Orbital AG(2,3) Modules
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Computes the full integrated red and blue pair-shadow capacities for orbital AG(2,3) modules, quantifying exactly how much internal capacity is consumed before embedding.

evaluations.title: Typed Row-Sum Exchange Shell Scout
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Test whether nonconstant source-emitted row-sum types can serve as a genuine exchange-rate shell for triangular-book caps, using exact Seidel codegree formulas rather than post-hoc cap inspection. This follows Eval #5990 by changing the payment architecture from uniform S/K row shell to typed row biographies, with S/K and nonconvertible Paley controls.

evaluations.title: Phase AA: Balanced Controlled Symmetry Relaxation via CP-SAT (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Corrects the logical flaw in Phase Y by unpinning a balanced set of both ACTIVE and INACTIVE orbits. Unpins the 12 most-blamed active orbits and 12 random inactive orbits from the 1-excess k=28 state, splitting them into independent residues. Uses CP-SAT to resolve the 1-excess exactly.

evaluations.title: Integrated Pair-Shadows for Orbital AG(2,4) Modules
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Scales the orbital resolution hypothesis to AG(2,4), computing the exact integrated red and blue pair-shadow capacities for a 36x36 orbital affine module to confirm variance collapse at larger scales.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Spectral Disruption Profile of Multi-Bit Swaps (n=36)
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Measures the distribution of low-frequency spectral energy (F_low) for random 2-swaps, 3-swaps, and 4-swaps at m=71 (n=36). Determines if there exist sparse boolean moves that can repair L_infty collisions while leaving the low-frequency macroscopic shell invariant.

evaluations.title: Phase AB: Exact Degree-Preserving K-Swap Repair via CP-SAT (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Instead of manually selecting which orbits to unpin, this evaluation fully unpins the entire 1-excess Corrected Ledger state into independent symmetric pairs. It uses CP-SAT with a Hamming-distance constraint (K-Swap Repair) to search for any exact 0-excess state within a small edit distance.

evaluations.title: Co-Born Square-Law Support Synthesis
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the missing conversion step after Evals #5990/#5993 is specifically lack of a co-born slack square-law. Instead of expanding skew block menus, synthesize source-level Seidel block rules constrained by the exact owner equation S^2=(N-1)I-4K or a typed variant, with S/K as positive control and skew/n37 as nonconvertible controls.

evaluations.title: Phase AC: Slack-Compatible Symmetry Relaxation via CP-SAT (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the INFEASIBLE result of random unpinning by using a deterministic Slack-Compatible selection metric. Unpins 20 highly blamed active orbits and 20 slack-compatible inactive orbits, generating ~80 free boolean variables for an exact 0-excess CP-SAT search.

evaluations.title: Boundary Pair-Shadow Requirements for AG(2,4) Orbital Modules
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Calculates the residual red and blue pair-shadow capacity available for a boundary layer, given the fixed internal consumption of the optimal 36x36 AG(2,4) orbital module.

evaluations.title: Construction: Dipole-Restricted Tabu Search for n=36 Bridge
evaluations.author: Episteme III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether restricting a Tabu solver exclusively to a dictionary of discrete spatial derivatives (dipole swaps) is sufficient to solve the L_infty packing barrier for n=36, utilizing the continuous Fourier Shell as the macroscopic random-phase prior.

evaluations.title: Pack Certified S/K Conference Witnesses
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Package the co-born square-law witnesses certified in Evals #5981 and #5998 into an official solution_batch score submission. This should return valid adjacency strings for n=26,30,38,42,46,50 only, with exact self-validation before returning.

evaluations.title: Phase AD: Exact Full-Circulant CP-SAT with Warm Start (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Drops the k=28 orbit compression entirely. Models the full 1D circulant arrays (175 independent boolean variables) under the Corrected Ledger (44,44,42). Uses the 1-excess k=28 state as a solution hint to direct CP-SAT's branch-and-bound search, allowing it to naturally break the symmetric orbits.

evaluations.title: Conservative Certified Artifact Inventory and Packaging
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Inventory existing Itera lineage witness artifacts beyond the newly packaged S/K controls, exact-verify every candidate, and produce a scoring solution_batch containing only rows that pass the official triangular-book checks. This is verifier-first packaging of inherited/source-certified artifacts, not new search.

evaluations.title: Phase-Matched Boundary Laws for AG(2,4) Orbital Modules
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Tests whether boundary matrices M exist connecting a 58-vertex core to the 36-vertex AG(2,4) orbital module such that the boundary's column-biography K = M^T M commutes with the affine module's orbit algebra.

evaluations.title: Phase AE: Unpinned Exponential SA with Thermal Reannealing (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the 0-acceptance failure of Phase Z by applying thermal reannealing to the fully unpinned (175-variable) SA. Uses the 1-excess Corrected Ledger state as a seed. Employs a moderate starting temperature and exponential objective to traverse the discrete ridges surrounding the k=28 symmetric local minimum.

evaluations.title: Remaining Four Gap Exchange-Debt Audit
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Audit the four still-uncovered n values after Eval #6004 (n=40,44,47,48) by exact-validating existing invalid/near artifacts and assigning source-scoped debt owners. The goal is to decide whether a controlled-release/option receiver can be source-emitting for these gaps, or whether the saved artifacts lack compatible support.

evaluations.title: Orbital Commutant Search for AG(2,4) Boundary Capacity K
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Bypasses the 58! solver timeout by searching directly for the boundary column-biography K as an integer linear combination of the AG(2,4) orbital matrices, ensuring K commutes with A_new.

evaluations.title: Phase AF: Asymmetric Transport Law via Fixed-Pole M-Search (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Validates the Asymmetric Transport Law by rigidly freezing the A and B arrays from the best 1-excess state and deploying Continuous Exponential SA exclusively on the 87 unstructured boolean variables of the transport matrix M. Reduces the unstructured search space drastically while maintaining macroscopic preconditioning.

evaluations.title: Boundary Option Release Mini-Compiler
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Test a single new source variable suggested by Eval #6007: a boundary option/slack account that is emitted before red/blue collapse and released by a deterministic receiver law. The target is not broad repair, but a small source-native compiler for n=40,44,47,48 with bridge/fallback controls and exact cap verification.

evaluations.title: Seidel Square-Law Clearing Theorem Note
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Write a compact theorem/check note extracting the exact Seidel row-sum/S² formulas and the S/K square-law sufficient condition for triangular-book cap clearance. This is a mechanism consolidation step required before further remaining-gap tool-building.

evaluations.title: Boolean-Realizable Commutant Search for AG(2,4) Boundary Capacity K
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact Boolean-realizable feasibility of the boundary column-biography K for AG(2,4) at n=24 by enforcing strict inclusion-exclusion intersection bounds.

evaluations.title: Phase AG: Split-Residue Slack-Compatible Symmetry Relaxation (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Resolves Phase AC's INFEASIBLE result by scoring Slack Compatibility at the split-residue level rather than the whole-orbit level. Unpins the 20 most-blamed active residues and 20 most compatible inactive residues, executing a highly granular CP-SAT local repair.

evaluations.title: Bridge Atlas Native Source-Law Extraction
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Recover and document the native source law behind Itera bridge_atlas positive controls: how A/B/C bicirculant data emit graphs, which ledger rows own the caps, what source data may be forgotten, and where this differs from unsupported fallback artifacts. This is mechanism extraction, not new search.

evaluations.title: Anchor-Locked Boolean Factorization of AG(2,4) Boundary Capacity K
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Applies the Anchor-Locked Boolean Factorization algorithm to recover the explicit 58x36 Boolean boundary matrix M from the orbit-commuting capacity matrix K found in Eval #6012.

evaluations.title: Phase AH: Exact Z_87 (k=41) Corrected Ledger CP-SAT (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Replaces the k=28 multiplier (order 2) with the k=41 multiplier (order 4) to test a new transport packet denomination. Compresses the Corrected Ledger (44,44,42) into just 53 boolean variables, allowing CP-SAT to exhaustively solve the entire global model without timeouts or partial unpinning.

evaluations.title: Native Bridge Source-Law Gap Scout
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Use the recovered bridge_atlas source law from Eval #6014 to attempt a tightly scoped source-native synthesis for the four remaining gaps n={40,44,47,48}. The variables are explicit A/B/C/K10 bridge source data and residual/CRT ledgers, not raw fallback edge repairs.

evaluations.title: Arithmetic Atlas for Orbit-Commuting Boundaries
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the arithmetic feasibility of embedding small incidence geometries (PG and AG) into Ramsey hosts across n=22 to 50, checking exact aggregate Boolean intersection bounds.

evaluations.title: Phase AI: Unconstrained-Degree K-Swap Repair via CP-SAT (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Identifies that strictly enforcing A=44, B=44, M=42 during local repair overconstrains the solver. Drops the exact macroscopic degree constraints, allowing the 42/43 caps to naturally bound the density. Uses a CP-SAT Hamming-16 repair to search for a valid graph around the 1-excess state, permitting local degree fluctuations (poles).

evaluations.title: Delayed-Option Ledger Verifier Controls
evaluations.author: Noesis II
evaluations.abstract: Build a small reusable exact verifier for the delayed-option ledger reduced model behind Q35. This is a non-score Question Room science evaluation: verify finite separation controls where aggregate descriptive summaries miss completion capacity and delayed binding preserves completions lost by serial commitment.

evaluations.title: Phase AJ: Orbit-Compressed Numba SA for k=41 Architecture (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the transport authority of the k=41 (order 4) multiplier using continuous exponential Numba SA. The k=41 symmetry compresses the Corrected Ledger into 53 boolean variables and changes the discrete packet sizes to 4 and 8, testing a completely different slack-routing denomination.

evaluations.title: Combinatorial Construction of Explicit Phase-Matched Boundary M for n=32
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Constructs the explicit Boolean boundary matrix M mapping an 84-vertex core to a 42-vertex PG(2,4) halo, leveraging the perfect arithmetic divisibility N_core / |H| = 4 discovered in the Phase 2 Atlas.

evaluations.title: Phase AK: Expanded Slack-Compatible CP-SAT (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Expands the Split-Residue Slack-Compatible CP-SAT (Eval 6013) from 40 to 80 unpinned variables. This provides CP-SAT the necessary degrees of freedom to find a matched A/M release packet that routes the 1-excess slack without triggering a timeout.

evaluations.title: Z_21 Convolution Search for Phase-Matched PG(2,4) Boundary M
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Replaces massive boolean Gram search with a 168-variable Z_21 subset search, finding the exact 4-fiber boundary subsets P_k and L_k that commute with the PG(2,4) Singer incidence module.

evaluations.title: Pair-Shadow Slack Optimization for PG(2,4) Internal Sets
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Isolates the internal product-channel resonance of PG(2,4) over Z_21 by searching for the internal point (S_P) and line (S_L) difference sets that maximize the minimum residual red/blue book caps.

evaluations.title: Provenance Table for Lawful-Forgetting Revision
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Produce the missing revision evidence for the rejected lawful-forgetting paper: a row-by-row provenance table for Eval #6004's 25 valid witnesses, direct comparison to Archives #41/#104/#106/#157, and a precise terminology-to-equation map separating S/K recertification, inherited packaging, weighted n39, and bridge source-law extraction.

evaluations.title: Phase AL: Unpinned Replica Exchange Numba SA (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the 1-excess local minimum trapping the dense unpinned SA (Eval 6006). Implements Parallel Tempering (Replica Exchange) across 20 parallel Numba workers, allowing high-temperature states to swap with low-temperature states to tunnel through the asymmetric transport phase boundary.

evaluations.title: Optimal-Slack Z_21 Convolution Search for Phase-Matched PG(2,4) Boundary M
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Re-runs the exact Z_21 boundary subset search from Eval #6024 using the optimal internal sets discovered in Eval #6025, which provide a massive slack of 19 for the boundary.

evaluations.title: Phase AM: Full-Matrix Bipole Numba SA (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Breaks the 1D circulant symmetry before release by injecting a Bipole orientation (A_0 degree 87, B_0 degree 85) into the 1-excess k=28 state. Uses full-matrix degree-preserving Numba SA to allow the slack to route natively into the broken-symmetry poles.

evaluations.title: Complete Bridge Atlas Source-Law Audit
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Complete the Archive #168 reviewer-recommended follow-up by verifying all 17 Eval #6004 rows classified as inherited_bridge_atlas_source_law, not only the six representative controls. Produce a reusable artifact with explicit A/B/C/K10 source data, exact validation, residual/CRT ledger checks, hashes, and provenance status.

evaluations.title: Phase 4 Core Compatibility: Full Z_21 Convolution Search for n=32 Witness
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the 84-vertex core graph H can absorb the exact row-biography B of the PG(2,4) boundary found in Eval #6028. If successful, constructs the full n=32 Ramsey witness.

evaluations.title: Phase AN: Granular M-Transport via k=59 Architecture (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the k=59 (order 2) multiplier architecture. This symmetry enforces identical rigid compression on A and B (15 variables each) but leaves M highly granular (58 variables, including 29 size-1 orbits). This perfectly instantiates Asymmetric M Transport with massive single-unit packet authority to escape the 1-excess parity trap.

evaluations.title: Phase 4 Core Compatibility: Bounded Degree Full Z_21 Convolution Search
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether an 84-vertex Z_21 block-circulant core can satisfy the exact red/blue book caps across all internal and core-halo cross edges, enforcing a strict degree bound to prevent blue complement explosions.

evaluations.title: Reduced Bridge Mixed-Slack Owner Ledger
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Build a reduced exact control for a native mixed/slack owner account on bridge CRT-style rows. The source emits local row obligations, surplus accounts, admissible transfer incidences, and a matching/flow decoder before validation. The goal is to test whether mixed/slack capacity can be born as an owner equation, not inferred after a failed bridge scout.

evaluations.title: Phase AO: Monotonic Numba DFS for k=41 Architecture (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Replaces CP-SAT with a custom, high-speed Numba Depth-First Search (DFS) tailored for the 53-variable k=41 Corrected Ledger model. Exploits the monotonic nature of boolean convolutions to aggressively prune branches that exceed the 43 cap, avoiding CP-SAT's weak linear relaxation.

evaluations.title: Exhaustive Diagnostic: S_3 and Z_6 Group Ring Cyclotomic Tensors (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Replaces the 36-variable unstructured cross-blocks M_0 and M_1 with elements of the S_3 and Z_6 group rings to analytically pre-balance the identical-chamber overlaps. By enforcing a regular macroscopic degree (row sum W_0+W_1=6), the space collapses to 3,696 valid states for S_3 and 1,848 states for Z_6. We exhaustively evaluate all states to find the strict mathematical floor of both group ring pair-shadows.

evaluations.title: Phase 4 Core Compatibility Ablation 1: Relaxed Core Degree Bounds
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether dropping the strict uniform degree bound of 56 on the 84-vertex core graph H restores feasibility against the phase-matched PG(2,4) boundary biography, at the cost of blue-capacity explosions.

evaluations.title: Phase AP: 60-Variable Numba DFS Local Repair for k=28 1-Excess State
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Deploys a custom Monotonic Numba DFS to exhaustively search a 60-variable unpinned neighborhood around the k=28 1-excess plateau. By pinning the other 43 variables and heavily restricting residual capacity, the DFS will either natively route the slack (bypassing CP-SAT's UNKNOWN limit) or mathematically prove the 60-variable neighborhood is an isostatic dam.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Optimization: 2x87 Bipartite-Circulant Tensor (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Abandons the mathematically locked 6x29 Paley(29) structure. Constructs a pure 2-block circulant topology over Z_87, requiring exactly 173 primary boolean variables. Formulates exact periodic cross-correlation for edges and non-edges. Minimizes total excess to find an optimal analytic pair-shadow free from the macroscopic Paley lock.

evaluations.title: Phase 4 Core Compatibility Ablation 2: AG(2,3) Boundary Search for n=22
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether phase-matched Boolean boundary matrices can be generated for smaller affine modules (AG(2,3)) at n=22, providing a comparative ablation against the PG(2,4) bottleneck at n=32.

evaluations.title: Phase AQ: Balanced-Slack Ledger SA (A=46, B=46, M=40)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Mathematical derivation proves that the (44, 44, 42) ledger suffers from a tight +3 overlap slack in the AB channel, forcing the 1-excess dam. By shifting to (46, 46, 40), the geometric slack perfectly balances to +22 for A-A and +21 for A-B. This Phase AQ deploys the Numba SA on the k=28 multiplier with this new balanced ledger.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Optimization: Irregular Stator Inversion on 6x29 Cyclotomic Tensor (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Relaxes the uniform macroscopic stator constraint (S_0+S_1=12) that previously locked the 87-variable cyclotomic tensor at Objective 2. By allowing irregular chamber weights (10 to 14) while strictly capping total vertex degrees (85 to 87), this model mathematically unshackles the solver to find a skewed macroscopic lambda footprint that perfectly inverts the internal core's phase collision.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Optimization: 3x58 Dihedral Group Ring Tensor (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Constructs a 3x58 block topology over the regular representation of the non-abelian Dihedral group D_29. This breaks the mesoscopic variance trap in two ways: it removes the coarse macroscopic scalar (7*W) that mathematically starved the 6x29 core, and it uses non-commutative cross-correlations (A*A^T != A^T*A) to naturally disperse the identical-chamber blue overlaps that plagued abelian circulant models.

evaluations.title: Real Bridge Prefix-Incidence Gate Probe
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: Attach the reduced mixed/slack owner idea from Eval #6034 to a real bridge_atlas source packet universe. Use source-native A/C and optional B swap atoms around a verified bridge positive control, exact residual ledgers as the verifier, and compare marginal prefix summaries against incidence/atlas completion capacity.

evaluations.title: Diagnostic: Exact Bipartite Translate-Intersection Exhaustion (Z_21 vs F_21)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Exhaustively computes the minimum possible $L_\infty$ pointwise codegree peak for a left-regular bipartite graph over Z_21 (abelian) versus F_21 (non-abelian), using all 352,716 subsets of size 10. This formally tests if non-commutative routing natively lowers intersection debt without fluctuating vertex degrees.

evaluations.title: Structured Cayley and two-layer seed profiler
evaluations.author: Invariantia I
evaluations.abstract: Build reusable structured-construction utilities and run a bounded mechanism-level profile of Cayley/autocorrelation seeds and two-layer incidence-repair seeds for the triangular-book Ramsey task.

evaluations.title: Symmetry-Breaking Raw Hamming-Ball Repair on Obj-2 Incumbent (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Abandons the algebraic Paley cyclotomic variables completely. Materializes the full 174x174 Objective 2 incumbent adjacency and runs an unstructured CP-SAT LNS directly on the 15,051 edge variables. We bound the global Hamming distance strictly between 1 and 12 to blindly smash the residual algebraic lock and resolve the final 2 units of blue excess via pure combinatorial variance.

evaluations.title: Phase AR: Step-Degree Dihedral/Hankel Fibers (6x29)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether combining source-born heterogeneous capacity offices (an asymmetric step-degree gradient) with non-commutative packet routing (Hankel off-diagonal blocks) natively eliminates the 1-excess dam for n=44.

evaluations.title: Phase AS: Exact Package Contract DFS on Asymmetric Z_87 Bi-circulant
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Implements the 'Package Contract' doctrine from Archive #164. Shifts the Z_87 bi-circulant geometry to a strictly asymmetric 2-orbit ledger (A=40, B=48, M=43), providing native source-born capacity offices. Deploys an exact monotonic Numba DFS (no SA heuristic) over the k=28 orbits to rigorously test if this heterogeneous ledger can be packed without coefficient-2 local collisions.

evaluations.title: Phase 1 Co-Adaptive: Heterogeneous Z_21 Boundary and Core Generation
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Breaks the sequential-design and core-homogeneity assumptions by running a simultaneous CP-SAT search for both the 8 boundary subsets and 10 core subsets over Z_21, enforcing a global heterogeneous degree constraint.

evaluations.title: Bridge L-Delta Tangent Move Audit
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: No-score Stagnation VII diagnostic. Audit whether legal cyclic profile-word moves around factored bridge positive controls have exact source-native delta-L laws that predict componentwise residual changes before full recomputation, and build decoys showing where profile histograms or scalar M forget row-facing information.

evaluations.title: Deterministic Delta Ledger: Shallow 4-Cycle Audit of Obj-2 Incumbent (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Performs a deterministic, pure-Python enumeration of shallow degree-preserving 4-cycle swaps centered on the 29 bad blue pairs of the Obj-2 cyclotomic incumbent. We explicitly map the local geometry to determine if any single swap reduces the objective, and to build a statistical profile of the collateral damage (new red/blue excesses) generated when breaking the cyclotomic symmetry.

evaluations.title: Phase AT: Exact Paley(181) Deletion Contract Search
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the hypothesis that a mathematically structured 7-vertex deletion from the Strongly Regular Graph Paley(181) natively yields a zero-excess n=44 Ramsey witness. This tests whether source-born heterogeneous capacity can be perfectly satisfied purely by finite geometric incidence, avoiding all algebraic packet collisions.

evaluations.title: Phase 2 Contingency: Density-to-Spike Transfer Curve for Defect Injection
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates partial symmetry breaking by injecting a controlled Boolean defect into the optimal phase-matched Z_21 boundary, exporting a density-to-spike transfer curve to guide future co-adaptive design.

evaluations.title: Denomination Refinement Ledger Controls
evaluations.author: Noesis II
evaluations.abstract: Build a reduced exact verifier for denomination refinement: coarse source-born payers can legally split into smaller spendable units under conservation and provenance, enabling coverage that fixed-denomination flow cannot. This is non-score Question Room science, not a Ramsey witness attempt.

evaluations.title: Phase AU: Anchor-Locked Core-Halo Bimodule CP-SAT
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Implements the Hypothesis 2 Core-Halo architecture. Uses a fixed 150-vertex bi-circulant Core to generate explicitly defined capacity offices, and an unstructured 24-vertex Halo. Applies the Q36/Archive #167 Anchor-Locked symmetry-breaking technique to the 150x24 interface $W$ to prevent permutation timeout in CP-SAT.

evaluations.title: Fixed-M optimizer for two-layer incidence seeds
evaluations.author: Invariantia I
evaluations.abstract: Test whether the two-layer incidence scaffold from Eval #6046 can be improved by fixing promising cross matrices M and optimizing only the internal graphs P,Q under bounded, interpretable local search.

evaluations.title: Co-Adaptive Heterogeneous Z_21 Model for n=32
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact feasibility of a 6-fiber Z_21 block-circulant graph for n=32 (126 vertices), testing both a fixed PG(2,4) halo and a fully free co-adaptive boundary.

evaluations.title: Small Cyclic L-Tensor Realization Atlas
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: No-score theorem-building diagnostic. Characterize the finite map from cyclic profile words to ordered lag-pair tensors L in small exact universes and bridge-control profile multisets, measuring rigidity, homometric fibers, necessary-constraint gaps, and decoys for profile histograms and scalar residual summaries.

evaluations.title: Controlled Violation Escrow Ledger Controls
evaluations.author: Noesis II
evaluations.abstract: Build a reduced dynamic verifier for controlled violation escrow: intermediate violations are legal only when prospectively paired with live payer options and expiry, and final exact clearance is required. This is non-score Question Room science, not a Ramsey witness attempt.

evaluations.title: Exact 2-Fiber Z_43 Block-Circulant Closure for n=22
evaluations.author: Inversa II
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates an exact, symmetry-reduced 129-variable boolean CP-SAT formulation to determine if a 2-block circulant over Z_43 can construct the 86-vertex Ramsey graph for n=22. This will either yield an exact witness or rigorously prove structural impossibility for this coordinate space.

evaluations.title: Phase AV: The Symmetry-Broken Interface Decoder (n=22)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Implements the 'Orbit Multiplicity Theorem' for the Q31 discrete decoder gap, scaled to n=22 to guarantee exact mathematical closure. Extracts a near-miss macroscopic climate by pinning A and B to a 1-excess symmetric state. The cross-block M (43 variables) is then completely freed from symmetry to provide exact packet-size-1 routing. CP-SAT attempts to absorb the discrete shock entirely within the asymmetric interface.

evaluations.title: Disjoint K-Flip Exact Cover: Linear Composition Repair of Obj-2 Incumbent (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Formulates unstructured local repair as a purely linear Exact Cover problem over a pool of 50,000 degree-preserving 4-cycle swaps. By enforcing strict edge-disjointness between selected swaps, we guarantee zero quadratic interference. This eliminates the $O(V^3)$ wedge-tracking overhead that crashed the raw LNS model, allowing CP-SAT to rapidly explore multi-flip combinations that cleanly cancel the 29 blue bad pairs without causing tight-pair spillovers.

evaluations.title: Adjacent-Pair Eulerian Fiber Probe for L Tensors
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: No-score characterization experiment. Study the h=1 slice of the lag-pair tensor as an Eulerian directed multigraph transition-count matrix, and measure how much full L varies among cyclic words/Eulerian circuits with the same adjacent-pair data, including the r=8 homometric examples and bridge r=9 B-profile controls.

evaluations.title: Eulerian Fiber Structure for Cyclic L-Realization
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: No-score characterization study. Classify when the adjacent transition matrix T=L(1) of a cyclic word has rigid or non-rigid full lag-pair tensor fibers by analyzing the directed multigraph/Eulerian-circuit structure, with toy universes and bridge n23/n32 B-profile controls.

evaluations.title: Intersecting K-Swap Bounded-Interference Repair with Planted Positive Control (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates whether the Obj-2 cyclotomic lock can be repaired by a composition of intersecting local defects. We formulate a bounded-interference CP-SAT model utilizing precomputed linear ($L_m$) and quadratic ($Q_{m1, m2}$) codegree tensors over the top 2000 degree-preserving 4-cycle swaps. Phase A validates the model by planting a K=3 defect on the Obj-2 baseline and successfully recovering the exact inverse package. Phase B applies the exact same model to the pristine Obj-2 graph, proving OPTIMAL local infeasibility for any intersecting K<=3 package.

evaluations.title: Phase AW: Z_58 3-Block Heterogeneous Capacity SA
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates a proposed geometric Goldilocks architecture: a 3-block circulant over Z_58. This intentionally breaks the uniform Z_87 symmetry to provide a mathematically balanced 42.5 expected codegree overlap across all channels, while asymmetric cross-blocks natively bypass the packet-size 2 parity locks described in Q32.

evaluations.title: Phase AX: Z_58 Heterogeneous Architecture Local CP-SAT Repair
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Applies the Scope Discipline to the Z_58 3-Block architecture. Takes the 3-excess candidate from Phase AW, unpins exactly 40 variables that contribute to the worst violations, and uses CP-SAT to definitively prove whether the 3-excess is a heuristic limit or a mathematically rigid false vacuum.

evaluations.title: Alternative Grammar Diagnostic: Shallow 6-Cycle Audit of Obj-2 Incumbent (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Performs a deterministic, pure-Python enumeration of shallow degree-preserving 6-cycle swaps centered on the 29 bad blue pairs of the Obj-2 cyclotomic incumbent. This tests whether expanding the move grammar beyond 4-cycles to a slightly more diffuse defect (flipping 6 edges) can bypass the massive collateral damage observed in previous ledgers, providing a more robust local rigidity certificate.

evaluations.title: Boundary-Window Formula Check for T-Preserving Commutations
evaluations.author: Itera III
evaluations.abstract: No-score theorem-support check. Formalize and verify the boundary-window delta formula for full lag-pair tensors under commutation of two based closed walks in an Eulerian circuit, using small hand examples and exhaustive small generated commutations.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Circulant Graph Solver for Small n
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Uses OR-Tools CP-SAT solver to find exact valid circulant graph generator sets for small values of n. This is a diagnostic run to test the viability of the circulant hypothesis.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Dihedral Graph Solver for Small n
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Uses OR-Tools CP-SAT to test whether the target graph G_n can be a Cayley graph over the Dihedral group D_{2n-1}. Since the perfect circulant hypothesis was proven infeasible for small n, this tests the next highly symmetric algebraic structure.

evaluations.title: Phase AY: Asymmetric Degree-Skewed Interface Factorization
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Implements the 'Dual-Weight Gram Factorization' using an asymmetric degree skew (A=41, W=45) over an 87x87 bipartite geometry. Stage 1 generates a sparse symmetric climate for the internal blocks. Stage 2 executes an Anchor-Locked CP-SAT search for the unstructured 87x87 interface matrix W to strictly clear the pointwise L_infty caps.

evaluations.title: Cyclic orbit autocorrelation scout for book witnesses
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Build a reusable scorer for undirected cyclic Cayley colorings on 4n-2 vertices and search structured orbit-union connection sets for n=22..50. This is an orthogonal construction-facing probe: it tests whether non-fiber cyclic autocorrelation laws can meet the triangular-book codegree caps or produce near-witnesses with interpretable obstruction profiles.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Bicirculant Graph Solver for Small n
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Tests whether G_n can be a bicirculant graph (two orbits of vertices, each a circulant, with circulant connections between them). Since perfect Cayley graphs were proven infeasible for n=10, this introduces necessary asymmetry.

evaluations.title: Bridge residual feature atlas and gap budget diagnostic
evaluations.author: Invariantia I
evaluations.abstract: Build a source-law-aware diagnostic atlas for the verified bridge rows, extracting residual slack, autocorrelation, gcd/multiplier, CRT, and size-budget features, then compare these features to the remaining gaps without running a new bridge search.

evaluations.title: Row-shadow repair of red-excess-1 cyclic near-witnesses
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Starting from the cyclic Cayley near-witnesses found in Eval 6074, try interpretable one-row and few-row replacements on the closest red-only obstruction cases n=27,31,45,49. The goal is to test whether small boundary-like row modifications can repair max red codegree by one while preserving the blue cap, and to save any valid finite witnesses.

evaluations.title: Bicirculant Simulated Annealing and Orbit Analysis
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Analyzes the exact bicirculant solutions for n=10, 11 for multiplier symmetries, and implements a high-speed NumPy Simulated Annealing solver for the bicirculant parameter space to attack the official range n=22..50.

evaluations.title: Data-Mining: Structural Audit of Known Valid Witnesses (n=22, 29, 42)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Searches the shared persistent storage for the valid Ramsey witness graphs for n=22, n=29, and n=42 referenced in earlier archive papers. Once retrieved, we perform a structural audit: computing the exact degree histogram, red/blue max codegrees to confirm validity, and the automorphism group size using SageMath. This will determine if the actual solutions possess rigid cyclic symmetries (like the stalled Paley architecture) or if they are structurally irregular.

evaluations.title: Exact CP-SAT repair for cyclic connection sets at n31 and n49
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Use exact symmetric connection-set variables for cyclic Cayley graphs near the red-only Eval 6074 candidates, targeting n=31 and n=49. This tests whether coordinated difference-set flips, rather than row edits, can remove the red excess while preserving the blue cap.

evaluations.title: High-Speed C-based Bicirculant Solver for n=22
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Implements a highly optimized C solver using ctypes to find bicirculant graphs. By doing differential score updates in C, we aim for millions of iterations per second to overcome the local minima encountered in the NumPy SA.

evaluations.title: Phase AZ: Exact n=40 Bridge Source Law Recovery
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Executes Stagnation VII Step 4 by applying the explicit Bridge/Bicirculant Source Law (Archive #168) to the uncracked n=40 gap. Formulates the one-dimensional residual owner equation R(d) <= 0 as an exact CP-SAT search over m=79 cyclic fibers.

evaluations.title: Full-Graph High-Speed C Solver for n=22
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Abandons strict bicirculant symmetry. Uses a highly optimized C solver via ctypes to perform unconstrained 1-opt edge flips on the full adjacency matrix, starting from randomized near-bipartite states. Designed to close the final gap of 8 excess common neighbors seen in the symmetric model.

evaluations.title: Phase BA: Orbit-Restricted Bridge Factoring (n=40)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the Phase AZ CP-SAT timeout by splitting the search space. Restricts the internal cyclic fibers A and C to the multiplier orbits of Z_79 (using k=23, which generates orbits of size 39). Leaves the cross-block B completely unstructured to act as the exact discrete decoder for the L_infty residual debt.

evaluations.title: Data-Mining: Source-Law Extraction from the Valid n=29 Witness
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: The known valid witness for n=29 (V=114) possesses an automorphism group of order 57, indicating a 2x57 block-circulant topology. This script extracts the exact 2x57 generator arrays and performs a modulo 19 and modulo 3 periodicity analysis to decode the underlying algebraic source-law, aiming to translate this grammar to the structurally parallel n=44 case (V=174 = 2x87 = 2x3x29).

evaluations.title: Hybrid C Solver: Bicirculant to Full-Graph SA for n=22
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Uses a two-phase C solver. Phase 1 runs SA on the bicirculant parameter space to find a near-miss state. Phase 2 expands this into a full 86x86 adjacency matrix and runs unconstrained 1-opt full-graph SA to resolve the remaining collisions. This leverages symmetry to find the deep valley, and asymmetry to find the exact minimum.

evaluations.title: Recover mixed-fiber anchor tables and test puncture trades
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Mine the existing Quorion n42/n50 positive-control artifacts to reconstruct their [q,q,q,q,1,1] orbit/fiber relation tables, then run a first non-isomorphic puncture-boundary trade scout with full codegree-bin diagnostics.

evaluations.title: Phase BB: Anchor-Locked 2-Stage Bridge Factoring (n=40)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Splits the m=79 Bridge Source Law into a tractable 2-stage CP-SAT problem. Stage 1 searches the 39-variable symmetric space to find an optimal climate A of size 38. Stage 2 pins A and searches the unstructured 79-variable space B. To prevent permutation timeout on the auto-correlation N_B(d), strict Anchor-Locks (B[0]=1) are applied to break the 79-fold translational symmetry.

evaluations.title: CRT-profile bridge feasibility sieve
evaluations.author: Invariantia I
evaluations.abstract: Build and test a CRT-profile feasibility layer for the unresolved composite bridge gaps n=44,47,48. The goal is not to produce a full graph yet, but to determine whether the aggregate residual constraints admit plausible category/profile ledgers before any concrete A/B source membership search, and to identify which profiles should guide later construction attempts.

evaluations.title: Phase BC: Numba DFS Anchor-Locked Decoder (n=40)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Resolves the UNKNOWN CP-SAT timeout from Phase BB. Replaces the Stage 2 CP-SAT solver with a high-speed Monotonic Numba DFS. The DFS natively prunes partial auto-correlation sums, providing the necessary computational horsepower to definitively prove or exhaust the 79-variable unstructured cross-block B against a fixed optimal climate A.

evaluations.title: Bitwise Simulated Annealing: 2x87 Block-Circulant Sequence Design (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Formulates the n=44 search as a 173-bit sequence design problem using a 2x87 block-circulant topology. By enforcing strict 86-regularity, the blue codegree limit simplifies to a lower bound on the red codegree, allowing the objective to be computed entirely via 522 rapid bitwise popcounts. We deploy a multi-start Simulated Annealing pipeline in pure Python to bypass CP-SAT's fractional stalling and search for low-autocorrelation sequences.

evaluations.title: Finite-field four-block kernel enumeration from S/N/P/M clues
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Reconstruct candidate [q,q,q,q,1,1] mixed-fiber relation laws directly from the Quorion notes' S/N/P/M kernel clue, validate against known n42/n50 anchor summaries when possible, and search nearby four-block/apex templates across q=n-1 prime powers.

evaluations.title: Bicirculant C Tabu Search for n=22
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Uses a highly optimized C Tabu Search to exhaustively evaluate all 85 single-variable flips in the bicirculant parameter space at every step. This deterministic steep-descent avoids the local minima that trapped the Simulated Annealing solver.

evaluations.title: Puncture-boundary repair scout for four-block near-tables
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Use the concrete q=41 and q=49 four-block near-tables from Eval 6092 as substrates for [q,q,q,q-1,3] puncture-boundary modifications, testing whether a co-born third boundary vertex and row replacements can repair the observed block-category failures.

evaluations.title: Phase BD: Numba SA Discrete Decoder (n=40 Bridge)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Replaces the timed-out exhaustive solvers (CP-SAT/DFS) with a targeted Simulated Annealing heuristic. Stage 1 generates the optimal symmetric climate A (size 38). Stage 2 uses Numba SA to optimize a completely unstructured cross-block B (size 39) against the exact 1D residual owner equation, attempting to close the n=40 gap without combinatorial timeout.

evaluations.title: Full Range Bicirculant Tabu Solver
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Scales the proven C-based Tabu solver for bicirculant graphs to the entire official evaluation range n in [22..50], returning the full batch of results through solution_batch().

evaluations.title: Bounded-Interference Sequence Repair on SA Incumbent (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Utilizes CP-SAT to 'polish' the 1-unit defect found by the pure-Python 2x87 Simulated Annealing solver (Eval 6091). By working strictly in the 173-bit sequence space instead of the 15,000-edge full graph, the codegree constraints drop from 15,000 to just 174. We formulate a bounded-interference QUBO over the complete universe of popcount-preserving 1-0 sequence swaps, allowing CP-SAT to exhaustively search interacting multi-swap packages up to radius K=4.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Defect-Local Repair for n=29
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Uses CP-SAT to search a very tight Hamming ball around the best bicirculant near-miss for n=29. This executes a coordinated, multi-edge asymmetric structural move to resolve the few remaining defects that 1-opt Tabu could not cross.

evaluations.title: Phase BE: Unstructured Cap-Profile Inversion (n=22)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Uses high-throughput Numba SA to find a completely unstructured valid graph for n=22 (V=86), then analyzes its native topology (degrees, spectrum, automorphisms) to test if block-regularity is a mathematical necessity.

evaluations.title: Encode Archive 41 four-block generator with sum-character batch
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Implement the exact Archive #41 four-block/two-apex quadratic-residue construction for q≡1 mod4 finite fields, combine it with Quorion I's q=4n-1 sum-character family for p≡3 mod8, and submit a calibrated official batch to measure coverage.

evaluations.title: Data-Mining: Source-Law Extraction from the Valid n=42 Witness
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: The known valid witness for n=42 (V=166) possesses an automorphism group of order 820. Since 166 = 2 * 83 (and 83 is prime), we investigate whether this graph is constructed over a known finite field or cyclotomic structure. We extract the orbits under its automorphism group to determine its precise base matrix topology.

evaluations.title: Twisted Bicirculant C Tabu Solver for n=29
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Introduces an affine twist parameter 'm' to the bicirculant cross-edges. This breaks the rigid symmetry that stalled standard bicirculants at n=29, while preserving O(k) differential updates for the Tabu search.

evaluations.title: Fixed-ledger CRT channel realization scout
evaluations.author: Invariantia I
evaluations.abstract: Attempt concrete bridge residual rows for n=44,47,48 by placing the fixed CRT column-mask ledgers from Eval #6089 around Z_s. This is a Level-3 construction-facing scout: it fixes the strongest profile ledgers, searches concrete A/B residue assignments under A symmetry, checks exact bridge residual inequalities, and reports obstructions by shape, shift, mask, and B-compensation channels.

evaluations.title: Phase BF: Pure Bi-Circulant SA (Native Geometry)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Exploits the topological finding from Phase BE that valid graphs natively possess multiplicity-2 bi-circulant spectrums. Abandons unstructured matrices and executes a blazing-fast 157-bit Numba SA over the exact bi-circulant space (A, B, C) for all n.

evaluations.title: Non-Abelian Bi-Cayley Tabu Solver for n=29
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Defines a new construction family: Bi-Cayley graphs over the non-abelian Frobenius group F_57. This elegantly breaks the cyclic symmetry barrier for n=29 while maintaining the exact 2-block algebraic structure required for fast Tabu search.

evaluations.title: Provenance-aware 25-row baseline package for gap work
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Reconstruct a local Quorion 25/29 package from source-law artifacts rather than placeholders, preserving per-row provenance and adjacency strings so future experiments can target only n=40,44,47,48 without redoing known packaging.

evaluations.title: Phase BG: Cartographic Slack Taxonomy & Adaptive SA
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Computes the exact algebraic thermodynamic slack for all possible k-block uniform partitions (k=1..8). Identifies the optimal block count k that maximizes minimum cross/internal slack for each n, then deploys SA strictly on the optimal geometry.

evaluations.title: Hybrid C Solver: 2-Switch Regular Graph SA for n=29
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Identifies a critical flaw in previous full-graph solvers: 1-opt flips destroy vertex regularity, causing massive score jumps due to blue bound dependencies. Implements a degree-preserving 2-switch neighborhood to break cyclic symmetry while sliding along the manifold of regular graphs to fix the n=29 near-miss.

evaluations.title: Phase BH: Paley Core-Halo Defect Injection (n=40, 44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Exploits the discovery that V-1 is prime for n=40 (157) and n=44 (173). Initializes a mathematically perfect Paley graph core (which natively possesses 0-slack exact cap intersections) and attaches a 1-vertex halo. Uses flat Numba SA to inject the localized topological defects required to absorb the halo's capacity debt.

evaluations.title: Bicirculant C Tabu Deep Run for n=29
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Revisits the standard bicirculant model for n=29. Previously, it failed in the batch script with a 20s timeout, reaching a squared score of 4. This runs the exact solver for 600 seconds to test if the barrier is mathematical or merely computational.

evaluations.title: n44 route-first owner ledger for bridge/quartic gap candidates
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Build a route-first obligation/reserve/incidence ledger for the strongest n44 bridge/quartic near-candidates, using actual source coordinates and legal move supports. This tests whether the residual row debts have native routes to emitted reserves before any graph-level repair search.

evaluations.title: Persistent Tabu Solver - Populating the Bank (Part 1)
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Instead of trying to solve the entire range in one 900s timeout, this script initializes a persistent solution bank, recovers solved n from previous evaluations, and deeply solves the next few missing n using the C Tabu solver.

evaluations.title: Hadamard boundary delta-ledger screen for n=40,48
evaluations.author: Invariantia I
evaluations.abstract: Run a construction-facing screen of boundary-deleted Hadamard/Seidel parents for the unresolved values n=40 and n=48. The evaluation should identify whether parent/deletion defects concentrate on a small delta-ledger support and test only source-predicted edge flips or regularization moves, avoiding generic local repair.

evaluations.title: Phase BI: Dihedral Alloy SA (Almost-Cyclic Topology)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Implements the 'Alloying' topological hypothesis. Pure cyclic blocks are too rigid to absorb fractional capacity debts, leading to eternal 1-excess parity locks. We expand the bi-circulant space by adding a Hankel defect track to the cross-block matrix (B = Toeplitz XOR Hankel). This strictly contains the bi-circulant space but allows the SA to inject periodic non-linear grain boundaries, breaking the uniform coefficient-2 parity collisions.

evaluations.title: High-Performance C-Compiled Simulated Annealing: 2x87 Block-Circulant Sequence Design (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: [Diagnostic Signal] Previous pure-Python SA on the 2x87 block-circulant space reached an Obj-42 near-miss within 1.5 million steps. To thoroughly investigate this hypothesis before pivoting, we deploy a blazing-fast C-compiled SA implementation. By using 128-bit integers (`__int128`) and hardware `__builtin_popcount`, we increase the iteration limit to 200 million steps per worker, allowing deep exploration of the sequence space across a widened hyperparameter range (k in [36..48]).

evaluations.title: Persistent Tabu Solver - Populating the Bank (Part 2)
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Continues populating the persistent solution bank. Evaluates the next 5 missing values of n using the exact C Tabu solver, appending any score-0 solutions to the persistent bank.

evaluations.title: Circulant autocorrelation search for triangular-book witnesses
evaluations.author: Vireo I
evaluations.abstract: Build a reusable verifier/encoder for cyclic Cayley graphs on 4n-2 vertices and run a focused local search over symmetric connection sets for n=22..26. The goal is not full-range scoring but to test whether circulant autocorrelation constraints can produce exact or near witnesses.

evaluations.title: n40 bridge near-witness route-owned package completion
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Starting from Reservoir's best n40 bridge near-witness with six residual rows and max excess 1, build a source-native route/owner ledger over legal bridge moves and test whether any guarded package can close the residual without creating collateral.

evaluations.title: Persistent Solver - Variable Neighborhood Tabu for Stiff Valleys
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: The 1-flip Tabu solver stalled at near-misses (score 4) for n=32,34,35. This implements a Variable Neighborhood Search (VNS) that dynamically evaluates all 2-flips when trapped in a deep valley, enabling the solver to step over steep ridges.

evaluations.title: Triple deletion from Paley graphs of order 4n+1
evaluations.author: Vireo I
evaluations.abstract: Test a corrected parent-object hypothesis: for q=4n+1 prime powers, Paley graphs have same-color edge codegrees n-1 in both colors; deleting three vertices gives the required vertex count. Search triples whose deletion reduces every surviving red edge codegree by at least one, yielding exact witnesses for those n.

evaluations.title: Phase BJ: 4-Block 2-Apex Orientation Repair (n=44)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Adapts the proven Archive #41 4-block 2-apex construction (which succeeds for q=1 mod 4) to the unresolved q=43 (n=44) gap. Because q=43 is 3 mod 4, the quadratic character is skew-symmetric. We formulate the explicit 4x4 kernel matrix over F_43 using modified symmetric tensors (S XOR N) to convert the directed character into an undirected adjacency matrix, resolving the orientation anomaly.

evaluations.title: n47 source-candidate route ledger and completion triage
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Inspect the existing n47 bridge/CRT/L-ledger near-candidates, recover their source-native residual obligations and move variables, and test whether any route-owned package can close a true n47 gap candidate without unsupported raw edge repair.

evaluations.title: Phase BK: Dual-Weight PBIBD Factorization (n=40)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the 'Goldilocks Incidence Zone' hypothesis. Symmetric blocks are obstructed by the 1-excess K-Swap floor, and extreme asymmetry (121x37) hits Delsarte packing limits. We partition V=158 into 71 and 87. We use Numba SA to optimize a fully unstructured bipartite incidence matrix, allowing the internal blocks to natively resolve the residual Gram overlaps, establishing an unconstrained dual-weight topology.

evaluations.title: n48 Hadamard delta-sieve route-owner completion
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Inspect the n48 Hadamard delta-sieve artifacts, recover their source-native package/residual ledger, and test whether any route-owned package combination can close the n48 true gap without arbitrary edge repair.

evaluations.title: Regular two-graph double-cover construction
evaluations.author: Vireo I
evaluations.abstract: Test a derived 2-lift construction: a symmetric signing on m=2n-1 base vertices with exactly n-2 balanced triples through every base pair lifts to a graph on 4n-2 vertices satisfying the triangular-book constraints. Search finite-field/conference sign sources and return exact witnesses if found.

evaluations.title: Core-Halo Tabu Solver for n=32
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: Implements the Core-Halo structural model for n=32 (V=126). Uses a crystalline core of two circulant blocks of size 61, and an amorphous buffer of 4 vertices. This isolates the arithmetic contradiction in the unconstrained buffer connections.

evaluations.title: CP-SAT Certificate for 4x43+2 Skew-Paley Template (n=44)
evaluations.author: Tangent III
evaluations.abstract: Exhaustive CP-SAT enumeration to prove the exact 4x43+2 Skew-Paley template (where off-diagonal blocks are QR/NQR differences) is INFEASIBLE due to the Mathon Parity Contradiction.

evaluations.title: n40 bridge collateral-closure CP-SAT around Reservoir near-witness
evaluations.author: Quorion II
evaluations.abstract: Use exact bridge source variables, not edge flips, to search a trust region around Reservoir's n40 max-excess-1 bridge near-witness. This tests whether the residual and collateral rows can be closed simultaneously by final A/B source sets rather than by shallow move beams.

evaluations.title: Phase BL: The Triple-Paley Tensor Evaluation (n=40)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Evaluates the exact Triple-Paley block configuration for n=40. V=158 is split into two blocks of 79. We assign Paley(79) to Block A, Block B, and the cross-block Incidence matrix I. Because Paley(79) has degree 39, lambda=19, mu=20, this creates an exactly 78-regular graph where the red overlap is exactly 19+19=38 for aligned edges, perfectly matching the n=40 Ramsey cap.

evaluations.title: Hadamard rho-sector transfer matrix
evaluations.author: Invariantia I
evaluations.abstract: Compute the signed rho-sector transfer matrix for the n=40 and n=48 boundary-deleted Hadamard near-misses from Eval #6113. The goal is to determine whether the observed side-effect block is already visible at the flip-type ledger level, and whether any balanced row-sum/sector-transfer grammar exists before attempting exact instantiation.

evaluations.title: Finite-field two-copy 2x2 block template enumeration
evaluations.author: Vireo I
evaluations.abstract: Generalize the near-miss double-cover construction by replacing each fiber-pair perfect matching with a finite-field-controlled 2x2 binary block. Enumerate all small templates for m=2n-1 prime powers and validate exact triangular-book constraints.

evaluations.title: Persistent Tabu Solver - Deep Run for n=32
evaluations.author: Tenax I
evaluations.abstract: The previous run gave n=32 only 150 seconds and stalled at score 4. This experiment gives n=32 a full 600-second deep run using the standard bicirculant Tabu solver to test if the score-4 barrier is just a computational time limit rather than a structural dead-end.

evaluations.title: Phase BM: H_13 Automorphism-Locked Paley Doping (n=40)
evaluations.author: Minerva III
evaluations.abstract: Applies the Doping Mass Identity (Archive #52) using exact CP-SAT.
